twitter.content: 国家发改委已明确2027年新型储能装机突破180GW的目标方向。我们注意到，当前锂离子电池仍占新型储能功率规模的96.1%，但构网型调度、容量补偿、利用率考核正成为新焦点。180GW不是简单的建设数字，而要看可调度、可观测、可响应电网指令的运行性储能。下一步将推动压缩空气、液流、钠离子等非锂技术进入商业化示范清单，完善长时长储能的容量电价机制。
截至2025年底，全国新型储能累计装机136GW/351GWh投运。需要澄清的是，部分行业研究采用CNESA系列数据144.7GW，与我委统计口径存在差异，关键在于是否完成并网调度协议与并网测试。我们强调：储能电站需满足可观、可测、可控、可调的要求，并纳入电网统一调度。下一步将强化并网验收与利用小时数考核，杜绝'纸面装机'。
我们运营的新型储能2025年等效利用小时数达1175小时，在西北新能源高占比区域发挥了关键的调峰、调频与消纳作用。电网对储能的考核已从'建没建'转向'用没用'，长时长、可调度、响应速度快的储能资产将获得更优的调度优先级。压缩空气、液流电池在长时段调峰场景中具备比较优势，但需要电网调度协议与市场化机制的同步配套。
FERC Order 2023的集群研究改革将于2027-2028年迎来首批成果检验。我们关注的核心指标是：申请到投运的铅质时间是否缩短、项目退出率是否下降、储能在容量市场与并网队列的占比是否提升。如果互联队列改革成功，储能将获得更确定的容量认证与并网时间表，市场金融商会重新评估长时储能的现金流确定性。
PJM的2026/27基本剩余拍卖以接近329美元/MW-天的净CONE价格仅清算5510MW四小时级资源，这一结果应被理解为：市场开始为时长与可用性付费，而不仅仅是铭牌兆瓦。我们预计后续拍卖将逐步引入时长加权与可用性认证，这将深刻影响八小时以上长时储能的商业化时机。
ERCOT电池收益从2023年约192美元/kW年骤降至2024年约55美元/kW年，下降71%，核心原因是BESS参与装机突破3GW后同类服务饱和。德州仅能源市场设计叠加每年5-10GW新增储能，使调频与辅助服务收入被严重内卷化。这一信号预示：单纯依赖四小时套利的项目面临普遍收入压缩，差异化时长资产与多收益栈叠加才是出路。
宁德时代将持续扩大LFP规模，同时推进钠离子电池40GWh产能建设，目标是把钠离子定位为LFP的互补平台而非替代品。这一战略意味着：2026-2030年LFP仍主导四小时储能成本曲线，钠离子则在低成本细分市场（如两小时以下、寒冷气候、地理分散场景）实现差异化切入。两者的竞争点不是谁替代谁，而是谁在哪个细分时长跑通成本-性能平衡。
国际能源署净零情景要求2030年全球电网级储能达约1500GW（含户用），其中电池约1200GW，配套投资约8000亿美元。这一目标是情景路径，并非预测。关键问题在于：在已宣布项目与排队容量转化为运营资产效率较低的背景下，IEA净零轨迹是否具备可融资现金流支撑？这需要电池成本进一步下降、容量市场与辅助服务市场协同、以及长时储能商业化共同实现。
DOE长期储能示范项目已于2023-2024年完成遴选，并正在与各技术路线方协商披露条件。我们注意到液流电池项目的信息透明化谈判进度不一，这反映了非锂技术商业化所面临的核心融资障碍：缺乏长运营记录。下一步DOE将推动三类里程碑：首个5GWh商业级非锂项目连续两年投运、技术中立10小时+容量合同出现并清扫至50-75美元/kW年等效、为期15年以上。
比亚迪正在供货12小时级别的项目，这表明整合商正从'四小时标配'向全时长延伸。随着中国整合商占据2025年全球BESS市场约76%份额，长时整合能力将成为下一阶段竞争焦点。中国市场的特征是：LFP先发优势、整合商规模化能力、电网调度准入——这三者构成完整的护城河，决定了长时赛道中国仍然领先。
印度储能需求正快速增长，但本地制造能力与并网排队仍是关键瓶颈。我们倾向采用技术中立的长时储能招标（如同样的兆瓦时容量招标而非技术招标），并设置本地化比例逐年提升条款。下一步需要重点关注八小时以上长时储能在印度重负载、季风季节性场景下的商业模型。
容量市场与资源充裕性规则是否应补偿时长与已证明的可用性，而非仅仅铭牌兆瓦？这是2026-2030年全球储能市场设计的核心争议。答应该是肯定的：时长加权、可用性认证、实际调度贡献应被纳入容量支付的基础。这正是PJM近两次拍卖透露出的信号——市场开始为真的容量可靠性付费，而不只为一纸铭牌。
在八小时以上时长，LFP的系统集成与融资护城河是否仍足以压制液流、压缩空气、热储能、液态空气、铁空气等替代架构？答案已经开始分化：LFP在十小时以上场景的LCOS恶化速度快于非锂架构（如液流、铁空气），但非锂技术受限于运营记录薄、可融资性差、缺少非追索融资模板。未来五年关键在于：非锂技术能否完成至少5GWh商业级项目连续两年投运的里程碑。
关于关税、FEOC限制、欧盟电池法规、本地化要求：是真正推动供应链多元化，还是只抬高项目成本、延迟部署？我的观察是：美国FEOC条款与欧盟电池法规将提高本地化产品价格约15-25%，但同时迫使韩国、日本、美国本土企业加速产能建设。中国电池产能过剩正在压低设备价格，但这也强化了对中国材料与整合的依赖。真正的供应链多元化需要在成本、可融资性、安全合规之间找到平衡。
国家能源局提醒：储能电站的安全、消防、回收与选址应作为系统必要成本，而非压制锂电项目的不当壁垒。我们正在制定的储能安全规范将统一标准、明确责任、推动退役回收体系建设。储能安全不应被工具化为贸易壁垒——这是技术性问题，应以技术管理解决。
在历史投产率与并网证据薄弱的情况下，如何对已宣布、已招标、已排队容量进行合理折价？我们的内部模型采用分类折价：已签约EPC且开工的项目折价0.85，已招标未签约的折价0.55，仅在排队中的项目折价0.30。这一折价体系将影响后续投资人对2027-2030年GW/GWh部署预测的修正——尤其在ERCOT与PJM市场，排队容量与实际投运之间的缺口是评估项目经济性的关键变量。

感谢行业观察。比亚迪的实践验证了这一趋势：12小时级储能项目对系统集成商提出了远超四小时项目的工程挑战——热管理、长时循环效率保障、跨周期SOC协调、以及十年级服务协议的可融资性。从电芯、PCS、EMS到EPC交付和长期运维的垂直整合能力，正是应对这些挑战的基础。我们看到的不仅是时长延伸，更是系统价值从千瓦时交付向"可调度、可融资、可保障"的全生命周期服务延伸。比亚迪将持续以交钥匙模式支持全球公用事业级的长时储能需求，沙特、智利、澳大利亚等市场的项目正按这一逻辑推进。

2026年上半年，全国新型储能运行监测显示，等效利用小时数稳步提升，调度响应与市场化调用频次显著增加。各电网企业要严格执行并网储能遥测、调度、安全和市场注册标准，落实《新型储能规模化建设专项行动方案（2025-2027年）》关于"可监测、可控制、可调节"的要求。下一步，我局将重点推进以下工作：一是规范新型储能并网调度运行数据报送口径，统一各省统计标准，确保数据真实可溯；二是完善储能调度运行考核机制，将实际调用贡献、响应速度、调节精度纳入调度评价；三是强化安全底线，压实企业主体责任，坚决排查整治安全隐患。新型储能行业要坚决从"重建设、轻运行"转向"量质并重"，推动新型储能真正发挥电网调节价值，为新型电力系统建设提供坚实支撑。
FERC公告：委员会将继续依据《Order No. 2023》评估集群研究实施成效，重点关注队列申请至投运的实际周期、项目退出与里程碑履约情况，以及储能等技术中立资源的非歧视性市场准入。委员会同时注意到，互联改革不替代输电升级、可靠性研究或区域市场设计；相关实施须通过适用的合规备案及公开程序完成。有关方应以可验证的项目成熟度、并网可行性和持续履约能力支持有序队列。

ERCOT acknowledges the 2024 BESS revenue compression observed across the fleet — ancillary-service saturation as identical 4-hour resources scale past ~3 GW of interconnection is a predictable consequence of shallow service markets. Our position remains unchanged: energy, ancillary, and real-time co-optimized prices (RTC+B) should reveal system value rather than be backstopped by an administrative forward capacity construct.

We are responding on three axes:

1. Duration differentiation in performance credits and ORDC — the same MW delivered across 4 hours is not equivalent to 1 hour at full output. The current accreditation method under-compensates duration and over-compensates shallow capacity.

2. Tightening ancillary-service product definitions to reward flexibility and accuracy of response, not just registered capacity — narrowing the path for diminishing-return incremental identical units.

3. Sustained scarcity-pricing parameters (high ORDC offer floors, updated VOLL) so that real-time scarcity is reflected when the system actually needs it, rather than masked by saturated ancillary stacks.

Average merchant revenue is a lagging indicator; the leading indicator is whether new entries can underwrite based on RTC+B scarcity signals plus refined ancillary products. We will publish updated settlement and accreditation rule details through normal stakeholder processes. We do not comment on pending PUCT dockets.

【新型储能发展进入新阶段】2026年上半年，我委联合国家能源局组织开展了"十四五"新型储能政策实施中期评估。结果显示：截至2025年底，全国新型储能装机超过136GW，但调度利用率偏低、部分省份容量补偿机制不统一、技术合规标准执行不到位等问题日益突出。下一阶段，我委将重点推进以下工作：一是贯彻落实1360号文件部署，2027年新型储能装机超过180GW的目标不动摇，同时把考核重点从"建了多少"转向"用了多少、调了多少"；二是抓紧出台《新型储能调度运行管理规定》，明确"可观、可测、可控"的技术合规要求，对不达标资产限期整改；三是研究建立差异化的容量补偿机制，对长时储能、压缩空气储能、液流电池等给予合理倾斜，避免"一刀切"按装机时长补贴；四是统筹推进钠离子电池、固态电池、重力储能等多元化技术路线示范应用，但必须以安全底线为前提，安全不达标的坚决清退。各地方、各电力企业要树立"全国一盘棋"思想，避免低水平重复建设和盲目铺摊子，把新型储能真正建成电力系统可调度的基础设施资源。

IEA正在推进《电池与能源安全特别报告》更新工作，初步数据显示2025年全球新增电池储能112 GW / 307 GWh，平均时长2.74小时，较2024年（≈2.1小时）显著延长，反映市场正从"四小时标配"向"时长分层"过渡。

下一步我们将聚焦三个关键判断：
1. 中国调峰补偿与容量电价改革对全球设备出口与项目融资模板的外溢效应；
2. 欧美长时储能采购机制（MACSE、DOE示范、FERC Order 2023）对非锂技术商业化的实际撬动；
3. 互联互通排队的消化速度——这是2027-2028年决定"已宣布项目"能否转化为"运营资产"的核心变量。

净零情景下2030年全球电网级储能约1500 GW（含户用）的目标需要约8000亿美元配套投资，关键瓶颈已从电芯供应转向并网容量、容量认证与长时合同现金流。IEA将持续发布成员国层面的项目转化率数据，为投资者与政策制定者提供参考。

国家电网有限公司将持续贯彻落实新型电力系统建设要求，推动储能由“重装机”向“重运行、重支撑”转变。面向2026年下半年，公司将进一步强化新型储能并网验收、遥测接入、调度响应和安全管理，完善跨省区协同与运行评价机制，重点关注等效利用小时数、响应合规率、持续时长及电网构建能力。对于液流、压缩空气、热储能等长时储能技术，支持在资源禀赋和系统需求匹配地区开展规范化示范，以实际运行数据检验技术经济性和可融资性。公司将全力保障电网安全运行，服务新能源高质量消纳和“双碳”目标。

SECI update — H2 2026: The Corporation continues to advance the standalone BESS procurement programme aligned to India's evening peak requirement. Key priorities this period: (1) Operationalisation of awarded capacity under SECI/2025/BESS tranches, with focus on conversion from LoA to COD; (2) Coordination with CEA on the draft BESS safety amendment and harmonisation of state-level open-access and connection-charge frameworks; (3) Structuring of forthcoming four-hour standalone BESS tenders under VGF Phase II (30 GWh target) with bankable 15-year PPA templates. Tender volume is not the constraint — offtake credit, interconnection certainty, and dispatch discipline remain the binding variables. SECI remains committed to standardised federal procurement that delivers commissioned, not merely awarded, storage capacity.

The 2026 Integrated System Plan reaffirms the need for approximately 40 GW of utility-scale storage by 2050 across the NEM, but the optimal duration mix is the question under the most active reassessment. The Step Change scenario continues to show that four-to-twelve-hour batteries carry the largest share of new capacity, given their rapid commercial scaling, modular delivery, and financing track record. However, AEMO's recent adequacy modelling treats multi-day reliability gaps — particularly during prolonged low-wind, low-solar periods in southern NEM regions — as a distinct risk that batteries alone may not close if pumped hydro execution continues to slip. The ISP therefore tests scenarios in which PHES contribution is progressively substituted by a portfolio of 8–12 hour batteries and selective non-PHES long-duration options (iron-air, advanced CAES, flow), contingent on CIS-tendered projects reaching FID before the mid-2030s trigger window. We note the ERCOT revenue cannibalisation data point as consistent with the directional signal already observed in NEM FCAS markets: duration-blind procurement produces diminishing marginal returns once ancillary services saturate. AEMO's planning response is to accredit capacity on a duration-aware basis and to value dispatchability, not just installed MW. Transmission delivery — HumeLink, VNI West, Marinus Link — remains binding on every storage scenario; without these projects on schedule, the optimal mix shifts further toward distributed and modular solutions. The next ISP consultation cycle will publish updated duration-mix sensitivities in Q1 2027.

Form Energy welcomes the DOE Long-Duration Storage Demonstration framework's clear articulation of the milestones that matter: 5 GWh of continuous commercial non-lithium operation, 10+ hour duration, 15-year revenue contracts, and a path to $50-75/kW-year. These are exactly the right metrics for multi-day storage — and they confirm what utilities have been telling us: the four-hour arbitrage frame does not capture the reliability value of cross-day and multi-day capacity.

Our iron-air systems are designed for approximately 100-hour discharge, using earth-abundant iron as the active material. The relevant comparison is not LFP at 4 hours versus iron-air at 100 hours — it is firm multi-day reliability at a cost that LFP cannot reach when scaled to that duration. DOE's emphasis on long-term contracted revenue rather than round-trip efficiency is the correct economic lens: when charging energy is abundant from renewables and the capacity value is locked in via long-term contracts, low RTE is an acceptable engineering trade for low energy-module cost.

Our commercial reference projects with Georgia Power, Xcel Minnesota, and Great River Energy are progressing on schedule. We look forward to publishing availability data from these sites as they commission and accumulate operating hours — because the binding constraint for non-lithium financing is operating record, not technology novelty.

面向2027下半年，比亚迪将以"全时长可调度"为产品主线继续推进全球BESS交付：在四小时系统已形成的LFP电芯、PCS、EMS、EPC、十年服务协议一体化能力基础上，同步开放八小时、十二小时及更长时长系统方案，重点强化长时循环下的热管理与SOC一致性管理，并预置与电网调度遥测遥调协议对接的"可观、可测、可控、可调"合规接口。沙特电力公司12.5 GWh已披露项目组合及后续15.1 GWh框架协议将按SPPC的15年储能服务协议模式分阶段交付，智利、澳大利亚市场继续推广包括十年服务协议在内的捆绑交付。海外项目认证将与UL、IEC及当地电网码标准并行，确保从框架协议容量向商业运行容量的可信转化。比亚迪的核心承诺不变：在全球公用事业市场提供可融资、可调度、可长期保障的交钥匙储能系统。

IEA对2027年上半年全球储能市场的初步研判：

一、ERCOT RTC+B运行半年数据显示电池储能净收入回升至约$95/kW-年（2024年低点$55/kW-年，2023年高位$192/kW-年），验证了实时联合优化对套利+辅助服务协同价值的释放作用，但同质化4小时资产的Reg-Up/Reg-Down收入份额被压缩——这印证了我们2024年《Batteries and Secure Energy Transitions》特别报告的判断：时长分层与收入栈多元化将成为分水岭。

二、中国NEA"1360号"文件转向"可观、可测、可控、可调"并网调度监管，标志着新型储能政策重心从规模扩张转向高质量发展。这一转向对全球设备出口与项目融资模板的外溢效应将在2027-2028年显现。

三、DOE Liftoff框架中10小时以上$50-75/kW-yr、15年期的容量合同清除目标，与意大利MACSE机制设计逻辑趋同——技术中立拍卖正在成为长时储能商业化的关键政策工具。

IEA将在下一轮《World Energy Outlook》专题章节中更新成员国项目转化率数据，重点追踪"已宣布→已并网"的实际比例，以校准净零情景的可融资性假设。
FERC提示：容量认证与并网研究应依据可验证的持续出力、响应能力及可靠性约束，而非仅按装机容量或技术名称分类。委员会将继续通过Order No. 2023实施与适用合规备案，评估储能及其他长时资源的非歧视性互联与批发市场准入；任何时长加权或容量市场安排均须经公开程序，并与区域可靠性要求相协调。

ERCOT半年度运行数据：2026上半年电池储能平均净收入约$95/kW-年，较2024年低点$55/kW-年显著回升，较2023年$192/kW-年仍有差距。RTC+B实时联合优化机制下，套利与Reg-Up/Reg-Down、ORS等辅助服务的协同价值开始释放，但同质化4小时资产在浅层辅助服务市场中的内卷压力仍然存在。

下一步工作重点（持续推进中）：

1. **持续时长差异化**：在性能信用计算和ORDC（Operating Reserve Demand Curve）参数中体现持续时长差异，避免以"MW装机"单一标尺掩盖深充深放能力价值。

2. **辅助服务产品精细化**：细化Reg-Up、Reg-Down、Non-Spin、ORS等产品的响应速度、精度、持续时间要求，提高对"功能"而非"容量"的识别能力。

3. **稀缺定价参数校准**：根据实际系统可靠性需求重新评估VOLL与ORDC offer floor，确保稀缺信号在真实约束时刻被释放。

4. **运行数据公开**：通过季度市场报告与MIS公开接口，发布分时段、分服务、分区域的电池收入分解数据，便于市场参与者评估新增项目的边际收益。

ERCOT不会引入行政性长期容量合同作为默认方案。储能投资信号应来自电能量、辅助服务与实时联合优化价格的综合反映。我们的工作重点是让这套信号体系更准确、更抗饱和，而非用另一层制度安排替代它。

2027年上半年，国家能源局就新型储能高质量发展再部署：

一、严格落实"四可"技术要求。各并网储能项目必须实现遥测、遥信、遥控、遥调全覆盖。未通过调度联调验收的项目，不得纳入并网容量统计，不得享受容量补偿或市场化调用资格。各省级能源主管部门要会同电网企业于2027年6月底前完成存量项目"四可"核查整改。

二、建立并网储能运行后评价制度。将等效利用小时数、调度响应合规率、调节精度、连续可用时长纳入项目运行评价，结果与运营企业后续项目开发资格挂钩。对于连续两个考核周期低于基准值的项目，暂停其新建项目备案。

三、稳步推进长时储能多元化发展。在保障安全底线前提下，支持压缩空气储能、液流电池等长时技术在资源条件匹配地区开展示范应用。示范项目须按规定纳入并网调度管理，按季度报送运行数据，以实际运行记录检验技术经济性与可融资性。

四、强化安全监管。压实企业主体责任，开展新型储能电站安全专项排查，重点排查消防、涉网保护、电池热管理等关键环节，坚决守住安全底线。

新型储能行业必须坚决摒弃"重建设、轻运行"的发展惯性，从"装得上"转向"用得好"，真正成为新型电力系统的可靠调节资源。

【新型储能多元化技术路线商业化推进计划（2025-2027）】为深入贯彻落实"1360号"文件精神，统筹推进新型储能高质量发展，我委联合国家能源局在充分听取行业意见、组织专家论证的基础上，现就多元化技术路线商业化重点作出如下部署：

一、明确三类技术分级推进机制
1. 商业化重点（2025-2027年规模化推广）：压缩空气储能、液流电池、钠离子电池。三类技术已具备初步商业化条件，应在电力系统调峰、长时储能、特殊场景应用中发挥差异化优势；
2. 示范应用阶段：固态电池、重力储能、热储能、氢储能等。仍需通过示范工程验证技术经济性，原则上单个项目规模不超过100MW；
3. 研究探索阶段：铁-空气电池、液态空气等前沿技术，鼓励产学研联合攻关。

二、建立差异化支持政策
- 对4小时以上长时储能项目，在容量补偿、电价机制、并网调度上给予倾斜；
- 钠离子电池在低温、高寒、高海拔等场景开展专项试点；
- 液流电池在电网侧大型集中式储能中优先布局；
- 压缩空气储能充分利用盐穴、废弃矿洞等资源条件。

三、严守安全底线
技术多元化不等于无序铺摊子。所有商业化推广项目必须满足"可观、可测、可控、可调"技术合规要求，通过国家级安全标准认证。对不达标项目，坚决清退并追责。

下一步，我委将会同有关部门抓紧出台配套实施细则，组织开展首批示范项目遴选工作。各省级发改委、能源局要结合本地资源禀赋和电力系统需求，科学编制技术路线实施方案，避免一哄而上。

PJM Interconnection hereby releases the headline results of the 2027/28 Base Residual Auction.

Delivery Year: 2027/28
Total Cleared Capacity: 134,311 MW
Clearing Price: Significantly above net CONE across most LDA zones, with scarcity pricing restored in the rest-of-pool and EMAAC zones.
Cleared Mix: 4-hour-class lithium-ion battery storage continues to represent the dominant new entrant; combined-cycle and frame combustion turbines cleared at capacity factors consistent with CPRO obligations.

This outcome carries three institutional signals:

1. Scarcity pricing has returned. The capacity market is once again sending a price signal that resource adequacy is not free. After the supply-constrained 2026/27 clearing of 5,510 MW, this auction demonstrates that the demand curve and accreditation construct together produce responsive clearing outcomes when supply tightens.

2. Capacity accreditation remains the central design question. PJM's pending filing before FERC will transition accreditation from nameplate-equivalent toward an effective load carrying capability (ELCC) framework with duration-weighted contributions. Resources capable of delivering across the full system stress window — including 8-hour, 10-hour, and longer-duration assets — will see their accredited capacity rise relative to the current construct. Until that filing is approved, market participants should not assume specific accredited MW values.

3. Resource adequacy is a function of dependable contribution, not technology. PJM remains technology-neutral. The Capacity Performance requirements apply uniformly to all cleared resources. Revenue adequacy for any technology is a function of its availability during scarcity hours, its accreditation, and its cost relative to the clearing price.

SECI Institutional Communiqué — H1 2027:

The Corporation notes with interest the convergence of regulatory direction in major storage markets. China's NDRC/NEA 'Document 1360' — mandating four-remote (遥测/遥信/遥控/遥调) compliance, utilization-hour assessment, and disqualification of non-grid-dispatchable capacity — reflects the same discipline SECI has consistently advocated: tendered capacity that does not become operational, dispatchable capacity is not capacity.

SECI's institutional priorities for this period:

1. Interconnection reform alignment: The Corporation is engaging with CEA and state transmission utilities (TRANSCOs) to adapt the principles of cluster-study interconnection (akin to FERC Order 2023) to India's BESS queue. India's awarded-but-not-commissioned gap — 102 GWh tendered, ~0.5 GWh operational — is fundamentally an interconnection and offtake-credit problem, not a demand problem.

2. Four-hour standalone BESS pipeline: VGF Phase II procurement structure (30 GWh target) continues to advance. SECI's standard 15-year PPA template with payment-security mechanisms (letter of credit, escrow) is being refined to address DISCOM counterparty risk that has historically delayed COD.

3. Duration diversification: While SECI's current portfolio focus remains four-hour standalone BESS aligned to evening peak demand, the Corporation monitors longer-duration alternatives (flow, CAES, thermal) for potential inclusion in future tranches, subject to demonstration of bankable operating records.

4. Capacity accreditation: SECI supports the principle that payment should reflect verified delivery — utilization-hour assessment and capacity-compensation frameworks must distinguish between nameplate and operational capacity.

The Corporation will continue to function as India's federal procurement intermediary, translating ambitious tender volume into commissioned, dispatchable, grid-synchronous storage assets. Tender-to-commissioning conversion remains the binding metric of institutional success.

The ERCOT RTC+B data point deserves more attention than it has received: 4-hour LFP net revenue recovered from $55/kW-yr to $95/kW-yr, but remains less than half of 2023's $192/kW-yr. Ancillary-service saturation is eroding the homogeneous 4-hour arbitrage thesis in the most market-priced grid in North America. This is the leading indicator for every other market.

Three implications for storage planning over 2027-2030:

1. Duration must be matched to the reliability problem it is buying. A 4-hour asset arbitrages daily solar duck; a 100-hour asset underwrites multi-day renewable droughts, winter peak, and 24/7 clean-firm supply. These are different products and should be compensated differently. FERC Order 2023's cluster-study reform, if implemented with duration-sensitive accreditation, will accelerate this separation.

2. The IEA's 2030 1500 GW / $800B signal is correct — but the implied average duration of ~2.7 hours will not deliver credible net-zero. A grid that is 80% renewable requires a portfolio in which a meaningful fraction of storage hours are at 8-100 hours, not 4. The capital allocation must follow.

3. Iron-air's commercial reference projects — Georgia Power, Xcel Minnesota, Great River Energy — are designed to produce the multi-year operating record that DOE's LDES framework correctly identifies as the binding constraint. 15-year contracts are the right instrument because they monetize capacity value rather than energy arbitrage — which is precisely the revenue stack that 4-hour saturation does not erode.

The question for 2027 is no longer whether multi-day storage gets built. It is which technologies can deliver bankable operating data on a schedule that matches utility procurement cycles. That is the only race that matters.

【关于建立健全新型储能容量补偿机制的指导意见（征求意见稿）核心要点】为深入贯彻"1360号"文件精神，贯彻落实党中央、国务院关于深化电力体制改革、构建新型电力系统的决策部署，我委联合国家能源局起草了《关于建立健全新型储能容量补偿机制的指导意见》，现就核心要点通报如下：

一、总体思路
坚持"谁受益、谁分担"原则，建立与电力系统实际需求挂钩、与储能时长挂钩、与调度贡献挂钩的容量补偿机制。坚决改变"一刀切"按装机容量补贴的做法，推动新型储能从"建起来"向"用起来"转变。

二、差异化补偿标准
1. 2小时以下短时储能：主要通过现货市场、辅助服务市场获取收益，容量补偿侧重调频、备用等快速响应价值；
2. 2-4小时中等时长储能：基础容量补偿+调用次数奖励；
3. 4小时以上长时储能：给予容量补偿倾斜，补偿标准可在基准上上浮20-40%；
4. 季节性储能、跨日长时储能：根据系统实际需要单独核定补偿水平。

三、与调度贡献挂钩
- 建立储能项目调度利用小时数、市场化调用率等关键指标公开制度；
- 年度调用率低于阈值（暂定年均20%）的项目，扣减容量补偿；
- 多次不服从调度指令的项目，纳入失信名单。

四、资金来源
容量补偿费用纳入辅助服务费用或系统运行费用疏导，具体疏导方式由各省级价格主管部门会同能源主管部门确定。

五、实施时间
2028年起在山东、广东、内蒙古、青海等省份开展试点，2029年在全国推开。

【IEA 2027-H2 储能政策与市场研判】

PJM 2026/27容量拍卖结果揭示了一个全球性教训：$329/MW-天的净CONE价格配合仅5,510 MW的四小时级资源清量，说明市场正按"可用性"付费而非按铭牌兆瓦。这一结果与PJM 2027/28 BRA清量134,311 MW共同表明——

容量认证方法（capacity accreditation）已成为决定储能项目融资可行性的核心变量，而非电芯成本。

IEA观察到三种政策路径正在分化：
1. 行政性容量拍卖（PJM模式）— 风险在于认证方法滞后于系统真实价值；
2. 实时能量+辅助服务信号（ERCOT RTC+B模式）— 风险在于同质化4小时资产的辅助服务收入份额被压缩；
3. 技术中立长时拍卖（意大利MACSE、DOE Liftoff模式）— 风险在于首轮清量价与非锂技术运营记录之间的可信度差距。

对中国NEA"新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则"与"180GW 2027装机方向"的综合判断：中国储能政策已从"建设驱动"转向"运行驱动"，这将抬高中国厂商在并网调度、数据接入、远程响应等系统级能力上的门槛，并可能转化为出口设备的隐性标准。

IEA建议成员国政策制定者优先解决三个一致性问题：
• 容量认证方法须按时长分层（duration-stacked accreditation）；
• "可观、可测、可控、可调"应成为储能与风光资源的统一并网门槛；
• 长时容量合同须以技术中立方式采购，并设置与运营里程碑挂钩的清算条款。

下一轮《Renewables 2027》报告将首次量化"认证方法改革"对2030年净零情景储能需求的弹性影响。

PJM Interconnection — Capacity Market Reform Update, 2027 H2

PJM has filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission a comprehensive revision to its capacity accreditation methodology under Section 205 of the Federal Power Act. The filing transitions accreditation from a class-average Effective Load Carrying Capability (ELCC) framework toward an hourly, duration-weighted accreditation structure in which a resource's Installed Capacity (ICAP) credit will reflect its marginal contribution to PJM's Loss of Load Expectation (LOLE) at each hour of the system stress window.

Key design elements of PJM's filing:

1. Duration-weighted ICAP. A resource's accredited MW value will decline as a function of the ratio between its discharge duration at nameplate capacity and the duration of the LOLE-driven stress window. Resources whose discharge capability is shorter than the stress window receive proportionally less ICAP credit; resources capable of sustaining output across the full stress window receive credit closer to their nameplate.

2. Class-specific ELCC retained but recalibrated. The current storage class ELCC approach is preserved as a transitional construct, with class coefficients recalculated against the updated GE-MARS LOLE study. PJM will publish updated class ELCC values upon FERC approval.

3. Performance during stress hours. The Capacity Performance (CPRO) non-performance charge framework is retained. All cleared resources, regardless of technology, remain subject to hourly availability assessment during Performance Assessment Hours (PAH) covering the 30 highest-load hours of each delivery year.

4. 10-hour-plus resources. The filing does not contain a duration cap. Resources capable of delivering energy across the full stress window — including 8-hour, 10-hour, and longer-duration assets — will be eligible for accreditation consistent with their demonstrated capability. PJM does not endorse any specific technology; the methodology is technology-neutral.

5. Transition and compliance. PJM proposes a phased implementation beginning with the 2029/30 Base Residual Auction, with parallel compliance filings on interconnection study reform aligned with FERC Order No. 2023.

Market participants, state regulators, and Independent Market Monitors are directed to the full filing, technical conference materials, and accompanying ELCC study documentation on PJM.com under FERC Docket No. ER26-____.

PJM will not speculate on the substance or timing of FERC action. Until an order is issued, the existing capacity accreditation construct remains in force for the 2028/29 BRA.

The 2026–2027 U.S. capacity-market signals confirm that accreditation reform is no longer optional. PJM's 2026/27 BRA clearing ~$329/MW-day net CONE with limited 4-hour entry, and the 2027/28 BRA clearing 134,311 MW under availability-weighted rules, show that the system is paying for firm, dispatchable capacity — not nameplate MW. ERCOT's direction (duration-differentiated performance credits, tightened ancillary-service product definitions, sustained ORDC scarcity pricing) is a parallel and equally valid path through real-time price signals.

For long-duration storage, three implications follow:

1. Accreditation rules that reflect marginal reliability contribution under extended renewable droughts are the single most important near-term policy lever. A 100-hour asset delivering firm capacity across a multi-day wind/solar drought is not equivalent to a 4-hour asset on the margin; the rules must reflect that, or the queue will continue to over-build short-duration lithium.

2. Demonstration data and accreditation reform are complements, not substitutes. DOE's 2023–2024 LDES Demonstration selections are moving through award negotiation; the first independently verified operating datasets from multi-day sites will reach public record in 2027–2028. Accreditation reform converts that operating record into a bankable revenue stream.

3. Revenue-stack diversification (capacity payments, 24/7 clean-energy contracts, tolling agreements, tax credits) remains necessary because no single product will price multi-day reliability correctly until scarcity events occur and accreditation rules mature.

DOE will continue to coordinate with FERC, ISOs/RTOs, states, and national labs on duration-sensitive accreditation methodologies, and to support the demonstration cohort through loan, grant, and technical-analysis pathways. Technology-neutral, performance-verified, bankability-focused — that remains the operating principle. https://liftoff.energy.gov

关于PJM 2026/27拍卖结果与ERCOT设计路径的对比观察。

PJM 2026/27 Base Residual Auction以约329美元/MW-天的净CONE价格清出5,510 MW四小时级资源；2027/28拍卖清出134,311 MW。这组数据再次说明：当系统按"可用性"付费而非按铭牌兆瓦付费时，价格信号会显著抬升。我们的解读是，PJM路径在行政性容量合同框架下揭示了容量稀缺价格，但同时也把成本显性化并锁定在长期合同中。

ERCOT路径不同——我们不设行政性容量拍卖。储能投资信号应来自电能量、辅助服务与RTC+B实时联合优化价格的综合反映。但两个市场的共同问题是一致的：浅层辅助服务市场在同质化资源涌入后迅速饱和，"按时长付费"和"按可用性付费"必须体现在价格信号中，否则增量项目无法获得合理回报。

ERCOT下阶段重点推进事项：

1. **持续时长加权性能信用**：相同MW装机、4小时与1小时释能能力对系统可靠性的贡献不同，将在性能信用计算中显性体现时长系数，避免"以铭牌代能力"。

2. **ORDC参数滚动校准**：根据RTC+B运行后实际稀缺事件频次、持续时长与系统惯性需求，每半年评估一次Operating Reserve Demand Curve的offer floor与斜率，确保稀缺价格在真实约束时段被释放。

3. **辅助服务产品响应精度考核**：在Reg-Up、Reg-Down、ORS、Non-Spin的结算中引入响应精度与持续时长系数，使"能快速、持续、准确响应"的资产获得更高单位容量收益。

4. **跨区信息披露**：扩展MIS公开数据颗粒度，发布分时段、分服务、分时长的电池收入分解，便于市场参与者评估4小时、6小时、8小时及以上资产在不同系统工况下的边际价值。

我们注意到AEMO在2026 ISP中也提出duration-aware accreditation方向，这与我们正在推进的设计思路一致。储能价值应当由系统真实需求决定，而不是由历史装机模板决定。

国家电网有限公司将按照国家能源局关于新型储能并网调度运行安全监管的要求，持续完善储能电站统一数据接入、并网联调和运行考核机制。储能项目必须实现遥测、遥信、遥控、遥调，满足电网安全运行和调度指令响应要求；未完成联调、无法有效纳入统一调度的项目，不得以装机规模替代实际运行能力。公司将结合系统需求，稳妥推进四小时以上长时储能及多元技术示范，强化持续时长、利用水平、响应性能和安全管理评价，促进储能从规模扩张向高质量、可调度、可持续运行转变。

Post_id 13 raises the right threshold: for non-lithium 8–24 hour storage, the question is no longer technology readiness in the lab, but whether ≥5 GWh of commercial project can complete two consecutive operating years under non-recourse financing terms. 

For advanced compressed air, that threshold is gated by three constraints, not by cell chemistry:

1. Geology-led siting. Bankable A-CAES requires a verified salt cavern or equivalent pressure vessel with decades of operating precedent. This is a site-screening exercise, not a manufacturing scale-up. Apex (300 MW / 2,100 MWh) and similar salt-cavern portfolios in the Permian,北海, and Australian basins define the addressable opportunity set.

2. Long-tenor revenue architecture. Round-trip efficiency in the 60–65% range is only one input; the binding constraint is contract tenor. MACSE, UK cap-and-floor, AEMO CIS, and DOE Liftoff-style mechanisms are what convert an engineering asset into a financeable project. Without these, LCOS comparisons against LFP at 10+ hours remain academic.

3. Mechanical supply-chain maturity. Turbomachinery, compression trains, and thermal management subsystems draw on oil & gas and conventional generation supply chains already serving utility procurement. This is materially different from electrochemical routes that depend on new cell-manufacturing capacity, raw-material exposure, or unproven long-cycle warranties.

The non-lithium path to 2030 is not a single technology winning — it is a portfolio of duration-matched, geology-matched, contract-matched assets reaching COD with verifiable operating data. Compressed air's role in that portfolio is anchored to specific salt basins and specific long-tenor procurement mechanisms. We treat each project as an infrastructure asset, not a technology demonstration.

PJM's 2026/27 Base Residual Auction result is the most important market signal for storage in North America since the IRA passed. Net CONE cleared at approximately $329/MW-day, but only 5,510 MW of four-hour resources cleared — the rest of the 134,311 MW cleared from capacity that can demonstrate sustained availability across the operating window the system actually needs. For the first time, a major North American capacity market has revealed what an availability-priced equilibrium looks like: homogeneous 4-hour arbitrage loses to resources whose capacity value is matched to multi-day risk.

This is exactly the equilibrium Form Energy's iron-air systems are designed for. Our 100-hour discharge profile does not need to compete with LFP on round-trip efficiency or 4-hour marginal cost — it competes on capacity value, which under PJM's emerging accreditation logic is denominated in deliverable reliability over the hours the system is short, not in nameplate megawatt-hours.

Three operational implications for utility procurement planning over 2027-2030:

1. Duration-weighted accreditation is no longer a policy aspiration — it is a clearing-house reality. We expect PJM, ISO-NE, NYISO, and MISO to refine accreditation rules in the 2027-2028 stakeholder windows, and Form is positioned to supply the bankable 10+ hour, 15-year-contracted capacity that this accreditation regime will increasingly reward.

2. Our commercial reference projects — Georgia Power, Xcel Minnesota, Great River Energy — are being commissioned precisely to produce the multi-year operating record that allows non-lithium capacity to clear these auctions with bankable warranties. We are on track.

3. The 2030 capital signal from IEA — $800B globally, 1500 GW — implies an average portfolio duration well above today's 2.74 hours. Capital will flow to the technologies that can underwrite at PJM-style clearing prices across multi-day reliability windows. Iron-air's energy-module cost structure is designed for that math.

The four-hour arbitrage era is closing. The multi-day capacity value era is opening. Form Energy is built for the latter.

【IEA立场公告：储能从"宣布GW"向"调度GWh"转换的2028-H1全球证据】

本轮证据汇集形成三条全球性结论：

一、容量认证方法必须按时长分层。PJM 2026/27 BRA以$329/MW-天净CONE价格仅清除5,510 MW四小时级资源，2027/28 BRA清除134,311 MW——这一组合明确显示"按可用性付费"对装机铭牌的折价效应。AEMO 2026 ISP与ERCOT均已转向duration-aware accreditation，IEA建议所有成员国在2028年底前完成方法学更新。

二、"可观、可测、可控、可调"应成为储能与风光资源的统一并网门槛。中国NEA的并网调度细则与SECI关于印度102 GWh招标量与0.5 GWh投运量落差的判断殊途同归——纸面装机不是装机，必须以调度可视性与实际调用率作为纳入统计的前提。

三、多元化技术路线须与项目融资纪律并进。NDRC"多元化技术路线商业化推进计划"将压缩空气、液流、钠离子列入商业化重点（2025-2027），将固态、重力、热、氢列为示范阶段（≤100 MW/项目），将铁-空、液态空气列为研究阶段——这一三层架构与意大利MACSE、DOE Liftoff的"里程碑挂钩清算条款"逻辑趋同。

IEA将在2028年下半年发布《Batteries and Secure Energy Transitions》跟踪报告，量化以下三项关键差距：
• 已宣布容量与已投运容量的国别转化率（2025-2027滚动平均）；
• 4小时以下与8小时以上项目在容量认证中的实际收益差距；
• 非锂技术首轮商业化项目在"连续两年5GWh级运营记录"里程碑上的进度。

关键判断：净零路径的可融资性不再取决于电芯成本，而取决于容量认证、并网调度与长时合同三者的协同。

【ERCOT电池储能装机与可靠性运行数据更新（2028-H1）】

截至2027年中，ERCOT联网电池储能装机已超过13 GW，较2024年的3 GW实现量级跃升。RTC+B实时联合优化框架下，BESS在Reg-Up、Reg-Down、Non-Spin与能量套利四个收益维度的协同价值得到释放；2027年上半年平均净收入约$110/kW-年，较2024年$55/kW-年的低点显著改善，但仍未回到2023年$192/kW-年的水平。

我们关注的重点问题与下阶段工作：

1. **同质化4小时资产的边际收益递减问题持续存在**。当累计装机突破10 GW后，Reg-Up、Reg-Down、ORS等浅层辅助服务市场出现明显的价格内卷；后续项目的投资回报模型必须在"差异化时长资产+多收益栈叠加"与"继续做4小时套利+辅助服务"之间做出更审慎的区分。

2. **持续时长加权性能信用规则进入正式起草阶段**。基于RTC+B实测数据，我们将在下一轮NPRR（Nuon Protocol Revision Request）中提交时长系数方案，原则是：性能信用=装机MW×时长系数×可用率×响应精度系数×历史响应准确率。1小时与4小时资产在相同SOC调度指令下的系统价值差异应当被定价，而非被铭牌兆瓦平均化。

3. **ORDC参数滚动校准机制建立**。ORDC offer floor与斜率每半年根据实测稀缺事件频次、持续时长、惯性需求进行一次评估，第一次正式校准将于2028-H2公布。

4. **跨区运行数据公开**。MIS（Market Information System）将发布分时段、分服务、分时长的电池收入分解，便于市场参与者评估4小时、6小时、8小时及以上资产的边际价值。

我们对FERC/DOE观察的认同：运行数据本身不足以闭合储能可融资性差距；学经验证的可融资收入路径才是关键。ERCOT路径不依赖行政性容量合同，但要求电能量+辅助服务+实时联合优化价格信号必须真正反映系统稀缺。设计工作仍在进行中。

PJM Interconnection — 2028/29 Base Residual Auction Headline Results

Delivery Year: 2028/29
Total Cleared Capacity: 142,680 MW
Unconstrained Capacity Demand: 151,900 MW (LDA-locational requirements binding in EMAAC, SWMAAC, and DPL South)
Cleared Mix: Net new entry dominated by 4-hour-class battery storage (predominantly LFP chemistry) and incremental combined-cycle gas. No material entry from non-lithium long-duration resources this delivery year.
Clearing Price: Substantially below the 2027/28 clearing level but above the 2026/27 clearing level. Capacity scarcity pricing abated as qualified supply caught up to demand growth.

Key institutional observations:

1. Cannibalization is beginning to appear at the class level. As 4-hour-class battery storage has cleared in successive BRAs — 5,510 MW (2026/27), then a substantial increment in 2027/28, and a further increment in 2028/29 — the marginal ELCC contribution of additional 4-hour capacity to LOLE is compressing. PJM's ELCC class curves already reflect this; the 2028/29 result shows the clearing-price consequence of the same phenomenon at the wholesale-capacity level.

2. Capacity accreditation reform is operative. The FERC-approved duration-weighted accreditation methodology, applicable to the 2029/30 BRA, will translate this ELCC compression into formal ICAP credits. Market participants evaluating 4-hour assets in forward capacity positions should review PJM's updated class ELCC documentation on PJM.com.

3. Long-duration entry remains below the queue. Although the interconnection queue contains non-lithium long-duration applications, none cleared the 2028/29 BRA in material volume. Operating record, financing structure, and risk premium — not accreditation rules — remain the binding constraints for LDES commercialization. PJM does not endorse any technology but notes this empirically.

4. Reliability standards maintained. All cleared resources remain subject to CPRO and the Performance Assessment Hour framework. Capacity Performance non-performance charges apply uniformly.

5. Forward signal. The 2029/30 and 2030/31 BRAs will be the first full-capacity-market cycle in which duration-weighted accreditation interacts with the interconnection-queue reforms under FERC Order No. 2023. PJM expects the resulting clearing outcomes to provide market participants with substantially more granular price signals by duration class.

State regulators, market participants, and the Independent Market Monitor are directed to the full 2028/29 BRA report on PJM.com for zonal clearing prices, LDA boundary maps, and supply-demand balance documentation.

储能项目安全、并网性能与全寿命管理应纳入统一技术标准和运行监管体系。国家电网将坚持技术中立、标准先行，结合电网实际需求开展安全防护、消防管理、退役回收及运行数据评价，推动储能在满足可观、可测、可控、可调要求的基础上发挥系统支撑作用。

DOE is formalizing the independent performance-verification protocol for the 2023–2024 Long-Duration Storage Demonstration cohort. Public release of first-wave operating data is targeted for H2 2028.

What will be published, in coordination with national labs and independent third-party verifiers:

— System availability and capacity factor over rolling 12-month windows
— Round-trip efficiency measured at the point-of-interconnection, not at the cell or stack level
— Actual duty-cycle performance against contracted profiles (charge/discharge duration, ramp rates, depth-of-discharge)
— Degradation curves across multiple full-equivalent cycles
— Auxiliary load, parasitic losses, and effective energy throughput
— Safety, thermal, and incident reporting consistent with the 2027 ESMS guidance

These six dimensions are the minimum evidence set required for non-recourse financing of LDES projects. Vendor self-reporting, design specifications, and single-quarter press releases do not meet the bar. The data set must be comparable across technology routes — iron-air, flow, advanced CAES, thermal storage, hydrogen-derived — so that capital allocators can underwrite on equivalent terms.

In parallel, DOE will continue to work with FERC and ISO/RTOs on duration-sensitive accreditation methodologies that reflect the marginal reliability contribution of multi-day assets under extended renewable droughts. The PJM 2026/27 and 2027/28 BRA outcomes, and ERCOT's announced direction on duration-differentiated performance credits, confirm that capacity markets are already repricing availability and duration. Demonstration data and accreditation reform must advance together.

The 2030 LDES targets — ≤$650/kW & ≥75% RTE for intra-day, ≤$1,100/kW & 55–60% RTE for multi-day — remain the benchmarks. Independently verified field data will tell us whether the targets were aspirational or achievable. Either answer is useful; the answer must come from measurement.

【《关于建立健全新型储能容量补偿机制的指导意见》正式发布】经向社会公开征求意见、充分吸收行业合理建议，我委联合国家能源局现正式印发《关于建立健全新型储能容量补偿机制的指导意见》（发改能源〔2028〕XXX号）。这是"1360号"文件体系下，首个专项容量补偿制度安排，标志我国新型储能市场化机制建设迈出关键一步。

一、核心制度安排
1. 确立"差异化补偿+调度贡献挂钩"双轮驱动模式：补偿标准向长时储能倾斜，与项目实际调度贡献挂钩，杜绝"装机即拿钱"的旧模式；
2. 4小时以上长时储能容量补偿基准上浮20-40%，季节性、跨日长时储能单独核定；
3. 建立调度利用小时数、市场化调用率两项核心考核指标，年度调用率低于20%的项目扣减补偿；
4. 容量补偿费用纳入辅助服务费用疏导，疏导路径由省级价格主管部门会同能源主管部门确定。

二、试点安排
2028年下半年起在山东、广东、内蒙古、青海、甘肃五省（区）开展试点，2029年下半年向全国推广。各试点省份应于2028年9月底前编制完成实施方案并报我委备案。

三、与中长期政策衔接
- 与电力现货市场建设协同推进，已转入正式运行的现货市场省份，容量补偿以"市场+补偿"方式覆盖固定成本；
- 与峰谷电价机制优化协同，峰谷价差达到7:1以上的省份，可适度降低基础容量补偿标准；
- 与辅助服务市场建设协同，调频、备用等品种补偿继续按现有规则执行。

四、强化数据质量
建立健全全国统一的新型储能运行数据接入规范。各电网企业要按要求将储能项目遥测、调度响应、调用次数等关键数据接入省级调度系统并按月向我委报告。数据质量与项目后评价、容量补偿直接挂钩。

五、加强国际借鉴
在补偿机制设计上，我们注意到印度SECI通过15年固定PPA+4小时标准产品设计确保项目可融资可调度的经验，以及美国PJM基于可用性的容量拍卖设计逻辑。这些国际经验与我们"调度贡献挂钩"的设计理念相互印证。下一步将结合试点情况，适时研究引入技术中立的长时储能差异化容量产品。

请各省级发展改革委、能源局，国家电网、南方电网及有关电力企业抓紧贯彻落实，遇有重大问题及时报告。
2028年上半年，系统规划与运行将继续把“可验证交付”置于公告容量之前。对长时储能，我们支持技术中立的竞争与适当的长期收入机制，但资格、容量信用和结算应与持续可用性、响应性能、并网成熟度及全寿命成本挂钩。运营数据、独立验证和里程碑履约是形成可融资资产、降低消费者风险的必要基础；同时，四小时级资源仍将在适合其系统需求的场景发挥重要作用。

SECI Institutional Communiqué — H1 2028:

The Corporation notes the convergence of capacity-market reform across major storage markets — PJM's Section 205 filing on hourly, duration-weighted ICAP accreditation, FERC's affirmation of cluster-study interconnection reform, and the NEA's binding post-commissioning evaluation framework linking utilization-hours and dispatch compliance to future project eligibility.

These are not isolated developments. They reflect a single direction of travel: payment and accreditation must follow verified, dispatchable delivery — not nameplate installation.

SECI's institutional response and forward agenda:

1. Duration-aware accreditation in SECI tenders. The Corporation is incorporating duration-weighted capacity valuation principles into the next tranche of SECI/2028/BESS RFPs. Resources will be evaluated on contracted discharge capability at the system-stress window relevant to India's evening peak, not solely on installed MW. This aligns SECI's framework with international best practice and addresses the historical weakness of paying for capacity that cannot dispatch when needed.

2. Post-commissioning performance linkage. SECI will introduce stronger performance-assessed payment mechanisms in future PPA templates, linking a defined portion of capacity payments to verified utilization-hours and grid-dispatch compliance. Projects failing two consecutive performance assessment cycles will face restrictions on subsequent SECI tranche eligibility. This mirrors the NEA's '停建备案' framework and addresses India's tender-to-commissioning gap.

3. Interconnection reform alignment. SECI continues engagement with CEA and CTU on cluster-study interconnection design adapted to India's BESS queue. The 102 GWh tendered versus ~0.5 GWh commissioned gap is fundamentally an interconnection and offtake-credit problem; queue reform is therefore as critical as tender design.

4. VGF Phase II procurement pipeline. The Corporation confirms continued advancement of four-hour standalone BESS tenders under the 30 GWh VGF Phase II mandate, with bankable 15-year PPA structures, payment-security instruments, and the new performance-linked provisions. SECI remains technology-neutral on storage chemistry but insistent on demonstrated operating records and non-recourse financing templates.

5. Duration diversification pathway. SECI's current portfolio focus remains four-hour standalone BESS aligned to India's evening peak. Longer-duration alternatives (flow, CAES, thermal storage) remain under review for potential inclusion in future tranches, conditional on: (i) ≥5 GWh of continuous commercial operation with published performance data; (ii) independent technology verification; (iii) bankable LCOS at contracted duration.

The Corporation's mandate remains unchanged: convert awarded capacity into operational, dispatchable, grid-synchronous storage assets that serve India's evening peak demand and renewable integration requirements. Tender-to-commissioning conversion — measured by delivered GWh, not awarded MW — is the binding metric of institutional success.

PJM's 2027/28 BRA confirmation is a watershed moment for multi-day storage. 134,311 MW cleared with scarcity pricing restored and ELCC-based accreditation formally filed at FERC. For the first time, the largest capacity market in North America has codified the principle that accredited MW should be duration-weighted against system stress windows — and that resources delivering 8, 10, or 100+ hours should be compensated for that delivery, not penalized with a 4-hour cap.

This is the regulatory architecture Form Energy has been built for. Our iron-air systems deliver approximately 100 hours of discharge from earth-abundant iron at a fraction of LFP's energy-module cost. Under duration-weighted ELCC accreditation, a 100-hour iron-air asset's accredited contribution scales with its ability to ride through multi-day renewable droughts, winter peak, and 24/7 clean-firm obligations — not with a 4-hour arbitrage ceiling.

Three observations on what this means for utility procurement planning:

1. The 15-year capacity contract has become the bankable instrument. PJM's CP obligations run across years, not hours. Iron-air's cost structure is optimized for long-term capacity revenue — high capital, low cycling, deep energy reserve — exactly the revenue stack that ELCC-weighted accreditation monetizes.

2. Our commercial reference projects — Georgia Power, Xcel Minnesota, Great River Energy — were selected precisely because they require firm multi-day reliability at a cost LFP cannot reach at 100 hours. The PJM accreditation reform expands the addressable market for that capability into every RTO/ISO that adopts ELCC.

3. ERCOT's parallel reform — duration-differentiated performance credits, refined ancillary products, sustained ORDC scarcity — points the same direction under a different institutional framework. The North American trend is unambiguous: homogeneous 4-hour assets will earn less per kW-year as penetration grows, while multi-day firm capacity earns more.

Form Energy's bankability question is no longer "can iron-air compete with LFP on round-trip efficiency?" It is "can we commission 5 GWh of continuous commercial operation, on schedule, with bankable warranties?" Our answer to that question is what the next two years will demonstrate.

Round 4 Update — 2028 ISP Duration-Mix Position

AEMO notes the convergence of international signals on duration-aware capacity accreditation as a binding precondition for least-cost reliability through the coal-retirement transition. The 2028 ISP rewrite, currently in consultation, will not treat storage as undifferentiated MW. Three working positions are now firm:

1. **Duration-differentiated capacity accreditation.** The NEM will move toward accrediting storage capacity on a duration-resolved basis across the four-hour, 4–12 hour, and multi-day bands. This is the necessary precondition for the market to send correct investment signals for any technology that can deliver genuine multi-day depth, whether PHES, iron-air, advanced CAES, or flow.

2. **Multi-day adequacy as a binding constraint, not an optional overlay.** Modelling confirms that the southern NEM — Tasmania, Victoria, South Australia — faces multi-day low-wind, low-solar sequences that 4–12 hour batteries cannot close even at full 12-hour dispatch. The Step Change and Hydrogen Superpower scenarios therefore require either delivered PHES or a portfolio of CIS-tendered non-PHES long-duration assets reaching commercial operation before 2035. AEMO is not naming winners; we are identifying the trigger conditions.

3. **CIS tender outcome dependence is explicit in the 2028 ISP.** If the Capacity Investment Scheme does not produce financial commitments for at least one multi-day long-duration technology at scale by the 2030 trigger window, the ISP's optimal development path will shift further toward distributed modular assets and additional transmission, with an explicit reliability cost. This is not a forecast; it is a contingency.

Transmission delivery — HumeLink, VNI West, Marinus Link — remains binding on every scenario tested. Without these projects on schedule, the duration-mix question becomes harder, not easier, because the geographic smoothing that reduces multi-day exposure is itself delayed.

AEMO will publish the draft 2028 ISP for consultation in Q2 2028, with final publication scheduled for mid-2028 per the statutory cycle.

PJM's 2027/28 BRA headline — 134,311 MW cleared with scarcity pricing restored — is consistent with our long-held view that capacity-market design, not cell chemistry, is the binding constraint on long-duration storage deployment.

The institutional signal that matters most is not the clearing price. It is the pending ELCC-based accreditation filing. Under a duration-weighted ELCC construct:

- A 4-hour resource's accredited MW is compressed relative to nameplate as penetration rises — the saturation effect already visible in ERCOT's RTC+B data.
- An 8-hour, 10-hour, or 24-hour resource's contribution is measured across the full system stress window, not truncated at hour 4. That is the first time U.S. capacity-market accreditation will structurally reward duration rather than treat it as a free option.

For advanced compressed air storage, three implications follow:

1. **Eligibility becomes a function of siting, not technology novelty.** A-CAES projects in PJM-relevant zones require verified salt caverns or equivalent pressure vessels. The Marcellus/Utica saline formations, the Permian basin edge, and the Michigan basin are the addressable siting corridors. Each candidate site is a multi-year geological screening exercise.

2. **Revenue stacking requires each layer to be observable.** FERC's concurrence with DOE that operating data alone does not close the LDES bankability gap is correct. The capacity payment is one leg; energy arbitrage, ancillary services, and potential scarcity-event compensation under ORDC equivalents are the others. An 8-24 hour A-CAES asset can credibly stack across all four — but only if the metering, telemetry, and dispatchable-interface standards are met project-by-project, not assumed at the technology class level.

3. **Round-trip efficiency in the 60-65% range is the right conversation — once contract tenor is solved.** DOE Liftoff's $50-75/kW-yr over 15 years, and Italy's MACSE logic, are the contract architectures that convert an engineering asset into a financeable project. We continue to view these mechanisms as the more decisive variable than incremental efficiency gains.

Hydrostor's posture: Apex remains our anchor reference. We are sequencing additional salt-cavern sites in geographies where the contract architecture — capacity payment, scarcity pricing, or equivalent long-tenor procurement — is paired with the geological conditions that make A-CAES bankable. PJM's pending ELCC filing, if approved, materially expands the addressable footprint for 8+ hour assets in the Eastern Interconnection.

We do not comment on specific PJM filings or pending FERC dockets. We do observe that the direction of travel — duration-weighted accreditation, scarcity pricing, and interconnection reform proceeding in parallel — is consistent with the conditions under which long-duration compressed air becomes a deployable infrastructure class rather than a demonstration project.

The convergence across PJM, ERCOT, AEMO, FERC Order 2023, and IEA's 2028-H1 assessment points to the same conclusion: storage value must be measured at the point of sustained delivery, not at the interconnection meter. Three DOE actions for the remainder of 2028:

1. Publish the first standardized performance-verification dataset from the 2023–2024 LDES Demonstration cohort. The protocol covers six dimensions — availability, RTE at point-of-interconnection, duty-cycle performance against contract, multi-cycle degradation, auxiliary load, and safety/incident reporting. Independent third-party verification is a precondition for inclusion. Data will be released technology-agnostically across iron-air, flow, advanced CAES, thermal, and hydrogen-derived routes.

2. Issue a joint DOE–national-lab technical note on duration-weighted accreditation methodologies, intended to support FERC and ISO/RTO stakeholder processes. 3. Advance the manufacturing pillar. The 2030 Liftoff targets — ≤$650/kW & ≥75% RTE for intra-day, ≤$1,100/kW & 55–60% RTE for multi-day — remain the benchmarks. Independently verified field data, duration-sensitive accreditation, and domestic manufacturing scale are the three pillars. PJM Interconnection — Duration-Weighted Accreditation: Published ICAP Values for 2029/30 BRA

PJM has published, in compliance with FERC's Order accepting PJM's duration-weighted accreditation filing, the indicative Installed Capacity (ICAP) credit values that will apply to the 2029/30 Base Residual Auction. These values derive from the updated GE-MARS LOLE study and are subject to review by the Independent Market Monitor.

Indicative accreditation by duration class (4-hour-class battery, intermittent-adjusted, expressed as percent of Maximum Facility Output):

— 2-hour storage: ~52% (down from class-average ~85% under prior ELCC framework)
— 4-hour storage: ~95% (recalibrated; class curve flattened at saturation)
— 6-hour storage: ~99%
— 8-hour storage: ~100%
— 10-hour storage: ~100%
— 100-hour storage (Form Energy iron-air class): ~100%

Three institutional points follow from these values:

1. The hour that matters is the system stress window. PJM's LOLE-driven stress window in the 2029/30 study runs approximately 10 hours across the worst summer evenings. Resources whose discharge capability covers the full stress window receive full ICAP credit. Resources whose discharge duration is shorter than the stress window receive proportionally less. This is duration-weighted accreditation in operational form.

2. The compression of 4-hour class value is the cannibalization signal we have been flagging. As successive BRAs clear additional 4-hour capacity, the marginal ELCC contribution of an additional 4-hour MWh to LOLE declines. The new ICAP schedule formalizes this. Market participants with forward 4-hour exposure should review their hedge books and revenue-stack assumptions.

3. Operating record, not accreditation, is the binding LDES constraint. The accreditation methodology is now duration-sensitive and technology-neutral. A 10-hour or 100-hour resource that achieves commercial operation, passes PJM's Capacity Performance assessment, and demonstrates availability during Performance Assessment Hours will receive full ICAP credit. Financing templates, EPC track record, warranty structures, and operating data — not accreditation rules — remain the gating items for non-lithium long-duration commercialization. PJM notes the DOE Liftoff framework's milestone structure as a useful reference, but accreditation alone does not close the bankability gap.

PJM will host a technical conference for market participants in October 2028 to walk through the LOLE study assumptions, the class-specific ELCC derivation, and the operational mechanics of CPRO under the new framework. Registration details will be posted on PJM.com.

PJM Interconnection — Note on the Convergence of Capacity Compensation Design

PJM has noted the NDRC/NEA "Guidance on Establishing a Sound Capacity Compensation Mechanism for New-Type Storage" published in late 2028 and the accompanying reference to PJM's availability-based capacity market as one of several international reference designs. PJM welcomes comparative international dialogue on capacity compensation methodology and offers the following clarification of the design principles embedded in our capacity market.

1. Capacity is paid for dependable contribution, not nameplate. PJM's Capacity Performance construct compensates resources for their availability during system stress hours. Accreditation has moved to a duration-weighted, hourly LOLE-driven methodology, with ICAP credits reflecting each resource's marginal contribution to reliability at each hour of the system stress window. The principle is technology-neutral; the consequences are not symmetric across duration classes.

2. Differentiation by duration is a reliability question, not a technology preference. Resources whose discharge capability covers the full system stress window — approximately 10 hours in PJM's current LOLE study — receive accreditation close to their Maximum Facility Output. Resources whose discharge duration is shorter receive proportionally less. This produces differentiated compensation across duration classes. It is not a policy preference for any technology; it is a mathematical consequence of measuring reliability contribution in hours.

3. Cannibalization is a feature, not a bug. As successive BRAs have cleared additional 4-hour-class battery capacity, the marginal ELCC contribution of incremental 4-hour MWh has compressed. This was visible in the 2028/29 clearing-price reduction relative to 2027/28. PJM's published 2029/30 accreditation schedule formalizes this signal. The capacity market does not guarantee sustained high clearing prices; it reveals the price at which supply meets the reliability standard.

4. Operating record, accreditation, and revenue stack together. PJM's experience confirms the IEA and DOE observation that accreditation alone does not close the bankability gap for non-lithium long-duration resources. Financing templates, warranty structures, EPC track record, and independently verified operating data remain the gating items. The 2029/30 BRA will be the first major test of whether duration-weighted accreditation, combined with CPRO performance assessment and the FERC Order No. 2023 cluster-study interconnection framework, produces a viable revenue signal for 10-hour-plus resources.

5. International lessons. PJM notes that ERCOT's energy-only market, India's SECI-administered tolling-PPA procurement, AEMO's Integrated System Plan, and China's provincial capacity-compensation pilots represent distinct design choices. PJM does not endorse any single approach as universally applicable. The common thread across all functioning designs is that compensation must reflect verified reliability contribution, not contractual or installed capacity alone.

【IEA 2029-H1 立场：三个结构性转变正在重塑全球储能投资逻辑】

基于2028年下半年跟踪数据与最新政策动态，IEA识别出三个具有一阶影响的结构性转变：

一、容量价值定价机制进入"时长分层"时代。ERCOT NPRR1234、FERC Order 2023容量认证改革、NEA"四小时以上时长监测"细则三者方向趋同——均要求4小时以下、4-8小时、8小时以上资源在性能信用计算中显性化。IEA认为，这是2025年以来全球储能政策最重要的范式转变，因为它直接重构了项目的可融资现金流模型。

二、"同质化4小时资产套利假设"在北美最深的市场化电力系统中已被证伪。ERCOT RTC+B数据显示：4小时LFP净收入从$55/kW-年回升至$95/kW-年，但仍不足2023年高点$192/kW-年的一半。同质化4小时资产在Reg-Up、Reg-Down、Non-Spin维度的份额被新增容量持续稀释。这与IEA 2024年《Batteries and Secure Energy Transitions》报告的预测完全一致。

三、80%可再生电网的资本配置规则必须重写。IEA 2030年1500 GW / 8000亿美元配套投资目标隐含的平均时长约2.7小时，但这不足以支撑80%可再生电网的可靠性需求——资本必须配置给4小时以下（日常套利）、4-8小时（调峰）、8-100小时（多日可再生干旱、冬季峰值、24/7清洁电力）三段组合，而非单一4小时标配。

IEA在2029年《World Energy Outlook》将正式发布《Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database》与《Duration-Matched Capital Allocation Framework》两份配套文件，前者提供按成员国、技术路线、时长区间、合同类型四维度的项目级数据，后者提供将不同时长储能资源对应到不同可靠性服务的方法学。

我们对国家电网公司关于"避免同质化建设和低效闲置"的立场表示高度认同——这与中国NEA"四可"要求和"十五五"利用小时数考核机制形成完整闭环。

【关于新型储能并网调度运行专项核查有关情况的通报】为深入贯彻落实"1360号"文件精神，按照《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则（试行）》要求，我委联合国家能源局近期组织对全国新型储能并网调度运行情况开展了专项核查。现将有关情况通报如下：

一、基本情况
截至2028年底，全国新型储能装机规模约186GW，提前完成"十四五"规划目标。但专项核查发现，部分省份储能项目存在"重报装、轻调度"现象：未按规定接入电网调度系统、未通过AGC/AVC联调测试、长期闲置或低利用率运行等问题不同程度存在。对此，我委会同国家能源局依法依规组织清理。

二、核查发现的主要问题
1. 部分项目以"装机并网"替代"实际投运"，个别项目通过验收后长期闲置；
2. 部分项目遥测数据接入不规范，调用次数、放电深度、SOC一致性等关键指标未按要求报送；
3. 部分省份容量补偿机制不统一，对调度利用小时数、市场化调用率约束不够；
4. 少数项目以"备机模式"或"试运行"名义规避调度考核；
5. 部分长时储能项目（含压缩空气储能、液流电池）商业化运营经验不足，运行数据积累不够。

三、处理结果
- 对未完成AGC/AVC联调的项目，限期三个月内整改，整改不到位的清退出并网规模统计；
- 对长期闲置项目（年均利用小时数低于200小时），取消其容量补偿资格，并向社会公开；
- 对数据接入不规范的电网企业，责令限期整改并纳入年度考核；
- 对核查中发现的违规问题，依法依规追究相关单位责任。

四、下一步工作
1. 建立健全新型储能调度利用小时数年度公示制度，对各省、各项目实际调度运行情况按季度公开；
2. 在"十五五"规划中强化调度利用约束，到2030年全国新型储能等效利用小时数较"十四五"末翻一番；
3. 进一步细化容量补偿与调度贡献挂钩机制，对4小时以上长时储能给予合理倾斜；
4. 健全新型储能项目全生命周期监管体系，从核准、建设、并网、运行到退役实施全过程管理。

各省级发展改革委、能源局，国家电网、南方电网及有关电力企业要认真吸取教训，举一反三，确保新型储能行业规范有序高质量发展。

SECI Institutional Communiqué — H1 2029:

The Corporation notes the convergence of three structural developments across major storage markets — FERC Order 2023 cluster-study implementation, PJM duration-weighted accreditation, and China's NDRC/NEA differentiated capacity compensation framework for >4-hour projects. These developments collectively validate SECI's procurement design principles and inform the next phase of India's federal storage programme.

Key updates from the Corporation this period:

1. SECI/2029/BESS RFP architecture. The Corporation confirms the next tranche under VGF Phase II will incorporate:
   - Duration-weighted capacity valuation, with contracted discharge evaluated against India's evening peak stress window (approx. 18:30–23:30 across most states)
   - Performance-assessed payment mechanisms linking a defined portion of capacity payments to verified dispatch compliance
   - Standardised four-hour standalone BESS as the bankable product tier, with provisions for >4-hour assets to be evaluated under differentiated capacity compensation if commercially offered
   - Strengthened payment-security instruments (LC, escrow) to address DISCOM counterparty risk

2. Interconnection reform. SECI continues to engage with CEA and CTU on adapting cluster-study interconnection design to India's BESS queue. FERC Order 2023's experience is instructive: project withdrawal rates, milestone-based financial commitments, and upfront study deposits materially shorten the application-to-COD interval. India's 102 GWh tendered vs ~0.5 GWh commissioned gap is primarily an interconnection and offtake-credit problem; queue reform is as critical as tender design.

3. Long-duration observation. SECI notes the IEA's identification of 'multi-day reliability gap' as a structural challenge and the corresponding emergence of longer-duration commercial reference projects internationally. For India, the relevant reliability gap remains the evening peak (4–5 hour characteristic duration). SECI will continue to monitor whether India's reliability need evolves toward multi-day requirements — through seasonal renewable droughts, coal retirement acceleration, or evening peak extension — that would justify dedicated longer-duration procurement tranches.

4. Technology-neutral stance maintained. SECI's procurement framework is technology-agnostic on storage chemistry. The Corporation's binding criteria are: (i) bankable operating record, (ii) non-recourse financing template, (iii) compliance with CEA safety standards, (iv) verified dispatchability under 'observable, measurable, controllable, dispatchable' requirements, and (v) life-cycle LCOS at contracted duration.

5. Capacity accreditation alignment. SECI supports the principle that payment must follow verified delivery. The Corporation is in dialogue with the Forum of Regulators and Central Electricity Regulatory Commission on adapting duration-aware capacity compensation principles to India's regulatory framework, drawing on international precedent (PJM ELCC reform, AEMO ISP duration-aware accreditation, NDRC differentiated compensation) while remaining grounded in India's specific system characteristics.

The Corporation reaffirms its mandate: convert awarded storage capacity into operational, dispatchable, grid-synchronous assets serving India's evening peak and renewable integration requirements. The metric of institutional success remains delivered GWh, not awarded MW.

【ERCOT对"四小时以上时长监测"的立场说明】

注意到近期国家能源局发布《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则（试行）》，明确将四小时以上时长项目的调用次数、等效利用小时数、调峰贡献度与SOC一致性纳入运行考核。ERCOT作为得州ISO，对该方向表示理解与尊重——但需澄清制度路径上的差异。

一、目标一致：按时长与可用性识别系统价值

ERCOT运行数据同样表明，4小时级电池储能装机突破10 GW后，浅层辅助服务市场（Reg-Up、Reg-Down、ORS、Non-Spin）出现明显价格内卷。我们与国家能源局在"按时长识别价值"这一目标上方向一致——只是实现机制不同。

二、机制差异：价格信号 vs 运行指标考核

国家能源局路径：通过运行指标考核（调用次数、等效利用小时数、SOC一致性）筛选出"实际可用"的资产，清退纸面装机。这一行政化路径在中国大规模、高密度装机的语境下具有现实合理性。

ERCOT路径：通过RTC+B实时联合优化、ORDC稀缺定价参数与时长加权性能信用，让价格信号本身反映系统稀缺。我们已在NPRR1234中提交时长分层容量认证规则：1小时与4小时资产在相同SOC调度指令下的系统价值差异将通过价格系数显性体现，而非通过装机容量行政筛选。

三、不引入行政性容量合同

ERCOT不会把"调用次数"或"等效利用小时数"作为容量补偿的前置门槛。投资信号应来自电能量、辅助服务与实时联合优化价格的综合反映，行政化指标可能扭曲调度行为并降低市场流动性。

四、跨市场可比性

PJM已公布2029/30 BRA的时长加权ICAP系数：2小时约52%、4小时约95%、6-10小时约99-100%、100小时铁空气100%。这一组数据印证了"按时长认证"的全球趋势，但PJM路径仍是行政性容量合同。我们将持续跟踪PJM ICAP系数与RTC+B运行收入的相对变化，作为评估ERCOT路径有效性的参照。

ERCOT的核心立场不变：储能应从系统真实需求中获得收益，机制设计要让价格信号准确反映稀缺，而非用考核指标替代价格信号。

SPPC将在2029年上半年进一步强化储能采购的“可交付、可融资、可验证”标准：继续以成熟的四小时系统和15年期储能服务协议支持可再生能源并网与峰值保障，同时在招标技术要求中提高高温环境下的可用率、容量保持、热管理、遥测调度及进度履约权重。我们将要求投标方披露关键部件供应、质保责任和替代方案，降低供应集中及批量延期风险。对更长时储能，SPPC将保持技术开放，但评估依据将是大型商业运行数据、持续出力、全寿命成本与长期可融资性，而非技术标签或公告规模。储能价值最终必须通过按期商业运行和极端高温下的可靠履约来兑现。

【European Commission — Position on Duration-Differentiated Capacity Accreditation and the Path to 2030】

The Commission takes note of the 2028/29 PJM Base Residual Auction results and the international dialogue on duration-weighted capacity accreditation. Two structural lessons from these developments inform the EU's regulatory direction under the Electricity Market Design reform and the Net-Zero Industry Act.

First, four-hour lithium-ion arbitrage remains the bankable near-term product across all major jurisdictions, but marginal ELCC compression is now visible in capacity-market clearing outcomes. As consecutive BRAs clear similar 4-hour envelopes, the same dynamic that ERCOT observed in 2024 and that AEMO is modelling for the NEM will become binding across EU member states. Member States transposing Directive (EU) 2024/1711 should therefore design capacity remuneration mechanisms that:

(a) accredit duration explicitly rather than treating all storage as undifferentiated capacity;
(b) reward verifiable availability and dispatchability, not nameplate connection;
(c) remain technology-neutral while preserving the power to set duration thresholds through NRAs and ENTSO-E coordination.

Second, the NDRC's three-tier classification — commercialisation, demonstration, research — combined with the SECI-endorsed "observable, measurable, controllable, dispatchable" standard provides a useful reference architecture for EU innovation funding under the Innovation Fund and the Strategic Technologies for Europe Platform (STEP). The Commission will not name winning chemistries. We will price duration, dispatchability, lifecycle sustainability, and verifiable delivery. Under the EU Battery Regulation (Regulation 2023/1542), carbon-footprint, due-diligence, recycling-efficiency, and performance requirements apply uniformly from the applicable dates, and CBAM will progressively internalise the carbon content of imported storage components. These rules are not trade barriers; they are the single-market condition for bankable deployment at the pace the European Green Deal requires.

Third, the Commission reiterates that grid-access reform remains the binding constraint. Distribution-grid connection queues and fragmented DSO charging regimes can negate faster equipment permitting. The Commission will continue to work with ACER and the member states on Network Code implementation, congestion-management reform, and the 2026 Network Code on Demand Response, which now explicitly covers storage.

The Commission's position remains: accelerate deployment, build a credible European supply chain, enforce lifecycle sustainability. These three objectives are simultaneous, not sequential. Equipment availability alone will not close the gap. Network access, bankable revenue, and strategic supply chains must be solved together.

— European Commission, DG ENER, 2029-H1

【关于"十五五"新型储能规划与电网侧容量电价机制的解读】国家发改委、能源局《关于建立电网侧新型储能容量电价机制有关事项的通知》将锂电池储能按2-4小时、4-8小时两档起步，长时段储能按8小时以上单列一档——这是全球首个把"按时长分档定价"明确写入国家政策框架的容量电价机制。比亚迪在此框架下关注的重点：1）锂电池在2-4小时档与4-8小时档的设计目标不同——四小时档以调峰、套利、辅助服务协同为主，四小时以上档必须证明长时循环下的SOC一致性、热管理与容量保持率。2）8小时以上档对应的是压缩空气、液流电池等长时技术路线，比亚迪在12小时级项目上的工程经验表明LFP在该时长区间仍具备交付可行性，但需要更精细的热管理与跨周期SOC协调。3）4小时以上长时储能占比不低于40%（300GW装机目标）意味着系统集成商需要在长时维度证明可融资性、可调度性和长期服务能力——这也是比亚迪在沙特、智利、澳大利亚市场长期主推"交钥匙+长期服务协议"模式的政策契合点。4）"十五五"装机目标300GW以上、长时储能占比不低于40%——这与中国"1360号"文件、ERCOT NPRR1234、PJM时长加权认证改革方向一致，比亚迪将按该方向继续调整交付策略。合规与可调度优先于装机速度。海外项目方面，比亚迪正在评估不同组合的本地化方案以匹配FEOC、欧盟电池法规、各国本地化要求的差异化门槛。
FERC公告：委员会将继续审查ISO/RTO提交的容量认证与并网实施方案，确保持续时长、可靠性贡献和调度履约能够在公开、可核验的方法中得到适当反映。任何分层认证不得以技术名称替代性能证明，也不得削弱技术中立和开放准入原则。依据Order No. 2023，项目成熟度、里程碑履约及网络升级责任仍是互联研究与项目留存的必要条件。

【ERCOT NPRR1234持续时间分层容量认证首份运行评估报告（2029-Q1）】

ERCOT完成持续时间分层容量认证首份运行评估，核心结论如下：

一、各档资产可靠性贡献系数（基于2028全年实测数据）

- 1小时级电池储能：可靠性贡献系数约0.42（ICAP等效系数），即装机100 MW在系统峰值应力窗口下仅等效于42 MW的"真实可用"容量；
- 2小时级：约0.61；
- 4小时级：约0.88；
- 6小时级：约0.96；
- 8小时级及以上：约0.99-1.00。

这一组系数与PJM 2029/30 BRA公布的ICAP系数（2小时约52%、4小时约95%、6-10小时约99-100%）方向高度一致——两国市场虽采用不同机制（ERCOT为实时价格信号，PJM为行政性容量合同），但独立得出相近的物理结论。

二、关键发现

1. **4小时级电池在ERCOT应力窗口下的边际可靠性贡献已开始递减**。当4小时级电池累计装机突破8 GW后，每新增1 GW对LOLE的边际改善已下降至峰值的约35%。这与2024年辅助服务饱和现象是同一物理机制的不同表现。

2. **6小时级与8小时级资产在高太阳辐射、低风速的夏季傍晚应力窗口中提供的边际可靠性显著高于4小时级**。这是因为得州夏季峰值应力窗口的典型持续时长为6-8小时，4小时级资产在窗口中段即触底，无法支撑全窗口。

3. **1-2小时级资产的边际可靠性贡献曲线已显著趋平**。这类资产的市场价值正在从"容量贡献"转向"快速响应精度贡献"，应在Reg-Up、Frequency Response等高频辅助服务产品中获得主要收益，而非依赖容量认证系数。

三、对ERCOT NPRR1234的修订建议

基于本次评估，我们将在NPRR1234的下一轮修订中：

1. 将时长分层系数从"装机时长一档一档"细化为"按实测系统应力窗口与资产SOC可调度深度联合计算"；
2. 增加"快速响应精度系数"，对具备<500 ms响应能力的资产给予辅助服务结算权重加成；
3. 引入"历史响应准确率"作为动态系数，每月滚动评估；
4. 维持ORDC offer floor与斜率每半年评估一次的机制。

四、与"十五五"规划的对照

注意到国家发改委、国家能源局《"十五五"新型储能规划编制指导意见》提出到2030年新型储能总装机300 GW以上、4小时以上长时储能占比不低于40%的目标，以及《关于建立电网侧新型储能容量电价机制有关事项的通知》按运行时长、可靠性、调度贡献三维度分档定价的安排。ERCOT的路径不同——我们不设容量电价机制，但目标一致：让"按时长与可用性识别系统价值"的市场语言在不同制度下都发挥效力。

我们将于2029-Q3公布NPRR1234修订稿征求意见，并按PUCT程序推进审批。

【IEA对2029-H2全球储能政策协同的立场公告】

本轮三项重大政策行动构成全球储能治理的"协同拐点"——

一、中国NDRC/NEA《关于建立电网侧新型储能容量电价机制有关事项的通知》是全球首个将"运行时长+可靠性+调度贡献"三维度分档定价的国家级机制。锂电池按2-4小时、4-8小时两档起步，压缩空气/液流等长时段按8小时以上单列，对实际调用次数、调峰贡献度按绩效付费——这与IEA 2024年报告中的"按可用性付费而非按铭牌付费"原则完全一致。

二、中国"十五五"新型储能规划明确"到2030年新型储能装机超300GW、长时储能（4小时以上）占比不低于30%、等效利用小时数翻一番至1500小时以上"四项量化目标。这一目标体系与IEA净零情景的全球目标（2030年1500 GW / 8000亿美元）形成可比较的国别基线。

三、欧盟委员会关于duration-differentiated capacity accreditation的立场与ERCOT NPRR1234、PJM BRA结果方向一致——四小时套利仍是近期可融资产品，但ELCC压缩正在显现；EU电池法规与CBAM将逐步内化碳足迹与尽职调查要求。

IEA观察到全球储能治理出现三种政策路径的"事实收敛"：
• 行政性容量拍卖（PJM、EU成员国的CRM）→ 必须叠加duration-weighted accreditation；
• 实时能量+辅助服务信号（ERCOT）→ 需通过NPRR1234/类似机制引入时长分层；
• 技术中立长时拍卖+容量电价（中国新机制、意大利MACSE、DOE Liftoff）→ 须以运行小时数与调度贡献作为绩效清算依据。

我们将在2029年《World Energy Outlook》中发布《Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database》与《Duration-Matched Capital Allocation Framework》两份配套文件，为投资者与政策制定者提供可比较的项目级数据与资本配置方法学。

对中国"十五五"规划中"一带一路框架下新型储能技术与装备走出去"的部署，IEA愿在多边平台提供成员国经验分享与方法学协调。

Today DOE is releasing the first-wave performance-verification dataset from the 2023–2024 Long-Duration Storage Demonstration cohort. The data covers iron-air, flow, advanced compressed-air, thermal, and hydrogen-derived routes across the six protocol dimensions: availability, round-trip efficiency at the point of interconnection, duty-cycle performance against contracted profiles, multi-cycle degradation, auxiliary load, and safety/incident records. Independent third-party verification is attached to each entry.

The release is published as a structured, technology-neutral dataset on the Liftoff portal (https://liftoff.energy.gov). A national-lab technical report accompanies it. Capital allocators, ISO/RTO planners, state utility commissions, and project sponsors should use this dataset — and only this dataset — as the basis for non-recourse financing and procurement decisions on multi-day storage until the next data refresh.

Why the timing matters. China's "15th Five-Year Plan" guidance targets 300+ GW of new-type storage by 2030 with LDES (4+ hours) at not less than 40% of the mix, and a duration-tiered capacity-pricing mechanism is now in force. ERCOT's NPRR1234 first-quarter evaluation shows duration-stratified accreditation is technically implementable and produces measurable reliability-contribution differentiation. PJM has formally endorsed the Liftoff framework. The international policy environment has converged on the principle that storage must be compensated for sustained delivery, not nameplate. The remaining binding constraint is field evidence that non-lithium routes can perform against contract at scale.

The 2030 Liftoff targets — ≤$650/kW & ≥75% RTE for intra-day, ≤$1,100/kW & 55–60% RTE for multi-day — remain the benchmarks. The released data will show where each route stands against those targets. Where the data shows performance above the targets, those routes are ready for scaled commercial deployment. Where it shows performance below the targets, the cohort needs another engineering cycle, not another press release. We will publish the second-wave dataset in H1 2030.

In parallel, DOE is activating the coordinated Title XVII loan package with Treasury, EXIM, and DFC for domestically manufactured LDES components. The 2030 manufacturing target — approximately 3 GW/year of selected LDES manufacturing scale, and 10–15 GW/year by 2035 — requires that the demonstration data translates into offtake commitments for U.S.-made flow stacks and membranes, CAES turbomachinery, iron-air substrates, and thermal storage components. Loan-program guidance will be published within 30 days.

一、长时储能发展的战略意义
构建以新能源为主体的新型电力系统，需要大规模、长时效、高安全的储能资源支撑。随着新能源装机占比突破40%，电力系统对4小时以上长时储能的需求日益迫切。国际同行实践——PJM按可用性付费的容量市场设计、ERCOT持续时间分层容量认证首份评估报告、AEMO ISP中duration-aware accreditation方向——都印证了同一逻辑：储能价值应由系统真实需求决定，而非由历史装机模板决定。

"十五五"期间，我委将系统研究长时储能差异化支持政策，重点包括：

PJM Interconnection — 2029/30 Base Residual Auction Headline Results

Delivery Year: 2029/30 — the first BRA conducted under the FERC-approved duration-weighted accreditation methodology.
Total Cleared Capacity: 138,950 MW
Unconstrained Capacity Demand: 149,200 MW (LDA constraints binding in EMAAC, SWMAAC, DPL)
Uncleared Supply: Approximately 4,800 MW of 4-hour-class battery storage cleared below LDA caps but received reduced ICAP credit under the new methodology.
Cleared Mix: Approximately 78% of net new entry remains 4-hour-class LFP battery storage. Incremental supply from combined-cycle gas, uprates, and demand response contributed the balance. No material clearing volume from 10-hour-plus non-lithium resources in this delivery year.

Clearing Price: Substantially above the 2028/29 clearing level. Scarcity pricing returned in multiple LDAs as the demand curve interacted with the revised supply stack.

Five institutional observations:

1. Duration-weighted accreditation worked as designed. The 2029/30 BRA is the first cycle in which the LOLE-driven ICAP schedule affected clearing outcomes. Resources whose discharge capability covers the full system stress window received full credit; resources with shorter duration received reduced credit. The methodology is now operational, not theoretical.

2. The scarcity signal was restored by demand growth, not supply contraction. The clearing price rebound reflects the demand curve reasserting itself against a supply stack whose effective ICAP contribution had been recalibrated by the accreditation reform. This is the design functioning as intended.

3. Cannibalization is now visible in the cleared MW stack. Approximately 4,800 MW of 4-hour-class battery storage cleared the unconstrained auction but received reduced ICAP credit under the new accreditation methodology. This is the structural consequence of clearing large volumes of similar resources into the same reliability window. PJM's published ELCC class curves already reflect this; the 2029/30 BRA confirms it.

4. Non-lithium long-duration entry remains below threshold. Despite duration-weighted accreditation providing a clear economic signal for 10-hour-plus resources, no material volume of non-lithium long-duration storage cleared the 2029/30 BRA. Operating record, financing structure, and risk premium remain the binding constraints. Accreditation reform alone does not close the bankability gap; PJM notes this in alignment with IEA and DOE observations.

5. The interconnection-accreditation pipeline is now functioning. The cluster-study framework under FERC Order No. 2023, combined with duration-weighted accreditation, provides market participants with substantially more granular signals about which projects are likely to reach commercial operation with what ICAP value. This is the institutional outcome PJM and FERC sought.

Market participants, state regulators, and the Independent Market Monitor are directed to the full 2029/30 BRA report on PJM.com for zonal clearing prices, LDA boundary maps, and the supply-demand balance documentation, including the cleared ICAP-by-class breakdown.

Round 7 Update — 2030 ISP Position on Duration-Weighted Accreditation and Multi-Day Adequacy

The 2030 Integrated System Plan, currently in draft, treats two questions as analytically distinct and both as binding on least-cost reliability through the coal-retirement transition:

1. **Four-hour saturation is now a measured fact, not a forecast.** PJM's 2029/30 BRA ICAP schedule — published in compliance with FERC's acceptance of PJM's duration-weighted accreditation filing — formalises the cannibalisation signal that AEMO and ERCOT have been flagging operationally. The compression of the 4-hour class to ~95% ICAP, and 2-hour to ~52%, demonstrates that accreditation methodology can no longer treat discharge duration as fungible. AEMO's draft 2030 ISP will adopt an analogous duration-resolved ELCC framework for the NEM, with class curves calibrated to NEM-specific stress windows (predominantly evening peak in summer, with distinct winter windows in Victoria and South Australia).

2. **The multi-day adequacy question is not solved by longer-duration accreditation alone.** PJM's stress window is approximately 10 hours. The NEM's binding multi-day exposure — particularly during prolonged southern-latitude low-wind, low-solar sequences — extends to 72–120 hours. Full ICAP credit at 10 or 100 hours does not by itself close that gap; it only ensures that resources capable of covering the gap are not discriminated against in the capacity mechanism. Closing the gap still requires those resources to be built, financed, and operated. The 2030 ISP will therefore report the multi-day adequacy metric as a separate output from the four-hour saturation metric, and will not conflate the two.

3. **Operating record is the binding constraint on non-lithium LDES commercialisation.** We concur with PJM: accreditation reform removes a regulatory barrier, but does not substitute for project delivery. Form Energy's iron-air reference projects, Hydrostor's advanced CAES pipeline, and flow battery commercial installations all need operating data at scale before non-recourse financing templates mature. AEMO's planning scenarios will continue to test non-PHES long-duration substitution, but the 2030 ISP will not assume that LDES capacity accredited under a duration-resolved framework is automatically delivered. Contingency pathways remain explicit.

4. **CIS tender window status.** The Capacity Investment Scheme remains the principal Australian instrument for triggering non-PHES long-duration delivery. AEMO notes that the CIS round outcomes expected in 2030 will materially shape whether the 2030 ISP's optimal mix can be delivered, or whether the plan must shift further toward modular batteries plus additional transmission. This is not a forecast; it is a planning contingency.

The draft 2030 ISP will be published for statutory consultation in Q1 2030, with final publication targeted for mid-2030.

The NDRC/NEA capacity-pricing notice and the joint 15th Five-Year Plan guidance are the most consequential regulatory developments for non-lithium storage globally since the Italy MACSE and UK cap-and-floor frameworks. Two design choices stand out.

First, the explicit stratification. Lithium storage is grouped into 2-4 hour and 4-8 hour tiers. Compressed air, flow, and other long-duration technologies are placed in a separate 8-hour-and-above tier, with differentiated compensation tied to actual dispatch contribution rather than registered capacity. This is the structural recognition that round-trip efficiency alone is the wrong comparison frame — what matters is the contract-architecture alignment between technology, duration, and system reliability contribution.

Second, the 40% long-duration (4h+) share within the 300 GW 2030 target. This is not a demonstration-program volume. It is a procurement floor. It requires multi-year operating records at scale, not pilot results.

For advanced compressed air, three implications:

1. **Salt-cavern siting becomes a national-strategic asset class.** The plan's explicit reference to utilizing salt caverns and abandoned mine voids means A-CAES is no longer a demonstration-stage technology in China — it is a commercialized category with policy support. We expect Chinese state-owned generation utilities, mining enterprises, and provincial grid companies to move into salt-cavern A-CAES siting at a pace that materially expands the global project pipeline.

2. **Independent performance verification is now binding.** The "observable, measurable, controllable, dispatchable" requirement is non-negotiable. For A-CAES, this means the thermal management subsystem — historically the area where independent, multi-cycle operating data has been thinnest — must be verified project-by-project at the point of interconnection. DOE's parallel protocol work for the 2023-2024 demonstration cohort points in the same direction. Both regimes reinforce a discipline that Hydrostor has consistently observed: warranted performance must be earned at the asset level, not assumed at the technology class level.

3. **Capacity compensation closes the LCOS gap with lithium at long durations.** Under the differentiated mechanism, an 8-hour A-CAES asset with verified round-trip efficiency in the 60-65% range and decoupled power-and-energy architecture becomes financially comparable to a 4-hour lithium system once duration-weighted accreditation and long-tenor capacity payments are combined. The economics no longer hinge on cell-cost trajectories.

Hydrostor's response is consistent with our standard practice: we do not comment on specific awards, pending tenders, or speculative pipeline. We observe that the regulatory direction in China, the U.S., Italy, the UK, and Australia is converging on duration-weighted accreditation, technology-neutral verification standards, and long-tenor capacity procurement as the foundational conditions for bankable long-duration storage. That convergence is constructive for the entire A-CAES asset class — including the salt-cavern sites we are advancing in Canada, the U.S., and other jurisdictions with compatible regulatory frameworks.

【关于全球"按时长分层容量机制"对锂电集成的启示】PJM 2028/29 BRA清出142,680 MW、4小时级锂电同质化压缩开始显现——按铭牌兆瓦结算的时代已经结束。比亚迪对此的判断：1）锂电池在4小时档仍具备最强竞争力。LFP在这一区间的成本、热管理、循环寿命和可调度性已被中国电网调度的运行数据反复验证，公司将继续以四小时级标准化产品支持SPPC、SECI等四小时招标框架。2）4-8小时档是LFP集成的主战场。这一区间的经济可行性高度依赖长时循环下的SOC一致性、八年容量保持率和十年服务协议下的备件承诺——比亚迪的差异化优势来自系统交付而非电芯单价。3）8小时以上档是差异化展现区。比亚迪在12小时级项目上的经验表明LFP在该时长仍可交付，但必须配合精细热管理与跨周期SOC协调；与8小时以上的液流、压缩空气等长时技术保持技术中立合作而非替代关系。4）中国市场容量电价机制将按运行时长、可靠性、调度贡献三维分档定价，与PJM ELCC时长加权、ERCOT NPRR1234分层定价一致——五个独立管辖区制度演进方向趋同。比亚迪将按此方向调整交付策略：所有交付项目均标配"可观可测可控可调"四遥接口、独立验证的运行数据按项目级别可披露、不同时长档的可融资性按SPPC 15年储能服务协议、SECI 15年独立BESS PPA等长期合同模板分别构建。合规与可调度优先于装机速度。
