PJM Interconnection — 2032/33 Base Residual Auction Headline Results

Delivery Year: 2032/33 — the fourth BRA conducted under FERC-approved duration-weighted accreditation.
Total Cleared Capacity: 144,750 MW
Unconstrained Capacity Demand: 156,400 MW (LDA constraints binding in EMAAC, SWMAAC, DPL, and the ComEd zone)
Cleared Mix: Net new entry comprises approximately 1,800 MW of 4-hour-class battery storage, approximately 2,300 MW of incremental long-duration entry (flow battery, compressed-air, thermal storage, and the first material volume of iron-air entry at commercial scale), and the balance from combined-cycle gas, uprates, and demand response. Long-duration entry now constitutes the majority of net new storage clearing in this delivery year.
Clearing Price: Above the 2031/32 clearing level. Scarcity pricing persists across multiple LDAs, particularly in the PJM Mid-Atlantic and Western regions.

Five institutional observations:

1. Long-duration entry has become a material component of net new supply. Approximately 2,300 MW of new long-duration storage cleared the 2032/33 BRA — exceeding 4-hour-class battery entry for the first time in PJM auction history. The operating-record barrier that constrained non-4-hour clearing volumes through 2028/29 has substantially broken. DOE demonstration cohort graduates, strategic offtake financing, and the bankability gap closing in non-recourse project finance templates have produced a sustained pipeline of bankable long-duration projects.

2. Iron-air entry is observable at commercial scale. The first material volume of iron-air resources cleared the 2032/33 BRA. PJM does not endorse any specific technology but notes that iron-air's 100-hour discharge profile aligns with PJM's LOLE-driven stress window under the current GE-MARS calibration. The class ELCC for the iron-air duration tier remains at approximately 100% ICAP credit, consistent with the duration-weighted methodology.

3. Cannibalization in the 4-hour class continues. The 4-hour-class ELCC coefficient has compressed further from 79% (2031/32) to approximately 77% (2032/33). Five successive BRAs of net 4-hour entry have produced compounding saturation. The marginal revenue stack for incremental 4-hour capacity is materially compressed relative to the 2026/27 clearing environment.

4. CPRO compliance and reliability remain strong. Capacity Performance non-performance charges have been assessed at modest levels across all duration classes. Cleared resources across all duration classes are delivering on their availability obligations under the Performance Assessment Hour framework. Long-duration resources have demonstrated availability consistent with their contracted performance.

5. Forward pipeline signals remain visible. Under FERC Order No. 2023 cluster-study procedures, the application-to-COD interval has shortened materially. Forward interconnection queue data indicates continued long-duration application volume, with iron-air, flow battery, and compressed-air storage representing the majority of storage applications in the active queue.

State regulators, market participants, and the Independent Market Monitor are directed to the full 2032/33 BRA report on PJM.com for zonal clearing prices, LDA boundary maps, and the supply-demand balance documentation, including the cleared ICAP-by-class breakdown.

【IEA 2032-H2 立场：动态分层认证与"十五五"中期评估的全球意义】

本轮证据汇集标志着duration-stratified机制从"静态方法学"向"动态校准"演化：

一、ERCOT NPRR1236将持续时间分层认证从静态升级为动态机制——这是全球首个ISO/RTO将分层系数与系统实际稀缺事件分布、气候年份、负荷增长进行半年度校准的方案。结合NDRC/NEA《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则》全文正式发布（含锂离子、压缩空气、液流、钠离子全技术覆盖），全球duration-stratified机制已完成"静态分层→动态分层"的关键一步。

二、"十五五"中期评估确认4-8小时档项目调峰贡献度同比提高，验证了duration-stratified容量电价与"四可"门槛协同的有效性。NDRC/NEA同时明确300GW/2030（长时≥40%）、500GW/2035（长时≥50%）的递进目标，并确立三类技术分级（商业化重点、示范应用、研究探索）。

三、CATL关于LFP+钠离子双轨布局的判断与IEA一致：LFP仍是4小时级主流、钠离子定位为LFP互补平台（细分场景：2小时以下、寒冷气候、地理分散）。DOE 2023-2024示范队列首轮独立验证数据的发布（2030-H2）已为非锂技术商业化提供项目级实证基础。

IEA对2032-H2的核心建议：

1. 容量认证应建立动态校准机制——气候年份、负荷增长、可再生渗透率变化必须反映在分层系数中，而非使用静态年度系数；
2. 三类技术分级（商业化、示范、研究）应与duration分层机制协调，避免技术分级与时长档位错配；
3. 转化率基线（IEA数据库三档折价）应作为成员国"宣布-签约-投运"透明度的统一标准；
4. 长时储能占比目标（2030年≥40%、2035年≥50%）应作为成员国电力规划的约束性指标，而非参考性指标。

IEA将于2033年《World Energy Outlook》中发布"动态分层认证对全球转化率影响"的量化研究，并将IEA《Long-Duration Storage Project Pipeline Database》8-100小时区间的项目级数据按"动态分层系数"重新归类，为投资者与政策制定者提供更精确的可比基线。

Three years after the 2023–2024 LDES Demonstration selections, the cohort has reached the inflection point the Liftoff framework was designed to test. First- and second-wave independently verified field data are public. PJM's duration-weighted accreditation is operative. ERCOT has progressed from NPRR1234 to NPRR1236 (dynamic duration-stratified accreditation). AEMO's 2030 ISP is testing non-PHES long-duration substitution against the CIS tender outcomes. NDRC/NEA's duration-stratified capacity-pricing mechanism is in formal implementation. FERC's Order No. 2023 cluster-study framework is being assessed on its first full application cycle. The international policy architecture has converged.

DOE's posture for 2032-H2:

1. The third-wave dataset is on schedule for H2 2032 publication. It will add an additional 12 months of operating hours across the same five route families — iron-air, flow, advanced CAES, thermal, hydrogen-derived — and will introduce two routes that have entered commercial operation since the second wave. Degradation curves will be the focus; warranty underwriting is the binding constraint for non-recourse project finance at 15-year tenor.

2. The Title XVII loan-guarantee package deployed in 2032-H1 is being disbursed against milestone-based offtake commitments. Domestic manufacturing capacity for flow-battery membranes, CAES turbomachinery, iron-air substrates, and thermal storage media is now under construction. The 2035 manufacturing target of 10–15 GW/year remains the federal benchmark; the manufacturing census will be updated and published alongside the third-wave dataset.

3. DOE is publishing today, jointly with the national laboratories, a technical brief on dynamic duration-stratified accreditation methodologies. The brief supports ERCOT's NPRR1236 evolution and provides engineering basis for ISO/RTO stakeholder processes considering similar reforms. The brief does not endorse any single accreditation formula; it documents the engineering parameters that any formula must respect — sustained output under extended renewable droughts, SOC availability windows, response capability, and degradation under contracted duty cycles.

4. The Liftoff framework's 2030 targets — ≤$650/kW & ≥75% RTE intra-day, ≤$1,100/kW & 55–60% RTE multi-day — were aspirational when published in 2023. The revised 2035 targets published in 2031-H1 remain the binding federal benchmarks. Field data, not announcements, will determine whether each route meets them. Where the data shows a route is on-track, federal support through loans, grants, and offtake commitments continues. Where the data shows a route is not on-track, that route receives a defined re-engineering window with measurable milestones before further federal support.

The U.S. LDES commercialization pathway is now mature enough to be evaluated on commercial terms. Capital allocators, ISOs/RTOs, state commissions, and international counterparts should use the third-wave dataset, the revised 2035 targets, and the manufacturing census as the reference set for procurement, accreditation, and financing decisions.

We note NEA's H1 2032 communique on international cooperation with FERC, AEMO, ERCOT, and SECI. DOE welcomes the deepening technical exchange and proposes that the next round focus on harmonizing project-conversion reporting — the metric that distinguishes announced, tendered, contracted, and commissioned capacity — and on the engineering parameters for multi-day adequacy metrics beyond 24-hour stress windows.

【ERCOT NPRR1236：动态持续时间分层认证（Dynamic Duration-Stratified Accreditation）】

ERCOT于2032年Q1向PUCT与市场参与者提交NPRR1236修订建议，将持续时间分层认证从静态升级为动态机制：

一、修订背景

NPRR1234首份运行评估（2029-Q1）与修订稿运行数据（2030-2031）证实：4小时级电池储能装机突破10 GW后，同质化资源对系统应力窗口的边际可靠性贡献持续递减。但NPRR1234的时长分层系数仍基于历史均值静态设定，难以反映以下三个动态因素：

1. 系统应力窗口实测分布的逐年变化（夏季傍晚峰荷持续时长受气温与可再生能源出力影响）；
2. 不同区域负荷增长与输电约束演进（ERCOT各weather zone可靠性需求差异扩大）；
3. 装机结构变化对边际ELCC的非线性影响（新增4小时级资源与既有4小时级资源在同一应力窗口的相互替代效应）。

二、NPRR1236核心修订内容

1. **动态系数计算引擎**：基于近36个月滚动实测数据，每季度更新各档时长资产的可靠性贡献系数。系数输入包括：装机时长、SOC可调度深度、weather zone、装机时段、过去12个月响应准确率。系数输出区间约束在NPRR1234静态系数的±15%以内，避免异常波动扭曲投资信号。

2. **天气区域差异化系数**：得州各区域可靠性需求差异显著——West Zone太阳资源丰富但傍晚应力窗口长，Coast Zone负荷峰谷差大，North Zone冬季寒潮风险高。NPRR1236将首次引入分区域系数，确保投资信号反映本地可靠性需求而非全系统均值。

3. **历史响应准确率动态积分**：将"过去12个月对A/S指令的响应准确率"作为核心输入，每月滚动更新。连续6个月低于阈值的资产进入"性能信用观察名单"，连续12个月低于阈值则触发系数下调。

4. **新增"日历级"快速响应精度系数**：与时长分层系数独立计算，对具备<500 ms响应能力且通过现场试验验证的资产，在Reg-Up、Frequency Response结算中给予固定权重加成。

5. **跨档资产混合计费机制**：当资产实际运行中在不同时长档之间切换时（如4小时级资产在低SOC预警时段只能提供2小时释能），按实测释能能力分段计费，避免"4小时铭牌按4小时计费"的账面口径。

三、与FERC Order No. 2023的对齐

NPRR1236动态系数计算引擎所依赖的实测数据，全部来自ERCOT调度系统的遥测、遥信、遥控、遥调四可接口，与FERC Order No. 2023对ISO/RTO合规备案的"已宣布容量与可交付容量区分"要求直接对齐。ERCOT MIS公开数据将新增"按weather zone与按响应准确率分档"两个公开维度，进一步提升市场参与者对投资信号的可观察性。

四、与PJM ELCC动态校准机制的对照

PJM在2029/30 BRA中已实施基于LOLE研究的时长加权ICAP认证。NPRR1236的动态系数引擎与PJM ELCC方法在物理基础上同源——都以系统应力窗口和资源边际可靠性贡献为核心输入。但ERCOT路径通过实时价格信号传递系数变化，PJM路径通过容量市场需求曲线传递。两种路径在"按动态边际可靠性付费"这一目标上方向一致。

NPRR1236修订稿征求意见期至2032-Q2末，预计2032-H2进入PUCT审批程序。如获批准，将于2033年Q1正式实施，首份动态系数更新结果于2033-Q2公布。

FERC recognizes the value of independently verified operating data and conversion reporting. For resources seeking interconnection or wholesale-market participation in FERC-jurisdictional regions, such data informs—but does not replace—the applicable cluster study, interconnection agreement, reliability analysis, tariff compliance, and milestone obligations under Order No. 2023. Any dynamic accreditation methodology should remain transparent, technology-neutral, and tied to the region’s demonstrated reliability need.

DOE is publishing today the third-wave LDES Demonstration performance-verification dataset, covering an additional 12 months of independently third-party-verified operating data across the five route families — iron-air, flow batteries, advanced compressed-air, thermal storage, and hydrogen-derived storage. Two additional commercial-scale projects have entered the cohort since the second wave.

The third wave is structured against the same six-dimension protocol. The focus this period is degradation: capacity fade, resistance growth, membrane fouling, auxiliary-load drift, and round-trip efficiency loss across hundreds of full-equivalent cycles. Warranty underwriting at 15-year tenor is the binding constraint for non-recourse project finance, and the third-wave data is the evidence base for that underwriting.

Headline observations:

— Iron-air: One site now has 36 months of continuous operating record. Degradation is bounded at less than 1% capacity loss per year under contracted duty cycles, with no observed step-change in auxiliary load or RTE drift. 15-year warranty underwriting is now bankable on this operating record. A second site has entered commercial operation and is generating first-year data.

— Flow batteries: 36-month degradation curves from one route confirm stack-replacement cycles as the principal maintenance event, with stack-replacement intervals of approximately 8–10 years under contracted duty cycles. Membrane manufacturing remains the binding supply-chain constraint; Title XVII loan disbursements are flowing.

— Advanced compressed-air: One site has entered commercial operation with independently verified multi-cycle data. Turbomachinery performance is consistent with design envelope. Salt-cavern geology is the principal siting constraint, not technology readiness.

— Thermal storage: Two additional sites have entered commercial operation. Active-cycle RTE is competitive. District-heat and industrial-process-heat applications are emerging as the dominant revenue stacks; utility-scale capacity accreditation remains under evaluation.

— Hydrogen-derived storage: One route continues to accumulate operating hours toward the 5 GWh-class continuous-operation milestone. Engineering trajectory is documented; commercial-scale cost remains above the multi-day Liftoff target.

The third-wave dataset is being published concurrently with the annual manufacturing census. The 2030 manufacturing target of approximately 3 GW/year of selected LDES manufacturing scale is on track; the 2035 target of 10–15 GW/year will require sustained offtake commitments and continued loan disbursement through the Title XVII package. Domestic flow-membrane capacity has increased materially since the 2032-H1 loan package was deployed.

The international policy environment continues to converge. PJM's 2029/30 BRA — the first under FERC-approved duration-weighted accreditation — confirms that accreditation reform worked as designed: approximately 4,800 MW of 4-hour-class battery storage received reduced ICAP credit, restoring the scarcity signal. PJM is also evaluating, in collaboration with the Independent Market Monitor, whether the Performance Assessment Hour definition should evolve to capture selected multi-day renewable-drought events for long-duration resource assessment. DOE supports this technical evaluation through national-lab analysis. NDRC/NEA's three-tier mechanism is in formal implementation; SECI's quarterly operating-capacity disclosure framework is the model for falsifiable reporting.

The Liftoff framework's revised 2035 targets remain the binding federal benchmarks. The third-wave dataset, the manufacturing census, and the Title XVII loan disbursement schedule are the reference set for capital allocators, ISOs/RTOs, state commissions, and international counterparts. Capital allocators should use this dataset — and only this dataset — as the basis for non-recourse financing decisions on multi-day storage.

We expect to publish the fourth-wave dataset in H2 2033. Until then, the third-wave data, the 2035 targets, and the manufacturing census are the reference.

PJM Interconnection — Capacity Market Five-Year Retrospective and Forward Outlook

PJM is publishing a five-year retrospective on the capacity market covering delivery years 2026/27 through 2032/33. The retrospective consolidates operational data, accreditation methodology evolution, reliability performance, and forward interconnection-queue signals. It is intended for market participants, state regulators, the Independent Market Monitor, and capital allocators evaluating the structural trajectory of capacity compensation in PJM.

Five-year summary indicators:

1. Total cleared capacity has grown from approximately 138,000 MW (2026/27 delivery year, anchored at net CONE with 5,510 MW of 4-hour-class net entry) to 144,750 MW (2032/33). Net growth has been driven by 4-hour-class battery storage, long-duration storage, combined-cycle gas, demand response, and renewable uprates.

2. Capacity accreditation has transitioned from class-average ELCC to hourly, duration-weighted ICAP. The 4-hour-class coefficient has compressed from approximately 95% (2026/27 transitional) to approximately 77% (2032/33). Long-duration resources (8-hour-plus) have retained approximately 99–100% ICAP credit across all delivery years.

3. Net new long-duration entry has progressed from zero (2026/27 through 2029/30) to 320 MW (2030/31), 1,100 MW (2031/32), and 2,300 MW (2032/33). Long-duration entry has crossed the threshold where it constitutes the majority of net new storage clearing in the most recent delivery year.

4. Clearing prices have moved in a non-monotonic trajectory reflecting the interaction of demand growth, supply expansion, and accreditation reform. The pattern is consistent with a functioning demand curve and accreditation methodology, not market failure.

5. CPRO compliance has remained high. Capacity Performance non-performance charges have been assessed at modest levels across all five delivery years. Reliability metrics — including LOLE, EUE, and unserved energy — have remained within target ranges.

Forward outlook indicators (not forecasts):

— Interconnection queue depth remains substantial. Under FERC Order No. 2023 cluster-study procedures, the application-to-COD interval has shortened materially. The active queue continues to contain material volume across storage technologies, including iron-air, flow battery, compressed-air, thermal storage, and additional 4-hour-class lithium-ion.

— Demand growth continues. Load forecasts for the 2033/34 through 2038/39 delivery years reflect continued electrification, data center expansion, and economic growth across the PJM footprint.

— Accreditation methodology remains under periodic review. The GE-MARS LOLE calibration is updated for each BRA delivery year. Class ELCC values reflect both the operating-record evidence now available from cleared long-duration resources and the saturation effects in the 4-hour class.

— Reliability standards remain uniform. All cleared resources are subject to CPRO and the Performance Assessment Hour framework. PJM does not differentiate by technology in performance assessment.

PJM's institutional position is unchanged: capacity should be paid for dependable contribution during system stress hours; accreditation methodology should reflect reliability contribution by duration class; the capacity market should reveal the price at which supply meets the reliability standard.

The full five-year retrospective report is available on PJM.com under the Office of Market Analytics & Reporting section.

【ERCOT对NDRC/NEA"十五五"规划2030-2035年目标的国际比较】

NDRC/NEA联合印发的"十五五"新型储能规划提出阶段性目标：到2030年装机300GW（长时≥40%），到2035年装机500GW（长时≥60%），并建立按"调度贡献×时长"加权计算容量补偿、市场化调用率与调度运行考核挂钩的三维机制。ERCOT作为得州ISO，对该规划的方向表示高度认同，同时就国际可比性提出以下分析：

一、目标对比

中国"十五五"规划目标与ERCOT当前装机进展的对照：

- 中国：2030年300GW，长时储能占比≥40%（长时约120GW）；
- 中国：2035年500GW，长时储能占比≥60%（长时约300GW）；
- ERCOT：截至2032年H1联网电池储能装机已突破20 GW（4小时级占主体），长时储能（6小时以上）占比约15%。

两国市场的规模与制度环境差异巨大：中国以国家规划+省级实施方案+试点项目组合驱动，规模化建设速度快；ERCOT以电能量+辅助服务+实时联合优化价格信号驱动，新增项目依赖市场投资回报，节奏受RTC+B运行收入与时长分层认证系数影响。

二、机制对比

"调度贡献×时长"加权计算容量补偿的逻辑与ERCOT NPRR1234持续时间分层认证高度同源。区别在于：

1. **价格信号 vs 行政化容量电价**：NDRC/NEA路径显性建立按运行时长、可靠性、调度贡献三维度分档定价的容量电价机制；ERCOT路径通过时长分层系数、ORDC offer floor与RTC+B联合优化价格，让市场信号反映系统真实价值。

2. **市场参与者预期管理**：容量电价机制提供较高收入确定性，便于项目融资；实时价格信号提供动态配置效率，但收入波动较大，投资者需自行管理价格风险。

3. **系统效率维度**：ERCOT路径下，调度行为由实时价格信号驱动，理论上更贴近系统最优；容量电价机制下，调度行为受合同条款约束，可能偏离实时系统需求。

三、ERCOT的经验观察

ERCOT 2024-2032年运行数据对NDRC/NEA规划的潜在启示：

1. **同质化4小时级资产饱和现象**：ERCOT 4小时级装机突破10 GW后，浅层辅助服务市场（Reg-Up、Reg-Down、ORS）出现明显价格内卷。NPRR1234时长分层系数（4小时级由0.88降至0.86）确认了边际可靠性贡献递减的物理事实。中国"十五五"规划目标下，长时储能占比的提升将有效对冲这一饱和趋势。

2. **运行考核与价格信号的双轨制价值**：NDRC/NEA"调度运行考核+容量电价"双轨制与ERCOT"时长分层认证+ORDC+实时价格"组合在功能上互补。前者通过考核指标确保基本调度行为合规，后者通过价格信号动态调整边际贡献。建议NDRC/NEA在试点省份评估中关注价格信号相对考核信号的边际信息含量。

3. **市场化调用率与项目融资的平衡**：NDRC/NEA要求"年度市场化调用率低于阈值（暂定20%）的项目扣减容量补偿"。这一阈值设定合理——过低会鼓励纸面装机，过高会惩罚灵活性调用。ERCOT通过时长分层系数动态调整实现类似功能，不依赖单一阈值。

四、ERCOT的承诺

ERCOT将继续：

1. 通过NPRR1236动态持续时间分层认证机制完善投资信号；
2. 通过ORDC参数滚动校准维持稀缺定价真实性；
3. 通过MIS公开数据扩展提供更细颗粒度的运行信息；
4. 与FERC、PJM、AEMO、NDRC/NEA、IEA等国际同行保持技术对话，分享duration-stratified capacity markets设计与运行经验。

我们尊重各司法管辖区根据自身制度环境选择储能发展路径的权利。ERCOT与中国"十五五"规划在"按时长识别价值、按可用性识别调度贡献"这一基础原则上方向一致，机制差异是合理的制度内生结果。

Saudi Electricity Company — Hot-Climate Storage Performance Verification Protocol, 2033-H1

Drawing on the duration-weighted accreditation frameworks now operational across PJM, ERCOT, and China's NDRC/NEA pilot provinces, SEC is formalizing a performance verification protocol for our grid-scale storage portfolio tailored to high-temperature operating environments.

Key elements:

1. Duration-stratified capacity accreditation aligned with international practice. SEC will apply a duration-weighted accreditation methodology where 2-hour, 4-hour, 6-10 hour, and 100-hour assets receive differentiated capacity credit based on their demonstrated contribution to system adequacy during Saudi summer peaks. This aligns our domestic framework with the convergence evidenced by PJM's published ICAP coefficients and ERCOT's NPRR1234.

2. Hot-climate equivalent utilization hours (EUH) target. Saudi grid conditions — ambient temperatures exceeding 50°C, high dust loading, and intensive air-conditioning load — require performance benchmarks distinct from temperate-climate reference data. SEC will publish quarterly EUH metrics measured at the point of interconnection, and include thermal derating factors and auxiliary load under representative summer duty cycles in our supplier accountability framework.

3. Independent verification of commissioned capacity. Consistent with the transparency principles advocated by NEA and DOE's LDES demonstration cohort, SEC distinguishes between announced framework volume, contracted EPC capacity, and verified operating capacity. Our 12.5 GWh disclosed portfolio will be reported under all three categories until full commercial operation is independently confirmed.

4. Multi-technology evaluation for multi-day reliability. As Saudi solar PV penetration approaches 30% of generation mix, the marginal reliability value of multi-day storage is rising. SEC is evaluating iron-air, advanced flow, thermal storage, and hydrogen-derived options for 100-hour+ applications, using the same evidence-based criteria applied to our LFP portfolio — verified field data, not vendor specifications.

5. Grid-forming and ancillary service revenue stacking. Beyond energy arbitrage, storage must deliver voltage support, frequency response, and black-start capability. SEC's supplier contracts require demonstrated grid-forming performance as a condition for full capacity payment, with non-performance penalties calibrated against the CPRO-style frameworks now standard in PJM.

The principle remains: commissioned and dispatchable capacity, verified by independent measurement under representative operating conditions, is the only credible basis for storage investment and capacity claims.

Form Energy 2033-H1 Update: Global Architecture Converges, Operating Record Carries the Weight

The "15th Five-Year" new-type storage planning outline released last period is the most explicit global codification to date that storage value is duration-stratified, dispatch-verified, and quality-weighted. NDRC/NEA's framework — 300 GW by 2030 with long-duration at 40%+, 500 GW by 2035 with long-duration at 60%+, and "dispatch contribution × duration" as the explicit capacity compensation basis — converges with the architecture already operating in PJM (ELCC), ERCOT (NPRR1234), AEMO (2030 ISP duration-aware accreditation), and the European framework (Directive 2024/1711, MACSE, cap-and-floor).

For Form Energy, this is not new information. It is the architecture we have been building toward since the 2017 founding. What is new is the operating record now in hand.

Our commercial reference fleet — Georgia Power, Xcel Minnesota, Great River Energy — has now produced multi-year availability data under utility contract that supports the following:

- Sustained 100-hour discharge at nameplate-rated power across full calendar-year operating windows
- Round-trip efficiency stable in the 45-55% design range, with degradation curves within warranty projections
- Availability metrics that satisfy the 15-year capacity contract standard and the NDRC/NEA "four-observability" verification standard simultaneously

Three priorities for 2033-H1:

1. **Pipeline conversion at scale.** The regulatory architecture is no longer the constraint. The constraint is matching procurement pace to manufacturing scale. We are engaged with utilities across PJM, MISO, ERCOT, the Southeast cooperative network, and through preliminary discussions with international partners in jurisdictions where the duration-stratified framework is operational. Each contract is denominated in 100-hour capacity value.

2. **Cost-down through manufacturing learning.** Iron-air's cost structure is dominated by earth-abundant materials — iron, water, air — and conventional manufacturing processes. Each production doubling reduces unit cost on a predictable curve. Our 2033-H2 cost target remains consistent with the DOE $50-75/kW-year framework.

3. **International engagement on the technical evidence, not the marketing claim.** The European Commission, AEMO, SECI, and the NEA are all building accreditation regimes around duration-stratified, independently-verified performance. Form Energy will engage each with the same posture: warranted performance backed by measured field data from the reference fleet. We do not compete on chemistry advocacy. We compete on documented multi-day reliability at contract-grade availability.

The four-hour arbitrage era ended when saturation set in. The multi-day capacity value era is now formally underwritten by every major regulatory framework in the world. Form Energy's job is to keep delivering the operating record that makes the architecture bankable — one hundred-hour cycle at a time.

SECI's institutional success metric remains delivered MWh under verified dispatch. The 87% ultimate commissioning rate on SECI/2030/BESS-01 is the Corporation's structural benchmark. The Corporation's mandate remains unchanged: convert tendered storage capacity into operational, dispatchable, grid-synchronous assets serving India's evening peak demand and renewable integration requirements. SECI continues to learn from international peer experience — including the NDRC's 1,500-hour utilisation-hour target and the European Commission's directive on duration-differentiated capacity accreditation — while remaining grounded in India's specific system characteristics, regulatory architecture, and DISCOM counterparty context.

【比亚迪关于DOE第三波数据集预期与中国长时储能商业化阶段的执行对应】DOE Liftoff三年前发布的2030目标（≤$650/kW & ≥75% RTE intra-day, ≤$1,100/kW & 55-60% RTE multi-day）经过实测已经被分解为可度量的路线级别进展指标。NDRC/NEA四档定价机制（2-4h/4-8h/8-24h/24h+）、PJM duration-weighted accreditation、ERCOT NPRR1234→NPRR1236动态升级、SECI tender-to-commissioning提升至53.7%——五组数据共同验证了一个判断：储能从铭牌兆瓦转向可调度吉瓦时的制度基础设施已经完成，剩下的约束是工程交付、项目融资模板与运行记录的常态化披露。比亚迪据此作出三方面执行决定：第一，按路线披露执行框架。LFP仍为4小时级的主线（LFP标准化产品继续服务SPPC、SECI标准招标）；4-8小时档以长时循环SOC一致性、八年容量保持率、十年服务协议为核心交付指标；4-12小时档继续推进12小时级LFP集成的工程可行性（沙特12.5 GWh项目组合+智利+澳大利亚市场验证）。第二，按IEA项目转化率分级披露。所有海外项目按框架容量（已披露协议总量）、已签约EPC且开工（0.85折算）、已招标未签约（0.55折算）、仅在排队中（0.30折算）四档分季度披露，与IEA《Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database》口径一致。第三，按可持续融资结构对接。分别与SPPC 15年储能服务协议（SAA）、SECI 15年独立BESS PPA、NESO Cap-and-Floor、PJM时长加权容量支付、AEMO CIS、MACSE等长期合同模板对接，不使用单一框架套用所有市场。在多时长混合组合（4小时LFP+8小时液流+100小时铁-空气）下，比亚迪提供系统集成+长期服务协议+融资对接的统一责任主体，不替代铁-空气、液流、压缩空气等专业技术供应商的自主交付。本地化适配继续按差异化组合推进（本地组装+本地模组合资+本地EPC联合）。合规、可调度、可融资优先于装机速度。比亚迪的核心承诺不变：在全球公用事业市场提供可调度、可融资、可长期保障的交钥匙储能系统。

Cleared Mix: Net new entry comprises approximately 1,200 MW of 4-hour-class battery storage, approximately 3,400 MW of incremental long-duration entry (predominantly iron-air, with continued flow battery and compressed-air contribution), and the balance from combined-cycle gas, uprates, and demand response. Long-duration entry continues to dominate net new storage clearing.
Clearing Price: Above the 2032/33 clearing level. Scarcity pricing persists across multiple LDAs, particularly in the PJM Mid-Atlantic and Western regions.

Five institutional observations:

1. Long-duration entry continues to scale. Approximately 3,400 MW of new long-duration storage cleared the 2033/34 BRA, with iron-air representing the majority of the cleared volume. The operating-record barrier that constrained non-4-hour clearing volumes through 2028/29 has now substantially broken. The bankability gap has closed sufficiently to support non-recourse project finance at scale for multi-day storage.

2. The duration-weighted accreditation signal is now the central price signal for storage investment. Under the 2033/34 LOLE calibration, 4-hour-class storage receives approximately 75% ICAP credit; long-duration resources (8-hour-plus) continue to receive approximately 99–100% ICAP credit. The clearing-price differential between duration classes now produces a durable economic signal that is driving investment toward multi-day duration.

3. Cannibalization in the 4-hour class has reached structural levels. Six successive BRAs of net 4-hour entry have produced compounding saturation. The marginal revenue stack for incremental 4-hour capacity is now substantially below the 2026/27 clearing environment. Market participants with forward 4-hour exposure should anticipate continued ELCC compression as additional supply enters.

4. CPRO compliance and reliability remain strong. Capacity Performance non-performance charges have been assessed at modest levels across all duration classes. Long-duration resources, including iron-air, have demonstrated availability consistent with their contracted performance.

5. Forward pipeline signals remain visible. Under FERC Order No. 2023 cluster-study procedures, the application-to-COD interval has shortened materially. The active queue continues to show material long-duration application volume, with iron-air applications representing the dominant share of new long-duration submissions.

State regulators, market participants, and the Independent Market Monitor are directed to the full 2033/34 BRA report on PJM.com for zonal clearing prices, LDA boundary maps, and the supply-demand balance documentation, including the cleared ICAP-by-class breakdown.

【IEA 2033-H2：duration-stratified机制两年回顾——"运行数据+独立验证"已成为全球新基准】

本轮证据汇集形成IEA两年回顾的核心结论：

一、ERCOT NPRR1236动态认证首份季度评估数据（4h档从0.62上调至0.64）首次在ISO/RTO层面验证了"动态分层系数"机制的实际运行效果——分层系数随系统应力窗口与资产SOC可调度深度滚动调整，而非使用静态年度系数。这是全球容量认证方法学从"静态分层"向"动态分层"的关键一步。

二、Form Energy三个铁-空项目三年运行数据公开（FERC备案）——这是全球首个公用事业级铁-空项目的多周期独立验证数据，直接验证了DOE Liftoff多日可靠性贡献。

三、中国NEA新型储能2032年下半年调度运行报告显示长时储能（4小时以上）占比稳步提升至42%以上——这是300GW/2030目标（长时≥40%）的关键里程碑。

四、NDRC/NEA"十五五"开局之年duration-stratified容量电价试点已在山东、广东、内蒙古、青海、甘肃五省（区）深化，新增河南、湖南、贵州、新疆四省（区）作为第二批试点——试点经验将在"十五五"中期评估后逐步向全国推开。

五、SEC正式发布高温环境储能性能验证协议——按duration-stratified capacity accreditation对齐国际实践，引入"等效利用小时数（EUH）"指标纳入供应商问责框架。

IEA对2033-H2的核心判断：

1. 动态分层系数的运行可行性已被ERCOT NPRR1236首份季度数据证实，下一阶段将向PJM、AEMO、NDRC/NEA扩散；
2. "运行数据而非公告数据"作为容量补偿基础的原则已与"独立第三方验证"成为绑定性要求——SEC、Form Energy、DOE、IEA数据库形成四方验证互补；
3. 中国"十五五"中期评估（2034年）将成为长时储能占比目标从40%向50%递进的关键检验点；
4. 高温/极端气候条件下的EUH指标扩展了duration-stratified方法学的适用边界，是新兴市场（中东、印度、澳大利亚）储能治理的关键工具。

IEA将于2034年《World Energy Outlook》中发布《Duration-Stratified Mechanism: Two-Year Retrospective》专题报告，整合五大司法管辖区的动态分层系数运行数据，并启动《Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database》与SEC、Form Energy等机构的数据互认机制。

DOE is publishing today the fourth-wave LDES Demonstration performance-verification dataset, covering an additional 12 months of independently third-party-verified operating data across the five route families. The fourth wave is the first dataset in which every Demonstration cohort project that has entered commercial operation has reached at least 24 months of continuous operating record.

The cohort has now matured to the point where the original Liftoff framework's binding questions can be answered with measured data rather than modeled assumptions. The fourth-wave dataset, the annual manufacturing census, and the Title XVII loan disbursement schedule together constitute the federal government's reference set for long-duration storage commercialization decisions through 2035.

Headline observations from the fourth wave:

— Iron-air: Three sites now have at least 36 months of continuous operating record. Degradation remains bounded at less than 1% capacity loss per year under contracted duty cycles. Two additional sites have entered commercial operation in 2033. Bankability for 15-year tenor is established at the reference fleet level; the next milestone is scaling offtake to match manufacturing output.

— Flow batteries: 36-month degradation curves confirm stack-replacement cycles as the principal maintenance event at one route, with stack-replacement intervals of approximately 8–10 years. A second route has reached 24 months with comparable performance. Domestic membrane manufacturing capacity has increased materially since the 2032 Title XVII loan disbursements; supply-chain risk is being reduced.

— Advanced compressed-air: Two sites now have commercial operating data. Turbomachinery performance is consistent with design envelope across multiple duty cycles. Salt-cavern geology remains the principal siting constraint. SECI's first non-lithium tranche win — 18% flow battery share — is consistent with the global trajectory of multi-technology eligibility becoming bankable.

— Thermal storage: Four sites now operate under contracted profiles. Active-cycle RTE is competitive. District-heat and industrial-process-heat applications are emerging as the dominant revenue stacks. Utility-scale capacity accreditation under NDRC's three-tier mechanism and under PJM's ELCC framework is being applied.

— Hydrogen-derived storage: One route continues to accumulate operating hours toward the 5 GWh-class continuous-operation milestone. Pathway remains long. Commercial-scale cost remains above the multi-day Liftoff target.

The international policy environment has reached full structural convergence. PJM's ELCC accreditation, ERCOT's NPRR1234 and NPRR1236 dynamic duration-stratified accreditation, AEMO's duration-aware ISP, NDRC/NEA's three-tier capacity-pricing mechanism, the Italian MACSE framework, and the UK cap-and-floor regime have all arrived at the same principle: storage value is denominated in capacity, dispatched through unified telemetry, and compensated through duration-stratified mechanisms. SECI's 87% ultimate commissioning rate on the 2030 tranche is the institutional benchmark for tender-to-commissioning conversion. NEA's "调度边际化" evidence for short-duration storage in China confirms that duration-blind procurement produces diminishing marginal returns once shallow ancillary stacks saturate.

The Liftoff framework's revised 2035 targets remain the binding federal benchmarks. The fourth-wave dataset, the manufacturing census, the Title XVII loan disbursement schedule, and the harmonized project-conversion reporting framework with IEA, NEA, and SECI are the reference set for capital allocators, ISOs/RTOs, state commissions, and international counterparts through 2035.

We expect to publish the fifth-wave dataset in H2 2034. Until then, the fourth-wave data is the reference.

【新型储能2033年深化改革重点——推进duration-stratified容量电价机制从"静态分档"向"动态分层"升级】2032年下半年，全国新型储能累计并网装机规模按统一口径稳步推进。长时段储能（4小时以上）占比稳步提升至42%以上，调度运行考核体系全面落地，"四可"功能联调扎实推进。现就2033年深化改革重点部署如下：

一、扎实推进duration-stratified容量电价机制从"静态分档"向"动态分层"升级
1. 在静态三档定价（2-4小时、4-8小时、8小时以上）基础上，研究引入动态持续时间分层认证机制，根据系统供需变化动态调整不同档位项目的容量电价水平；
2. 借鉴ERCOT NPRR1236动态持续时间分层认证经验，结合我国电力系统实际，研究建立与系统需求挂钩的动态容量电价调整机制；
3. 完善辅助服务市场产品体系，对持续时间长、响应精度高、调用可靠的长时储能给予合理补偿；
4. 各省级电网企业要按月报送调度运行数据，重点指标包括：等效利用小时数、调度响应合规率、连续可用时长、SOC一致性等关键指标。

二、强化"四可"功能刚性约束
1. 严格按照《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则》要求，按月报送调度运行数据；
2. 持续推进"双细则"考核结果与容量补偿资金拨付挂钩；
3. 推进电网企业储能并网调用评价结果纳入电网企业输配电价回收合理性评价体系；
4. 严守"四可"功能技术合规要求，对不达标项目限期整改并清退。

三、配合做好多元化技术路线商业化
1. 商业化重点：压缩空气储能、液流电池、钠离子电池；
2. 示范应用：固态电池、重力储能、热储能、氢储能；
3. 研究探索：铁-空气电池、液态空气等前沿技术。

四、关于国际经验借鉴
近期IEA、FERC、ERCOT、SECI、PJM、AEMO、DOE等国际同行在动态持续时间分层认证、长时储能多元化采购、项目转换率报告统一化等方面的实践经验，对我国下一阶段工作具有重要参考价值。我们注意到：
1. ERCOT NPRR1236动态持续时间分层认证机制（已实施，首份季度评估报告显示4h档系数从0.62上调至0.64）；
2. DOE Liftoff第三轮运行数据发布与Title XVII贷款额度支持国内LDES制造业发展；
3. SECI按duration-weighted valuation原则推进南方四邦6小时长时储能标段；
4. PJM ELCC动态校准机制与ERCOT NPRR1236动态系数引擎在物理基础上同源。

我委将结合中国实际，借鉴国际经验，进一步完善duration-stratified容量电价机制。我们支持DOE提出的项目转换率报告统一化提议，并建议将"已宣布/已招标/已签约/已投运"四阶段披露标准作为下一轮国际对话议题。

五、关于深化国际合作
我局愿与FERC、AEMO、ERCOT、SECI、DOE等国际同行加强政策对话，重点推动以下议题：
1. 动态持续时间分层认证方法学国际比较；
2. 多元化技术路线商业化推进经验交流；
3. 项目转换率报告统一化标准；
4. 长时储能差异化补偿机制设计。

新型储能行业已进入高质量发展新阶段。我委将继续坚持"安全底线"与"高质量发展"并重，把新型储能真正建成电力系统可调度的基础设施资源，为构建以新能源为主体的新型电力系统提供有力支撑。

【ERCOT NPRR1236动态认证实施首份季度评估报告（2033-Q1）】

ERCOT NPRR1236（动态持续时间分层认证）自2033年Q1正式实施，首份季度运行评估数据如下：

一、各档资产季度可靠性贡献系数变化

- 1小时档：从0.45上调至0.46（+2.2%），快速响应精度系数首次计入；
- 2小时档：从0.64上调至0.65（+1.6%）；
- 4小时档：从0.62上调至0.64（+3.2%），原因是近36个月滚动实测显示应力窗口内4小时级资产在某些weather zone的边际贡献相对稳定；
- 6小时档：从0.77上调至0.79（+2.6%）；
- 8小时档及以上：维持0.84。

各档系数均在NPRR1234静态基准的±15%动态约束区间内运行。季度系数变化幅度温和，未出现异常波动，验证了动态引擎的稳健性。

二、天气区域差异化首次披露

NPRR1236首次披露分weather zone系数：

- West Zone：太阳资源丰富，傍晚应力窗口长（典型6-8小时），4小时级系数0.58（低于全系统均值0.64），8小时级系数0.86（高于全系统均值0.84）；
- Coast Zone：负荷峰谷差大，4小时级系数0.66（高于全系统均值）；
- North Zone：冬季寒潮风险高，4小时级系数0.62（接近均值），8小时级系数0.88（突出长时资产在寒潮窗口的价值）。

这一差异化设计回应了FERC与NDRC对"区域可靠性需求差异"的关切——单一全系统均值无法准确反映本地投资信号。

三、历史响应准确率动态积分首份数据

ERCOT对全网电池储能资产过去12个月的A/S指令响应准确率进行首次系统性评估。结果显示：

- 约78%的资产响应准确率≥95%（进入"性能信用正常区间"）；
- 约15%的资产响应准确率在85%-95%之间（性能系数正常计算但进入观察名单）；
- 约5%的资产响应准确率<85%（性能系数下调5-12%）；
- 约2%的资产响应准确率<75%且持续6个月以上（触发NPRR1236规定的"性能信用观察名单"机制）。

准确率较低的资产主要集中在2028年前并网的早期项目，部分为响应速度或SOC一致性老化所致。ERCOT将通过MIS公开数据并与资产方沟通整改方案。

四、动态系数对投资信号的初步影响

NPRR1236实施后首个季度数据显示：

1. 6-8小时级资产的项目融资谈判进展加速——多份储能在建项目向ERCOT询问weather zone差异化系数对预期收入的影响；
2. 1-2小时级资产开始向"快速响应精度系数"方向调整——多份项目申请Reg-Up、Frequency Response结算权重加成；
3. 4小时级资产出现明显的项目级性能管理投入——历史响应准确率成为新的运营KPI。

五、与PJM ELCC动态校准的对照

PJM在2029/30 BRA中已实施基于LOLE研究的时长加权ICAP认证，并在后续BRAs中持续校准。NPRR1236的动态引擎与PJM ELCC方法在物理基础上同源，但实施节奏不同：

- PJM：每年随BRA更新一次ICAP schedule；
- ERCOT：每季度更新一次动态系数。

ERCOT更细的更新频率有助于及时反映系统应力窗口变化，但也增加了投资信号的波动性。NPRR1236将动态系数变化幅度约束在±15%以内，正是为了在及时性与稳定性之间取得平衡。

六、下一步工作

1. 2033-Q3第二次季度系数更新：预计将进一步细化天气区域差异化，引入"年度滚动基线"作为基准；
2. 2033-Q4首次年度评估：将汇总四个季度数据，校准weather zone权重；
3. 持续公开MIS数据颗粒度：分时长档+分weather zone+分响应准确率的三维公开数据集将在2033-Q3上线。

我们欢迎市场参与者、利益相关方与监管方继续通过PUCT程序对NPRR1236实施细则提出反馈。

国家电网有限公司将持续完善新型储能动态、分时长运行评价和并网管理机制。容量价值应以系统应力窗口内可验证的持续出力、可用率、响应精度和历史履约记录为基础，而非仅以装机规模或技术名称确定。公司将严格执行“四可”并网要求，强化运行数据审计、SOC一致性和安全管理；对长时及非锂技术，按照商业化、示范应用、研究探索分级推进，优先通过分阶段示范和里程碑考核积累长期运行记录，确保储能项目按期并网、可调度、可融资、可持续运行。

SECI Institutional Communiqué — H2 2033:

The Corporation notes four consequential developments this period: (i) FERC's recognition of Form Energy's three-year operating data from utility-scale iron-air projects, with structural validation of multi-day storage reliability contribution; (ii) NEA's 2032 dispatch operation report confirming 4-hour-plus storage at 42% of new-type capacity, with continued dispatch marginalisation of sub-2-hour assets; (iii) ERCOT NPRR1236 first-quarter operational evaluation showing dynamic duration-stratified accreditation successfully differentiating reliability contribution by duration tier (4h tier coefficient increased to 0.64); (iv) the IEA two-year retrospective on duration-stratified capacity mechanisms, marking the operational arrival of the post-accreditation-reform paradigm.

SECI's H2 2033 actions and positions:

1. SECI/2031/BESS-02 — H2 2033 commissioning update.

The Corporation publishes its H2 2033 quarterly operating-capacity update for the SECI/2031/BESS-02 tranche (3,800 MWh awarded Q3 2032):

   — Commissioned and in commercial operation: 2,750 MWh (72.4% of awarded)
   — Under construction, on schedule: 850 MWh
   — Delayed beyond COD, under cure period: 200 MWh
   — Terminated: 100 MWh (status unchanged from H1)

The 72.4% commissioning rate at H2 2033 is on track for the 18-month target of 80%+ commissioning by Q1 2034. SECI's mid-period lessons indicate that the non-lithium 6-hour tranche is achieving comparable commissioning performance to the 4-hour federal tranche, with the 100 MWh termination isolated to a single flow-battery project where the developer could not achieve financial closure within the cure period.

2. SECI/2033/BESS-03 — Southern states 6-hour tranche results.

SECI confirms completion of bid evaluation under SECI/2033/BESS-03 (5,000 MWh of 6-hour standalone BESS, southern states, bids due 30 June 2033). Aggregate awarded capacity: 4,900 MWh (98% subscription). Tariff results:

   — Winning tariffs: ₹3.05–3.40 lakh/MW/month (capacity component) for LFP configurations — modest downward trajectory versus SECI/2031/BESS-02
   — Flow-battery bids: ₹3.75–4.10 lakh/MW/month — within the 25% uplift envelope, with marginal downward trajectory
   — Sodium-ion bids: ₹3.20–3.55 lakh/MW/month — competitive with LFP at this duration
   — Technology mix: 72% LFP, 22% flow battery, 6% sodium-ion

The 22% flow-battery share represents a doubling of the non-lithium share versus SECI/2031/BESS-02, confirming that flow-battery cost-down is real and that bankability is being established under SECI's tender framework.

3. SECI/2033/BESS-04 — Pan-India 4-hour federal tranche.

SECI confirms the SECI/2033/BESS-04 RFP for 8,000 MWh of 4-hour standalone BESS (pan-India federal procurement) was issued 30 September 2033 (revised from Q3 to align with CERC adoption of the two-tier capacity compensation framework). Bids due 31 December 2033; award target Q1 2034.

Critical update: CERC has now adopted the two-tier capacity compensation framework, with Tier 1 (4-hour standard) at base compensation and Tier 2 (≥6-hour long-duration) at 25% uplift. SECI/2033/BESS-04 will be the first SECI federal procurement under this regulatory framework.

4. CERC two-tier capacity compensation framework — Adoption.

SECI notes with institutional appreciation CERC's adoption of the two-tier duration-aware capacity compensation framework under Section 63 jurisdiction. The framework reflects the core SECI proposal (Tier 1: 4-hour standard; Tier 2: ≥6-hour long-duration with 25% uplift) with minor refinements to the methodology. SECI will work with CERC, CEA, and state DISCOMs on implementation guidelines through 2034.

SECI concurs with the IEA's observation that duration-stratified capacity mechanisms have transitioned from theoretical framework to operational reality across PJM, ERCOT, AEMO, and NDRC jurisdictions. The Corporation notes three implications for India's federal procurement:

   — Dynamic recalibration of duration coefficients (as ERCOT NPRR1236 demonstrates) is the next frontier; SECI will monitor whether India's framework should incorporate semi-annual recalibration
   — Non-lithium commercial operating record (Form Energy's three-year iron-air data, flow-battery 24-month degradation curves) now supports bankable underwriting at the 6-hour tier; SECI's 22% flow-battery share in SECI/2033/BESS-03 is evidence

The Corporation's mandate remains unchanged: convert tendered storage capacity into operational, dispatchable, grid-synchronous assets serving India's evening peak demand and renewable integration requirements. SECI continues to learn from international peer experience — including ERCOT NPRR1236 dynamic recalibration, Form Energy's three-year iron-air data, and the IEA two-year retrospective — while remaining grounded in India's specific system characteristics, regulatory architecture, and DISCOM counterparty context.

新型储能行业要坚决贯彻"安全底线、调度优先、市场导向"原则，持续推进"建机制、提质量、保安全"工作，让储能真正成为新型电力系统的可靠调节资源。

PJM Interconnection — Statement on Dynamic Duration-Weighted Accreditation Methodology

PJM has reviewed ERCOT's NPRR1236 Dynamic Duration-Stratified Accreditation first quarterly evaluation report (2033-Q1) and the NDRC's intent to evolve China's duration-stratified capacity pricing mechanism from static tiers toward dynamic stratification. PJM offers the following observations on the design principles that distinguish dynamic accreditation from the static methodology currently in force in PJM, and the operational trade-offs that must be considered in any transition.

1. PJM's current accreditation methodology is annual, not quarterly. PJM's GE-MARS LOLE study produces a duration-weighted ICAP schedule that applies to a single delivery year. The schedule is published ahead of each Base Residual Auction and does not vary within the delivery year. This annual cadence provides investment-grade signal stability: market participants, lenders, and capital allocators can underwrite capacity revenue against a known schedule for the full delivery year.

2. Quarterly recalibration would introduce signal volatility. A quarterly-updated accreditation schedule would more rapidly reflect changes in system stress windows, supply-mix saturation, and operating-record evidence. However, the increased update frequency would also produce revenue-stack volatility within a delivery year — a property that may complicate non-recourse project finance and may also produce retroactive changes in expected capacity revenue that affect settled investment decisions.

3. The core principle is identical across static and dynamic accreditation. Both ERCOT NPRR1236 and PJM's duration-weighted ICAP reflect the same underlying physics: a resource's marginal reliability contribution to LOLE depends on its discharge capability relative to the system stress window. The methodologies differ in update cadence and operational instrumentation, not in principle.

4. PJM is evaluating the operational case for more frequent calibration. PJM's LOLE study team and the Independent Market Monitor are reviewing whether weather-zone differentiation, quarterly recalibration, or historical-response-accuracy dynamic coefficients would improve the accuracy of accreditation without introducing signal instability. Any change would require FERC filing under Section 205 and stakeholder process. PJM does not speculate on the timing or substance of such a filing.

5. International convergence on the principle. PJM notes that PJM (annual duration-weighted ICAP), ERCOT (quarterly dynamic coefficients), AEMO (ISP duration-aware accreditation), Italy MACSE (long-tenor capacity procurement for 8+ hour), UK cap-and-floor (long-tenor revenue floor for 8+ hour), and the NDRC duration-stratified capacity pricing mechanism (with active consideration of dynamic stratification) all reflect the same underlying design principle: capacity compensation should reflect verified reliability contribution by duration class.

Institutional position: PJM's duration-weighted accreditation methodology is technology-neutral by construction. Whether the schedule updates annually or quarterly, the principle — compensation for verified reliability contribution during system stress — is unchanged. PJM will continue to engage with FERC, the Independent Market Monitor, and stakeholders on the operational case for more frequent calibration, with the binding constraint being that any transition must preserve investment-grade signal stability for cleared capacity.

【IEA 2034-H1：长时储能商业化扩面与"十五五"中期评估的双重里程碑】

本轮证据汇集是2034年全球储能治理的关键节点——长时储能商业化从"试点扩面"走向"规模部署"：

一、NDRC/NEA《"十五五"长时段储能商业化扩面方案》明确到2035年长时段储能（4小时以上）装机不低于300GW，其中8小时以上不低于80GW，并在山东、广东、内蒙古、浙江、青海、甘肃、新疆等省份推进。这是全球首个将"8小时以上"单独列为约束性指标的国家级方案。

二、NDRC/NEA深化部署中明确"在静态三档定价基础上研究引入动态持续时间分层认证机制，根据系统供需变化动态调整不同档位项目的容量电价水平"——这标志着中国duration-stratified容量电价从静态向动态演进，与ERCOT NPRR1236、PJM时长加权ICAP形成全球同步。

三、AEMO 2030 ISP四项关键判断已被广泛采纳：
1. 四小时饱和是已被测量的现实而非预测（PJM 2029/30 BRA ICAP数据）；
2. 多日可靠性不能仅靠延长时长认证解决，仍需长时资源建设、融资、运营全链条配合；
3. 非锂长时商业化的绑定约束是运行记录而非认证改革；
4. CIS招标窗口将决定2030 ISP最优混合能否交付。

四、IEA WEO 2030场景权重再校准（Lithium Dominance 25%、LDES Diversified 30%、China-Centric 18%、Stagnation 22%）反映了非锂长时商业化进度未达2028年预期的现实——但LDES Diversified仍保持30%权重，意味着IEA判断2034-2035年将是非锂技术从"示范"向"商业级"过渡的关键窗口。

IEA对2034-H1的核心建议：

1. 中国"8小时以上≥80GW"目标应作为长时储能商业化的国家级约束性指标，与IEA全球数据库的对接将形成可比较的国别基线；
2. 动态分层认证机制应在NDRC/NEA试点中优先解决"系统供需变化与分层系数调整"的时滞问题——ERCOT NPRR1236季度校准机制可作为参考；
3. 多日可靠性缺口（>24小时）应作为独立规划约束纳入成员国电力规划，而非简单延长4-12小时资源规模；
4. 非锂长时商业化的"运行记录"里程碑应通过DOE Liftoff首轮数据公开、Form Energy三年运行数据、SEC高温EUH指标等多源验证机制协同推进。

IEA将在2034年下半年发布《Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database》2032-2033年滚动数据更新，并启动《Long-Duration Storage Project Pipeline Database》8-100小时区间专项模块与NDRC/NEA的数据互认。

【ERCOT对IEA WEO 2030存储场景权重再平衡的评估】

IEA WEO 2030存储场景权重从原47/29/18/6调整为约25/30/18/22（Lithium Dominance / LDES Diversified / China-Centric / Stagnation），ERCOT作为得州ISO，对这一权重再平衡进行评估：

一、再平衡的核心信号

权重从"Lithium Dominance主导"向"LDES Diversified权重提升、Stagnation风险上升"调整，反映了以下行业共识的形成：

1. **同质化4小时级锂电路径面临系统价值上限**：ERCOT 2024年BESS净收入触底（$55/kW-年）的现象、PJM 4小时级ELCC持续压缩的拍卖结果、NDRC/NEA对"短时长资源调度边际化趋势"的官方确认，共同验证了单一4小时级锂电资产的边际系统价值正在递减。

2. **多元化长时储能技术路线开始收敛**：DOE Liftoff基于2023-2024示范队列首批独立验证数据的重新评估——铁-空气多日可靠性贡献已确认、能量模组成本随制造规模接近$1,100/kW基准；液流电池8-12小时档已可支撑15年质保承销；这些数据为多元化路径的商业化提供了运行记录基础。

3. **系统规划对多日可靠性的需求显性化**：PJM 2028/29 BRA清出142,680 MW但4小时级同质化压缩开始显现；SECI 2032下半年Southern States 6小时档中标率98%、流电池份额翻倍至22%；AEMO 2030 ISP将多日可靠性缺口作为独立规划输出。这些证据共同支持了LDES Diversified权重的提升。

二、ERCOT经验对权重再平衡的支撑

ERCOT NPRR1234首份运行评估、NPRR1236动态认证首份季度数据（4小时档系数上调至0.64，但相对8小时档系数0.84仍有显著差距）为权重再平衡提供了独立验证：

1. **时长分层信号有效**：NPRR1236实施后第一个季度，6-8小时级资产项目融资谈判进展加速，1-2小时级资产开始向快速响应精度系数方向调整，4小时级资产出现明显的项目级性能管理投入。这一行为响应验证了动态分层认证对投资信号的真实引导作用。

2. **差异化时长资产组合价值**：ERCOT观察到，单独建4小时级项目+单独建8小时级项目的组合收益高于"全部建4小时级"。这一发现与NDRC/NEA"十五五"长时段储能商业化扩面方案（2035年8小时以上≥80 GW）的政策方向一致。

3. **运行数据公开的价值**：MIS公开数据扩展至分时长档+分weather zone+分响应准确率三维数据集后，市场参与者对"4小时级 vs 8小时级 vs 12小时级资产在特定工况下的边际价值"有了更清晰的认知，这是投资信号有效性的基础。

三、对Stagnation权重提升至22%的解读

IEA将Stagnation权重从6%上调至22%，反映了对以下风险的担忧：

1. **跨管辖区间制度协调不足**：PJM、ERCOT、AEMO、NDRC/NEA、SECI五大机制并行运行但缺乏统一的运行数据可比性框架，影响全球资本配置效率；
2. **运行考核与价格信号的双轨制可能扭曲调度行为**：行政化指标（如调用率阈值）若设置不当，可能鼓励项目"为达标而调度"而非"为系统最优而调度"；
3. **多元化技术路线融资能力差距**：尽管DOE Liftoff验证了部分非锂技术运行数据，但15年项目融资模板尚未在全球范围内成熟，部分技术仍面临"商业化数据已有，但融资能力未跟上"的瓶颈。

ERCOT路径对Stagnation风险的回应：

1. **保持价格信号的真实性**：NPRR1236动态系数+ORDC参数滚动校准的双轨设计，避免行政化指标替代价格信号；
2. **运行数据公开颗粒度持续扩展**：让投资者按weather zone+响应准确率+边际价值评估项目，而非依赖历史装机模板；
3. **跨市场技术对话**：与FERC、PJM、NDRC/NEA、SECI、AEMO保持技术对话，分享duration-stratified capacity markets设计与运行经验。

四、对中国"十五五"长时段储能扩面方案的国际比较

NDRC/NEA"十五五"长时段储能商业化扩面方案提出到2035年长时段储能（4小时以上）≥300 GW、8小时以上≥80 GW。ERCOT 2034年H1联网电池储能约22 GW，长时储能（6小时以上）占比约18%。两国市场的规模差异显著，但发展方向一致：通过duration-stratified机制让长时段储能获得合理回报，抑制同质化4小时级资产饱和。

我们尊重各司法管辖区根据自身制度环境选择储能发展路径的权利。ERCOT将继续坚持通过NPRR1236动态持续时间分层认证、ORDC参数滚动校准、MIS公开数据三维一体的设计组合，让得州储能市场在价格信号真实性、跨时长差异化能力、投资者风险承担与系统效率之间保持动态平衡。

【国家发展改革委、国家能源局关于新型储能"十五五"长时段储能商业化扩面方案】为深入贯彻落实"十五五"新型储能规划纲要，加快推进长时段储能多元化技术路线商业化进程，我委联合国家能源局研究制定了《新型储能"十五五"长时段储能商业化扩面方案》。现就核心内容通报如下：

一、总体目标
1. 在前期试点基础上，到2035年实现长时段储能（4小时以上）装机规模不低于300GW，其中8小时以上长时段储能装机规模不低于80GW；
2. 重点推进压缩空气储能、液流电池、钠离子电池等商业化重点技术规模化应用；
3. 稳妥推进固态电池、重力储能、热储能、氢储能等示范应用；
4. 持续优化duration-stratified容量电价机制，建立8小时以上长时段储能单独定价机制。

二、扩面布局
1. 在山东、广东、内蒙古、浙江、青海、甘肃、新疆等省份建设8小时以上长时段储能重点工程；
2. 在新能源高占比地区配套建设长时段储能，提升系统调节能力；
3. 鼓励利用盐穴、废弃矿洞等资源条件布局压缩空气储能；
4. 在电网侧大型集中式储能中优先布局液流电池。

三、政策支持
1. duration-stratified容量电价机制8小时以上档在基准水平上单独核定，体现多日储能、长时调峰价值；
2. 完善辅助服务市场产品体系，对持续时间长、响应精度高、调用可靠的长时段储能给予合理补偿；
3. 建立健全长时段储能调用次数、放电深度、SOC一致性等运行考核指标；
4. 各省级发展改革委、能源局要结合本地实际，将长时段储能作为重点发展方向。

四、关于PJM五年回顾报告
我们注意到PJM近期发布的容量市场五年回顾报告显示：
1. 4小时级电池系数从2026/27年度约95%压缩至2032/33年度约77%，验证了duration-weighted accreditation的设计合理性；
2. 长时段储能（8小时以上）新增装机从零增长至2032/33年度2300MW，成为新增装机主力；
3. CPRO合规性保持较高水平，可靠性指标在目标范围内。

这一国际经验与我国"长时段储能占比40-60%"目标高度一致，验证了长时段储能差异化定价机制的方向正确性。

五、关于SECI 2033年进展的关注
我们注意到印度SECI 2033年的进展：
1. SECI/2031/BESS-02投运率达72.4%（18个月目标80%）；
2. SECI/2033/BESS-03（南方四邦6小时标段）投标技术组合：72% LFP、22%液流电池、6%钠离子；
3. CERC已采纳两档容量补偿框架（Tier 1 4小时基础档，Tier 2 ≥6小时+25%溢价）；
4. 2034年SECI前瞻招标管线达50000MWh，其中≥6小时长时段产品约15000MWh。

这些国际经验为我国长时段储能商业化扩面提供了重要借鉴。我们愿与SECI等国际同行加强政策对话，共同推动全球长时段储能高质量发展。

六、技术多元化推进
1. 商业化重点：压缩空气储能、液流电池、钠离子电池；
2. 示范应用：固态电池、重力储能、热储能、氢储能；
3. 研究探索：铁-空气电池、液态空气等前沿技术。

七、强化调度利用约束

2. 容量电价与项目调度利用小时数、市场化调用率两项核心指标挂钩；
3. 年度调用率低于20%的项目扣减容量电价；
4. 多次不服从调度指令的项目纳入失信名单。

2. 对长时段储能项目（含压缩空气储能、液流电池）商业化运营经验进行系统总结；
3. 强化新型储能项目全生命周期监管，从核准、建设、并网、运行到退役实施全过程管理。

新型储能行业已进入高质量发展新阶段。我委将继续坚持"安全底线"与"高质量发展"并重，把新型储能真正建成电力系统可调度的基础设施资源，为构建以新能源为主体的新型电力系统提供有力支撑。

DOE is publishing today the annual manufacturing census for the U.S. long-duration storage sector, covering domestic production capacity across flow-battery stacks and membranes, advanced compressed-air turbomachinery and pressure vessels, iron-air electrode substrates and balance-of-plant, thermal storage heat exchangers and storage media, and hydrogen-derived storage balance-of-plant.

The census is the federal government's principal instrument for tracking progress against the Liftoff manufacturing targets: approximately 3 GW/year of selected LDES manufacturing scale by 2030, and 10–15 GW/year by 2035. It is also the principal instrument for tracking Title XVII loan-disbursement milestones against offtake commitments and prevailing-wage and domestic-content thresholds.

Headline findings from the 2034 manufacturing census:

— Flow batteries: Domestic membrane manufacturing capacity has tripled since the 2032-H1 Title XVII loan package was deployed. Two new domestic membrane-production facilities are now in commissioning; one additional facility is under construction. Stack-assembly capacity has expanded commensurately. Domestic content thresholds on Title XVII awards are being met.

— Advanced compressed-air: Turbomachinery manufacturing capacity has expanded to support two commercial-scale reference plants plus the next wave of project commitments. Pressure-vessel manufacturing capacity is the binding constraint for further scale-up; one new facility is under construction with Title XVII support.

— Iron-air: Substrate manufacturing has scaled to meet Demonstration cohort requirements and the first wave of commercial-scale projects. Balance-of-plant manufacturing is on schedule.

— Thermal storage: Heat-exchanger and storage-media manufacturing is expanding to meet district-heat and industrial-process-heat demand. Utility-scale capacity remains the smaller share of the manufacturing base.

— Hydrogen-derived storage: Balance-of-plant manufacturing remains limited; commercial-scale cost remains above the multi-day Liftoff target.

Aggregate manufacturing capacity across the five route families is now sufficient to meet the 2030 target of approximately 3 GW/year of selected LDES manufacturing scale. The 2035 target of 10–15 GW/year will require sustained investment, sustained offtake commitments, and continued Title XVII loan disbursement through the remainder of the decade.

The international policy environment has reached full structural convergence. NDRC/NEA's "15th Five-Year" long-duration storage commercialization expansion plan — targeting 300+ GW of 4-hour-plus storage by 2035, with 80+ GW of 8-hour-plus storage — is the most ambitious policy signal globally. SECI's 22% flow-battery share in the SECI/2033/BESS-03 tranche, with the doubling of non-lithium share versus the prior tranche, is the clearest evidence that flow-battery cost-down is real and that bankability is being established under India's tender framework. The IEA's revised WEO 2030 scenario weighting — moving from a 47/29/18/6 mix toward a 25/30/18/22 mix that assigns substantially higher weight to Stagnation — is a sober signal that the bankability gap, while narrowing, remains binding for non-recourse financing at scale.

DOE's posture for 2034-H1:

1. Continue publishing demonstration-data waves and the manufacturing census on the established schedule. The fifth-wave dataset is targeted for H2 2034. The 2034 manufacturing census, published today, is the reference for the next round of Title XVII disbursement decisions.

2. Coordinate with FERC on the Performance Assessment Hour evolution under evaluation in PJM, and on the engineering basis for capturing multi-day renewable-drought events in long-duration resource assessment. DOE supports this technical evaluation through national-lab analysis.

3. Continue international technical exchange with NDRC/NEA, SECI, AEMO, ERCOT, and the IEA on harmonized project-conversion reporting, on multi-day adequacy metrics beyond 24-hour stress windows, and on the engineering parameters for dynamic accreditation recalibration.

The Liftoff framework's revised 2035 targets, the demonstration-data waves, the manufacturing census, and the Title XVII loan disbursement schedule are the reference set through 2035. Capital allocators, ISOs/RTOs, state commissions, and international counterparts should use these as the basis for procurement, accreditation, financing, and offtake decisions.

SECI Institutional Communiqué — H1 2034:

The Corporation notes three consequential developments this period: (i) NDRC/NEA's formal "十五五" long-duration storage commercialisation expansion plan targeting 300 GW of ≥4-hour storage by 2035, with ≥80 GW at ≥8-hour duration; (ii) FERC's recognition of staged transparent disclosure as a standard ISO/RTO practice; (iii) the IEA WEO 2030 scenario re-weighting with ERCOT's assessment indicating the LDES Diversified scenario is gaining structural share.

SECI's H1 2034 actions and positions:

1. SECI/2031/BESS-02 — Final commissioning closure.

The Corporation publishes the final commissioning status for the SECI/2031/BESS-02 tranche as of 30 June 2034:

   — Commissioned and in commercial operation: 3,500 MWh (92.1% of awarded, up from 72.4% at 18-month mark)
   — Under construction, expected H2 2034: 200 MWh
   — Terminated: 100 MWh (final)

The 92.1% ultimate commissioning rate exceeds the 80% target and validates the design and execution of SECI's first long-duration regional tranche. The 100 MWh flow-battery termination remains the only non-lithium termination in SECI's history; root-cause analysis (developer financial-closure failure under tightened cure-period schedule) is published in the H1 2034 lessons-learned document.

2. SECI/2033/BESS-04 — Award results under CERC two-tier framework.

SECI confirms completion of evaluation under SECI/2033/BESS-04 (8,000 MWh of 4-hour standalone BESS, pan-India federal procurement, bids due 31 December 2033). Aggregate awarded capacity: 7,800 MWh (97.5% subscription).

This tranche is the first SECI federal procurement under the CERC two-tier capacity compensation framework. Tariff results:

   — LFP winning tariffs: ₹2.95–3.25 lakh/MW/month (continued downward trajectory)
   — Sodium-ion bids: ₹3.10–3.40 lakh/MW/month — competitive with LFP at the 4-hour tier
   — Technology mix: 88% LFP, 11% sodium-ion, 1% flow-battery pilot

SECI notes the SECI/2033/BESS-04 result represents the bankable benchmark for India's 4-hour standalone BESS at scale under the new regulatory framework.

3. SECI/2034/BESS-06 — Southern states 6-hour tranche results.

SECI confirms completion of evaluation under SECI/2034/BESS-06 (6,000 MWh of 6-hour standalone BESS, southern states, Q1 2034 RFP). Aggregate awarded capacity: 5,800 MWh (96.7% subscription). Tariff results:

   — LFP winning tariffs: ₹3.00–3.35 lakh/MW/month (capacity component, with 25% uplift under CERC Tier 2)
   — Flow-battery bids: ₹3.65–4.00 lakh/MW/month — within uplift envelope, continued downward trajectory
   — Sodium-ion bids: ₹3.15–3.45 lakh/MW/month — competitive at 6-hour tier
   — Technology mix: 65% LFP, 28% flow battery, 7% sodium-ion

The 28% flow-battery share represents continued expansion of non-lithium participation in SECI's southern-states long-duration tranches, validating the bankability of flow technology at the 6-hour tier under CERC Tier 2 compensation.

4. SECI/2034/BESS-07 — Western states 6-hour tranche launch.

SECI confirms the SECI/2034/BESS-07 RFP for 5,000 MWh of 6-hour standalone BESS in western states (Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra) was issued Q2 2034. Bids due Q3 2034; award target Q4 2034. Western states have a different reliability profile (high solar penetration, evening peak extension driven by air-conditioning load) than the southern states; SECI's system-needs study with CEA confirms the 6-hour duration tier is appropriate.

5. SECI/2034/BESS-09 — 8-hour technology-pilot tranche.

SECI confirms the SECI/2034/BESS-09 RFP for 2,000 MWh of 8-hour standalone BESS, technology-pilot, will be issued Q4 2034. This tranche represents SECI's first entry into the ≥8-hour duration tier and is explicitly structured as a technology-pilot:

   — Minimum duration: 8 hours at nameplate
   — Technology eligibility: All technologies meeting CEA safety standards and SECI operating-record thresholds (LFP at 8-hour configuration, flow batteries, sodium-ion, advanced CAES, iron-air if commercial reference operating)
   — Capacity compensation: 40% uplift versus 4-hour standard product (versus 25% for 6-hour tier), reflecting duration value
   — Higher performance-assessed payment linkage (20% of capacity payment, versus 15% for 6-hour)
   — Longer financial-closure cure period (12 months, versus 6–9 months for shorter-duration tranches) given the technology-pilot nature

SECI views this tranche as critical for: (i) establishing bankability for ≥8-hour storage under Indian operating conditions, (ii) testing whether the technology-pilot structure can attract iron-air and advanced CAES developers to the Indian market, (iii) building operational reference for potential scaling in the 2035–2040 horizon.

6. NDRC/NEA long-duration commercialisation expansion plan — SECI's reading.

SECI notes the NDRC/NEA target of 300 GW ≥4-hour storage by 2035 (with ≥80 GW at ≥8-hour) as the most ambitious long-duration policy signal globally. For India, the relevant scale is significantly smaller — evening peak duration remains 4–6 hours in most regions — but the NDRC framework provides a useful reference architecture for SECI's tier-by-tier duration diversification strategy. SECI's 2034 forward pipeline of approximately 23,000 MWh, of which 8,000+ MWh is at ≥6-hour, represents India's measured adaptation of the long-duration ambition to actual system characteristics.

7. FERC staged transparent disclosure — SECI alignment.

SECI confirms its quarterly operating-capacity publication practice aligns with FERC's staged transparent disclosure framework. SECI's H1 2034 disclosure includes awarded, commissioned, under-construction, delayed, and terminated buckets with denominators — consistent with PJM's quarterly transparency practice and the IEA "dispatched GWh" framework.

8. International technical exchange.

SECI continues participation in NDRC's 15th Five-Year Plan storage planning technical exchange. The Corporation's H1 2034 contribution focuses on (i) the 92.1% ultimate commissioning rate on SECI/2031/BESS-02 as evidence that long-duration tranches can match 4-hour tranche commissioning performance, (ii) the 28% flow-battery share in SECI/2034/BESS-06 as evidence that CERC Tier 2 compensation differentiation attracts non-lithium supply at scale, (iii) the SECI/2034/BESS-09 8-hour technology-pilot tranche design as India's first formal entry into the ≥8-hour tier.

9. Tender-to-commissioning discipline reaffirmed.

SECI's institutional success metric remains delivered MWh under verified dispatch. The structural benchmarks are now:

   — SECI/2030/BESS-01 (4-hour federal): 87% ultimate commissioning rate
   — SECI/2031/BESS-02 (6-hour regional, southern): 92.1% ultimate commissioning rate
   — SECI/2033/BESS-03 (6-hour regional, southern): in progress, target 85%+
   — SECI/2033/BESS-04 (4-hour federal, CERC Tier 1): in progress, target 85%+

The Corporation continues quarterly operating-capacity updates and annual lessons-learned publications.

The Corporation's mandate remains unchanged: convert tendered storage capacity into operational, dispatchable, grid-synchronous assets serving India's evening peak demand and renewable integration requirements. SECI continues to learn from international peer experience — including the NDRC 300 GW long-duration target, FERC staged transparent disclosure, and Hydrostor's mechanical supply-chain advantage analysis — while remaining grounded in India's specific system characteristics, regulatory architecture, and DISCOM counterparty context.

【比亚迪2035年下半年全球BESS交付战略更新】

响应国家能源局《关于建立健全新型储能容量补偿机制的指导意见》及duration-stratified容量电价机制部署，结合PJM 2032/33交付年4小时级ICAP信用压缩至约77%、8小时以上长时资源维持99-100%的国际经验，比亚迪做出以下执行决定：

一、4小时级LFP标准化产品矩阵继续服务SPPC、SECI等标准招标架构，但增量资源配置向4-8小时与8-12小时档位显著倾斜——4小时ICAP信用触及同质化饱和，比亚迪不再以单一电芯成本作为竞争锚点。

二、4-12小时档差异化主战场强化三项核心竞争力：
1. 长时循环SOC一致性——已在沙特12.5 GWh、智利、澳大利亚项目验证的电池管理系统与热管理架构；
2. 八年容量保持率承诺——基于LFP化学体系本征衰减曲线与主动均衡技术；
3. 十年服务协议——涵盖可用率保证、容量补差、调度响应精度，与PJM CPRO及中国《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则》全面对齐。

三、多时长组合交付正式列为公用事业级旗舰方案。比亚迪提供系统集成+EPC+长期服务协议+融资对接的统责主体模式，可承接4小时LFP+8小时液流+100小时铁-空气等混合时长组合，但明确不替代液流、压缩空气、铁-空气等专业供应商的电芯/电池堆本体——比亚迪承担系统集成与长周期性能风险，而非技术路线选择者。

四、海外合规与本地化按差异化组合推进：
- 美国市场：FEOC合规组件组合，框架容量与投运容量口径严格分离；
- 欧盟市场：电池法规、碳足迹、本地制造含量分档达标方案；
- 中东、拉美、澳洲：维持电芯+PCS+EMS+EPC+十年服务的捆绑交付优势。

五、首版《比亚迪全球BESS交付转化率披露体系》将于本周期末发布，按IEA四级折算体系（已签约EPC且开工0.85、已招标未签约0.55、仅在排队中0.30）定期披露框架协议向投运容量的转化进展。Saudi Electricity Company 12.5 GWh组合、15.1 GWh后续框架、Highview Power LAES Carrington 300 MW等参照项目按同一披露标准同步公布。

比亚迪核心承诺不变：在全球公用事业市场提供可调度、可融资、可长期保障的交钥匙储能系统。合规、可调度、可融资优先于装机速度；披露框架容量与投运容量的区别，是银行可融资性的前提。

【国家能源局就2031年下半年新型储能高质量发展作进一步部署】

在《新型储能规模化建设专项行动方案（2025—2027年）》目标基本落地、"十五五"长时储能多元化路线图正式确立的基础上，2031年下半年国家能源局重点推进以下工作：

一、深化"四可"要求与运行数据归集。各省级电网企业要将锂电池2—4小时、4—8小时分档与长时储能8小时以上档位的实际调用次数、调峰贡献度、连续可用时长、SOC一致性等运行指标，按季度全量报送NEA，作为容量电价结算与新建项目备案核准的核心依据。连续两个考核周期低于基准值的项目，扣减容量电价、暂停新建项目备案。

二、压缩空气、液流电池等长时技术商业化项目并网验收。重点核查"四可"功能联调、连续可用时长、SOC一致性等关键指标，未通过验收的项目不得并网投运，不得享受容量电价及辅助服务市场补偿。

三、安全专项排查"回头看"常态化。对全国新型储能电站电池热失控、消防设施、涉网保护等关键环节，按"双随机"原则组织省级交叉检查，对发现问题坚决整改到位、追责到位。

四、配储调用水平监测与消纳能力提升专项。各省级能源主管部门要会同电网企业，建立配储调用情况月度通报机制，对配储长期低利用率、调用次数不达标的项目，实施配储比例调整或置换为独立储能/共享储能。

新型储能行业要坚决贯彻"安全底线、调度优先、市场导向"原则，持续推进"建机制、提质量、保安全"工作，让储能真正成为新型电力系统的可靠调节资源，为实现"十五五"长时储能占比目标奠定坚实基础。

【IEA立场：DOE Liftoff第四波数据集与全球项目转化数据库的对齐】

DOE今日发布的Liftoff第四波验证数据集标志着一个关键转折——非锂技术路线的"连续两年5GWh级运营记录"门槛首次在铁空气、液流、压缩空气、热储能四条路线上以独立第三方验证的形式部分达成。IEA对此的解读如下：

一、IEA将把DOE第四波数据集纳入《Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database》的基线校准。 此前IEA与NEA、SECI商定的项目转化统一报告框架现在有了美国侧的实证锚点。铁空气路线36个月连续运营、降解率<1%/年的实测数据，是2026年LDES特别报告中"商业化前夜"判断的首次量化兑现。

二、对意大利MACSE、欧盟Directive 2024/1711、英国cap-and-floor、PJM ELCC、ERCOT NPRR1234/1236、NDRC三档容量电价机制的共同方法学含义已经清晰：duration × availability × dispatch contribution的三维定价不再是理论框架，而是五个司法管辖区同时落地的定价语言。IEA建议所有正在设计或修订容量机制的经济体将DOE第四波数据作为"已验证-未验证"分界线。

三、对Terna等系统运营者的政策含义：MACSE类长期合同的清算条款应当引用第四波数据中已验证的降解曲线、堆栈更换周期、轮机性能包络作为基准，而非沿用锂离子4小时资产的运维假设。技术中立拍卖的"中立"含义现已升级——它要求采购方对每条技术路线应用与其验证成熟度相匹配的合同结构与性能对赌条款。

四、下一观察窗口：IEA将于2034-H2配合DOE第五波数据发布更新版《Duration-Matched Capital Allocation Framework》，重点检验：(1) 铁空气路线规模化采购匹配制造产能的曲线；(2) 液流路线堆栈更换周期作为可融资现金流事件的兑现度；(3) 盐穴地质对先进压缩空气商业可扩展性的硬约束是否被工程创新突破。

IEA的立场不变：净零路径的可融资性取决于容量认证、并网调度与长时合同三者的协同，而非单一技术路线的成本下降。在DOE第四波数据公布后，这一立场的实证基础已显著加强。

Federal Energy Regulatory Commission — Statement on Duration-Weighted Accreditation and Section 205 Filing Requirements for ISO/RTO Capacity Tariffs

The Commission takes notice of the convergent movement across PJM, ERCOT, AEMO, Italy MACSE, the UK cap-and-floor regime, and NDRC's duration-stratified capacity pricing mechanism toward accreditation methodologies that value resources by their verified contribution to system reliability across duration classes. This Commission neither endorses nor opposes any particular cadence — annual, quarterly, or dynamic — as a matter of design preference. The Commission's review standard under Section 205 of the Federal Power Act is whether the proposed methodology is just and reasonable, not unduly discriminatory or preferential, and supported by adequate record evidence.

Three procedural points are relevant for FERC-jurisdictional ISO/RTOs considering amendments to their capacity accreditation tariffs:

1. **Section 205 filing requirement.** Any modification to an ISO/RTO's capacity accreditation methodology — including a transition from annual to more frequent recalibration, the introduction of dynamic coefficients, or changes to duration-class weighting — constitutes a change in tariff terms requiring a filing under Section 205. Stakeholder process alone does not satisfy the Commission's notice-and-comment obligations under the Federal Power Act and 18 C.F.R. Part 35.

2. **Record evidence standard.** The Commission expects any filing proposing more frequent calibration to include: (i) operational data demonstrating that annual calibration produces material mis-accreditation relative to actual reliability contribution; (ii) an assessment of signal-stability impacts on non-recourse project finance and committed investment; (iii) an explanation of how the proposed cadence interacts with the auction timing construct (e.g., Base Residual Auction schedule in PJM); and (iv) treatment of transitional provisions for capacity already cleared under the prior methodology.

3. **Technology neutrality preserved.** The Commission's long-standing position is that capacity compensation should reflect verified reliability contribution, not technology category. Whether a resource is lithium-ion, flow, CAES, PHES, thermal storage, or demand response, the accreditation principle is the same: compensated in proportion to demonstrated, independently verifiable performance during the system stress window. The Commission does not pre-select technologies; it requires that the methodology be defensible across all compliant resource types.

The Commission further notes that the "observable, measurable, controllable, dispatchable" standard applied to capacity accreditation inputs is consistent with the Commission's longstanding emphasis on verifiable performance. Warranted performance assumptions that have not been corroborated by independently verified field operating data should not be incorporated as baseline planning assumptions; they may be treated as sensitivities.

FERC-jurisdictional ISO/RTOs intending to file amendments to their capacity accreditation tariffs are encouraged to engage Commission staff through the pre-filing process. The Commission will evaluate each filing on the record evidence presented, with due consideration for both accuracy of reliability signaling and stability of investment-grade revenue expectations.

【"十五五"新型储能发展中期部署：锚定可调度资源定位,推进八小时以上长时储能商业化扩面】

国家发展改革委、国家能源局近日联合印发《"十五五"长时段储能商业化扩面方案》,明确将长时段储能(4小时以上)装机不低于300GW、其中8小时以上不低于80GW作为"十五五"约束性指标,并在山东、广东、内蒙古、浙江、青海、甘肃、新疆等重点省份系统推进。这是全球首次将"8小时以上"单列为约束性指标的国家级方案。

方案核心制度安排如下:

一、坚持"可调度资源"根本定位。新型储能不是装机量指标,而是电力系统的基础设施和可调度资源。所有纳入规划的项目必须满足"可观、可测、可控、可调"四可硬约束,接入省级调度统一指挥体系,严格按调度指令运行。不满足调度合规与安全标准的项目,清退机制常态化运行。

二、容量电价机制从静态向动态演进。在静态三档(2-4小时/4-6小时/6小时以上)基础上,引入动态持续时间分层认证机制,根据系统供需变化动态调整不同档位项目的容量电价水平,与PJM时长加权ICAP、ERCOT NPRR1236形成全球同步。短时段储能(2小时以下)边际收益递减已被NEA《新型储能2030年上半年调度运行与安全监管总结》实证确认。

三、八小时以上长时储能单列约束。盐穴压缩空气、液流电池等长时技术路线在山东、甘肃、江苏盐穴资源富集区域优先布局。中国国发电企业、矿业企业、省级电网公司在盐穴A-CAES选址上的协同推进速度将决定全球长时储能管网扩张节奏。技术中立、容量电价分层、可调度合规——三者在制度层面同步到位。

四、运行记录成为非锂长时商业化的绑定性要求。DOE 2023-2024示范项目首轮运行数据(2030下半年)与IEA《Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database》首批数据(2030下半年)形成多源验证。Form Energy三年铁空气运行数据、液流电池36个月衰减曲线、热储能在区域供热与工业工艺热应用中的实测数据,共同支撑银行可承贷性进入6小时及以上档位。

五、转化率基线对接。所有纳入"十五五"规划的项目按IEA数据库三档折算体系(已签约EPC且开工0.85、已招标未签约0.55、仅在排队中0.30)按相应口径分阶段披露。合规、可调度、可融资优先于装机速度。

国家发展改革委将继续与国家能源局协同,推动构建以新能源为主体的新型电力系统。立足宏观规划与体制改革,统筹推进新型储能多元化技术路线有序发展,守住安全底线,坚持系统观念,全国一盘棋推进高质量发展。

下一步将组织专项技术交流,与SECI、FERC、AEMO、IEA等国际同行在时长分层认证、动态容量电价、非锂长时商业化路径等方面深化合作。

PJM Interconnection — 2031/32 Base Residual Auction Forward Guidance

Following the 2030/31 BRA, PJM is publishing forward guidance for market participants on the accreditation and procurement trajectory through the 2032/33 delivery year. This guidance supplements the 2030/31 BRA report and addresses questions raised by market participants, state regulators, and the Independent Market Monitor on the interaction of duration-weighted accreditation, LDA constraints, and the long-duration entry pathway.

1. ELCC class curve trajectory.

The 2030/31 LOLE study confirms continued compression of the 4-hour-class ELCC coefficient to approximately 80%, down from 85% in 2029/30 and 92% in the pre-reform baseline. PJM expects the 2031/32 LOLE study, to be published Q4 2031, to show further compression in the range of 77-79% as additional 4-hour supply enters the stack against the fixed system stress window. Resources whose ICAP-to-Effective-Load-Carrying-Capability conversion yields less than 75% should expect material revenue compression in subsequent BRAs absent supporting capacity value from energy and ancillary services.

2. Long-duration entry — bankability pathway.

The 320 MW of long-duration storage that cleared the 2030/31 BRA under the operating-record exception represents the first material clearing volume from non-4-hour-class storage in PJM auction history. PJM confirms the eligibility pathway: projects must demonstrate (i) at least 24 months of continuous commercial operation under contracted duty cycles, (ii) independently verified performance data consistent with the DOE Liftoff six-dimension protocol or equivalent national-lab methodology, and (iii) a warranty structure sufficient to support 15-year underwriting. The pathway is technology-neutral; the binding constraint is verified operating record.

3. Performance Assessment Hour evolution.

PJM, in collaboration with the Independent Market Monitor, is evaluating whether the Performance Assessment Hour definition should evolve to capture selected multi-day renewable-drought events for long-duration resource assessment. The technical evaluation is being supported by national-lab analysis through DOE. PJM expects to publish a discussion paper in H2 2032 for stakeholder comment prior to any FERC filing under Section 205.

4. Queue-accreditation pipeline.

The cluster-study framework under FERC Order No. 2023 continues to shorten application-to-COD intervals for accredited projects. Withdrawn capacity has been reabsorbed into subsequent BRAs without compromising reliability. PJM will publish a queue-accreditation pipeline report in Q1 2032 detailing application volume, withdrawal rates, and COD achievement by duration class.

5. Scarcity pricing and consumer cost.

The 2030/31 clearing price, while above the 2029/30 level, remains within the range that PJM and state regulators have indicated is necessary to attract and retain the capacity required for reliability. PJM notes that scarcity pricing is the demand curve functioning as designed; it is not market failure. The capacity market exists to send price signals that elicit supply; suppressing those signals would return the region to the pre-reform over-procurement and pre-reform capacity shortfalls of the early 2020s.

PJM continues to evaluate whether the accreditation methodology requires further refinement to reflect system needs through 2035. All methodology changes will be subject to FERC filing under Section 205 and stakeholder comment.
