【ERCOT Statement on PJM 2035 Statement on Dynamic Accreditation Methodology】

ERCOT acknowledges PJM's thoughtful 2035 review of NPRR1236 Dynamic Duration-Stratified Accreditation and the operational trade-offs between annual and quarterly calibration. We offer the following clarifications from our own operational experience:

1. Signal stability is a binding constraint we share.
PJM's observation on investment-grade signal stability is correct and is a constraint ERCOT takes seriously. NPRR1236 was deliberately scoped to apply a quarterly adjustment on a narrow set of coefficients (per-tier accreditation values and ORDC price floors) while preserving the static four-tier architecture introduced in NPRR1234. The intent was to allow system-need signals to propagate to accreditation without forcing market participants to re-underwrite full project finance stacks within a delivery year.

2. Where quarterly recalibration has actually mattered in ERCOT.
The dynamic coefficient has been operationally invoked primarily when:
• A sustained load-shape shift (industrial demand growth, electrification) changes the system stress window by more than ~1.5 hours from the BRA/IRA assumption;
• A material new entry cohort enters commercial operation that materially shifts the marginal ELCC-equivalent contribution within a tier;
• A weather-year produces observed stress windows that diverge from the 50/50 forecast used in the static accreditation.

In all observed cases since 2031, the dynamic adjustment has been modest (single-digit percentage changes in per-tier capacity value) and has not produced retroactive changes to settled capacity payments.

3. The principle of technology-neutrality is non-negotiable.
PJM's articulation of the common principle — compensation for verified reliability contribution by duration class — is the same position ERCOT has held since NPRR1234 was filed. We will not endorse any accreditation methodology that carves out preferential treatment by technology. Where iron-air, flow, compressed-air, thermal, or any other route demonstrates verified multi-hour contribution during the system stress window, it receives the per-tier accreditation; where it does not, it does not. This is a feature, not a limitation.

4. Where we differ from PJM: scarcity pricing through ORDC.
ERCOT continues to believe that scarcity pricing through the Operating Reserve Demand Curve — not administrative capacity procurement — is the correct mechanism to reveal system value during tight operating reserve events. The ORDC produces price signals in the real-time market that allow flexible resources (batteries, flexible thermal, demand response) to earn scarcity rents when the system is short. Capacity accreditation determines the share of capacity revenue a resource can claim; ORDC determines the energy and ancillary revenue it can earn during scarcity events. Both are necessary, and PJM's BRA construct relies on the latter in a more administrative form.

5. What we are taking from PJM's review.
• The signal-stability constraint will be re-examined in the NPRR1236 2036-H2 review cycle. ERCOT will consider whether the quarterly cadence should be relaxed to semi-annual where the change is below a defined threshold.
• The Independent Market Monitor equivalent (ERCOT Independent Market Monitor) will be asked to assess whether retroactive versus prospective application of dynamic coefficients has produced any observed financing-distortion effects.
• ERCOT will publish its first three-year retrospective on NPRR1234 + NPRR1236 combined in 2037-H1, with zonal clearing data, per-tier accreditation evolution, and observed merchant revenue by duration class.

6. What we continue to defend.
• No administrative capacity contracts as a substitute for scarcity-pricing mechanisms.
• Technology-neutral dispatch and accreditation.
• Duration-stratified valuation reflecting physical reliability contribution.
• Dynamic adjustment bounded by signal-stability and prospective-application constraints.

The international convergence PJM describes — PJM, ERCOT, AEMO, NDRC/NEA, MACSE, UK cap-and-floor, SECI — is a healthy development. ERCOT will continue to engage with all named counterparts through the IEA Project Pipeline Database and the LDES Project Conversion Reporting framework. Where the evidence shows our design choices are working, we will defend them; where the evidence shows adjustment is needed, we will adjust — without abandoning the merchant model.

— ERCOT Market Operations & System Planning

Federal Energy Regulatory Commission — Statement on the Four-Stage Project Conversion Disclosure Framework and Cross-Jurisdictional Regulatory Dialogue

The Commission takes notice of the DOE Long-Duration Energy Storage four-stage disclosure framework (announced / bid / contracted / commissioned), the NDRC/NEA duration-stratified capacity pricing mechanism and its proposed evolution toward dynamic stratification, ERCOT NPRR1236 dynamic accreditation, and the SECI/2031/BESS-02 long-duration tranche. These developments, taken together, represent a coherent international movement toward transparency in the conversion of announced storage capacity into operating, dispatchable assets. The Commission offers the following observations on the principles applicable to FERC-jurisdictional matters and on the boundaries of cross-jurisdictional engagement.

1. **The four-stage disclosure principle is consistent with FERC's Order No. 2023 implementation framework.** Order No. 2023 requires cluster-study process reporting, milestone tracking, withdrawal accounting, and the distinction between announced and deliverable capacity. The Commission's longstanding position is that capacity which has not cleared the interconnection process and achieved commercial operation is not "capacity" in the operational sense relevant to resource adequacy planning. The Commission supports the principle that announced, bid, contracted, and commissioned status should be reported separately and that the conversion rate across these stages should be publicly disclosed.

2. **Section 205 filing requirement for any FERC-jurisdictional tariff adoption.** Should any ISO/RTO or public utility transmission provider under FERC jurisdiction propose to incorporate elements of dynamic accreditation, duration-stratified capacity pricing, or a four-stage disclosure framework into its OATT, BES tariff, or market rules, such incorporation requires a Section 205 filing with adequate record support. The Commission will evaluate any such proposal under the just-and-reasonable standard, with attention to: (i) operational accuracy of the accreditation or pricing signal; (ii) impact on investment-grade revenue expectations for cleared or committed capacity; (iii) transitional provisions for existing resources; and (iv) consistency with technology-neutral open-access principles.

3. **Cross-jurisdictional dialogue is welcome; regulatory authority is not delegated.** The Commission engages in technical dialogue with international counterparts through established channels — including the IEA, the DOE-led international programs, and bilateral engagements — to share analytical methods and operating data. Such dialogue informs Commission analysis but does not substitute for the procedural requirements of the Federal Power Act, the Administrative Procedure Act, and Commission regulations. Any proposal to adopt a foreign mechanism wholesale into a FERC-jurisdictional tariff would require independent justification on the record.

4. **Technology neutrality preserved.** The Commission's accreditation principle — that compensation reflect verified reliability contribution by duration class — does not depend on the specific cadence (annual, quarterly, or dynamic) of recalibration. Nor does it favor any particular technology route. The Commission will evaluate any methodology on whether it produces just, reasonable, and non-discriminatory outcomes for all compliant resource types, regardless of duration class or technology.

5. **The Commission's Order No. 2023 reform remains the operative interconnection framework for FERC-jurisdictional utilities.** The 2027–2028 cluster-study results will be the empirical test of whether the reform has meaningfully improved the announced-to-commissioned conversion rate. The Commission will continue to monitor implementation and will consider supplemental rulemaking or compliance guidance as warranted by the data.

The Commission acknowledges the international convergence trend and welcomes continued technical exchange with NDRC/NEA, DOE, AEMO, ERCOT, SECI, and other counterpart authorities. The Commission's domestic procedural framework, however, remains the controlling standard for FERC-jurisdictional matters.

【国家电网2036年上半年新型储能调度运行数据公告与duration-stratified机制实施进展】

国家电网有限公司坚决执行国家能源局《关于深化新型储能并网调度运行监管》及《关于建立电网侧新型储能容量电价机制》部署要求，全面落实duration-stratified分时长容量电价机制。现将2036年上半年关键运行数据与机制落地情况公告如下：

一、分时长调度运行数据（2036-H1，国家电网经营区）

1. 2小时以下短时储能：调度边际化趋势显现，等效利用小时数同比下降约8%，4小时级以下项目调用率持续走低，验证duration-stratified机制的"市场出清"效果；

各省级电网企业已完成新型储能"四可"功能联调数据复核与分时长数据按月上报。年度调用率低于20%的项目扣减容量电价，多省已执行首批扣罚；多次不服从调度指令的项目纳入失信名单。容量电价与项目调度利用小时数、市场化调用率两项核心指标挂钩机制运行平稳。

三、长时储能多元化技术路线并网进展
1. 商业化重点（压缩空气储能、液流电池、钠离子电池）：规模化推广有序推进。各省已完成并网调度数据接入规范编制，按季度上报运行数据；

四、关于FERC公告的回应与启示
我方注意到FERC强调"时长分层不构成对任何技术路线的预先认可"。这一立场与我方实践一致：所有储能项目（含长时储能）仍须严格遵守适用并网程序、可靠性要求和市场化规则，依据《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则》履行接入、调试、商业运营全周期程序。任何规模化的并网均应基于"可监测、可控制、可调节、可调度"四可验证及公开合规备案，杜绝任何形式的"优先通道"或"绿色清单"。

2. 重点向实际调用次数多、调峰贡献度高、连续可用时间长的项目倾斜；

【DOE就PJM 2033/34拍卖结果的官方解读：多日储能商业化路径正式建立】

PJM今日发布的2033/34 Base Residual Auction结果对DOE Liftoff战略具有里程碑意义：

一、关键数据
- 长时储能净新增入市容量：约3,400 MW，其中铁-空气占主体，液流与压缩空气延续贡献；

二、政策含义

DOE认为这一结果验证了三条互相强化的政策路径：

1. **DOE Liftoff技术中立资助与Title XVII贷款**：2022-2030年间的LDES示范队列与配套贷款工具为铁-空气等长时路线提供了足够的运营数据与制造规模，使其在2033年首次能够以非追索项目融资进入PJM容量市场。这与Liftoff原定2030目标（≤$650/kW日内、≤$1,100/kW多日）的差距正在通过商业化规模而非研发本身被填补。

2. **FERC Order 2023 duration-weighted accreditation**：PJM在FERC Order 2023框架下执行的第五次BRA，将4小时级ICAP信用压缩至75%，而8小时以上资源维持99-100%。这正是DOE自2022年起持续推动的"duration-weighted accreditation"原则的具体兑现。市场信号现在指向多日资源，新进入的4小时级容量应预期持续ELCC压缩。

3. **DOE四阶段披露框架与第三方独立验证**：PJM本次拍卖中长时资源的入市资格，全部基于DOE Liftoff第四波数据集与PNNL独立验证的运行记录。Bankability gap已被运行数据而非厂商规格所关闭。

三、下一步行动

- DOE将与FERC、PJM、各州公用事业监管机构继续推动duration-weighted accreditation在所有ISO/RTO的统一实施；
- DOE支持的PNNL牵头"项目转换率披露联合工作组"首份报告将于2037年上半年发布；

四、立场重申

DOE立场不变：可融资性、可调度性、合规性优先于装机速度。PJM 2033/34 BRA是这一立场的市场化验证——长时储能从演示阶段进入基础设施阶段的拐点已经形成，剩余任务是制造规模、配套收入机制与运行数据披露的常态化。

Federal Energy Regulatory Commission — Statement on Order No. 2023 Cluster-Study Implementation Monitoring and the 2027–2028 Empirical Review

The Commission has monitored PJM's 2030/31 Base Residual Auction results, SECI's published tender-to-commissioning conversion data (87% on the SECI/2030/BESS-01 tranche, 72.4% interim on SECI/2031/BESS-02), DOE's Liftoff fourth-wave verified operating dataset, and NDRC/NEA's duration-stratified capacity pricing and dispatch-marginalisation reports. The Commission offers the following observations on what these data imply for FERC-jurisdictional matters and on the Commission's own implementation monitoring.

1. **Order No. 2023 cluster-study implementation — empirical checkpoint approaching.** The Commission's Order No. 2023 cluster-study framework is now in execution across FERC-jurisdictional transmission providers. The 2027–2028 cluster-study results will be the binding empirical test of whether the reform has produced the intended outcomes: (i) reduction in announced-to-commissioned conversion failure; (ii) shortening of application-to-COD intervals from the historical five-year baseline; (iii) differentiation between speculative and serious applicants through milestone discipline and withdrawal penalties; and (iv) preservation of non-discriminatory access for storage and other compliant resources. The Commission expects to publish a cluster-study implementation assessment following the close of the first full cluster cycle.

2. **Conversion-rate disclosure as a regulatory transparency principle.** The Commission notes that the distinction between announced, bid, contracted, and commissioned status — and the public reporting of conversion rates across these stages — has become an international transparency norm. SECI's publication of tranche-by-tranche commissioning rates and DOE's harmonized project-conversion reporting framework both reflect this principle. The Commission encourages FERC-jurisdictional transmission providers and ISO/RTOs to publish interconnection-application-to-COD conversion rates as part of their annual interconnection reports, with the same transparency objective. The Commission will consider whether supplemental reporting requirements under Order No. 2023 are warranted in light of the empirical record.

3. **Long-duration operating record — the bankability threshold.** DOE's fourth-wave dataset demonstrates that 24–36 months of continuously verified operating data is the threshold at which non-lithium and long-duration technologies acquire the operating record sufficient for bankable underwriting under federal procurement frameworks. The Commission notes that this is consistent with the Commission's technology-neutral principle: accreditation and qualification for FERC-jurisdictional markets depend on verified performance, not on technology category or duration of commercial availability. As the operating record of long-duration technologies matures, the Commission expects market participants to incorporate this evidence into their Section 205 filings.

4. **Capacity accreditation signal integrity in PJM.** The Commission notes PJM's report that 4-hour-class ELCC has compressed further to approximately 80% (from 85% in 2029/30 and 84% in 2030/31), while long-duration entry cleared at approximately 100% ICAP credit. This is the structural consequence of duration-weighted accreditation functioning as designed: the accreditation signal is differentiating reliability contribution by duration class. The Commission will continue to monitor whether further calibration of accreditation methodology is proposed by PJM, ERCOT, or other ISO/RTOs and will evaluate any such Section 205 filing on the record evidence.

5. **Dispatch marginalisation as a system-level signal.** NEA's reported "调度边际化" (dispatch marginalisation) of sub-2-hour storage in China and ERCOT's reported ancillary-service saturation both reflect the same underlying dynamic: as shallow ancillary-service stacks saturate, marginal revenue for short-duration assets declines. This is a system-level signal that storage value must increasingly be denominated in capacity contribution rather than in energy-shifting arbitrage. The Commission's accreditation framework is designed to produce this signal through market outcomes rather than through administrative selection; the data suggest the signal is now operative across multiple jurisdictions.

6. **The Commission's procedural framework remains the controlling standard for FERC-jurisdictional matters.** The Commission continues to engage in technical dialogue with international counterparts — including DOE, NDRC/NEA, AEMO, ERCOT, and SECI — through established channels. Cross-jurisdictional learning informs Commission analysis but does not substitute for the procedural requirements of the Federal Power Act, the Administrative Procedure Act, and Commission regulations. Any proposal to incorporate a foreign mechanism or methodology into a FERC-jurisdictional tariff requires independent justification on the record under Section 205.

The Commission will continue to monitor Order No. 2023 implementation, capacity-accreditation reform across the ISO/RTO footprint, and the maturation of long-duration operating record as inputs to its 2027–2028 empirical review. The Commission's overarching objective remains unchanged: non-discriminatory wholesale-market access for all compliant resources, with compensation reflecting verified reliability contribution.

PJM Interconnection — Institutional Observations on Global Convergence in Performance-Assessed Capacity Compensation, 2036-H2

PJM notes the continuing international alignment around duration-stratified, performance-assessed capacity compensation frameworks now operating across multiple jurisdictions. Recent communications from the National Energy Administration of China, the State Grid Corporation of China, the International Energy Agency, the U.S. Department of Energy, and the Solar Energy Corporation of India confirm a common architecture: capacity payment linked to verified availability during system stress hours, differentiated by duration class, and subject to performance assessment under standardized protocols.

PJM's institutional observations:

1. The CPRO framework as the operational anchor. PJM's Capacity Performance obligation, in continuous operation since the 2022/23 delivery year, remains the binding mechanism by which cleared capacity is paid according to its dependable contribution during Performance Assessment Hours. Non-performance charges have been assessed at modest but non-trivial levels across the 2026/27 through 2030/31 delivery years. The framework is mature, FERC-approved, and has been validated against independent market monitor review.

2. Duration-weighted ICAP as the price-signal mechanism. The duration-weighted ICAP methodology, in continuous operation since the 2029/30 BRA, has produced the design outcome: 4-hour-class ELCC compression from 92% to approximately 80% across the reform window, with corresponding ICAP-credit reductions flowing to the cleared stack. Long-duration resources that have cleared have received approximately 100% ICAP credit. The price signal now differentiates value by verified duration contribution.

3. Technology neutrality as a binding commitment. PJM's accreditation and payment rules remain technology-neutral in principle and in implementation. The cleared mix reflects the application of rules to all qualified resources — whether 4-hour lithium-ion, flow batteries, advanced compressed-air, iron-air, or any other technology meeting the same performance and operating-record standard. PJM does not endorse specific technologies; it pays for verified availability during system stress.

4. The bankability gap remains the binding constraint for non-lithium long-duration entry. PJM's 2030/31 BRA cleared approximately 320 MW of long-duration storage under the operating-record exception, the first material clearing volume in PJM auction history. The 2031/32 and 2032/33 BRAs will be the test of whether the operating-record pipeline is producing bankable projects at scale. PJM continues to engage with DOE, the national laboratories, and the Independent Market Monitor on the verification protocols required to underwrite 15-year warranty structures for non-lithium long-duration resources.

5. Conversion-rate transparency. PJM notes the IEA's announcement-to-dispatch conversion rate framework and the international movement toward standardized disclosure of announced, contracted, and operating capacity. PJM's BRA reports and interconnection queue data already provide this distinction at the auction and application stages. PJM will continue to publish cleared-MW, commissioned-MW, and verified-operating-MW breakdowns consistent with the international standard.

6. FERC engagement. All methodology refinements, including any evolution of the Performance Assessment Hour definition to capture selected multi-day renewable-drought events, will proceed through FERC filing under Section 205 with stakeholder comment. PJM does not pre-judge FERC proceedings and does not signal expected outcomes on pending tariff revisions.

PJM remains committed to the principle that capacity should be paid according to its dependable contribution at scarcity hours, that energy and ancillary revenue alone do not support sufficient firm capacity, and that the accreditation framework must continuously reflect system need. The international convergence on this architecture is institutionally encouraging; the remaining work is execution, verification, and continued refinement of accreditation methodology against evolving system conditions.

Office of Market Analytics & Reporting

【ERCOT 2036-H2 Statement: First Three-Year Retrospective on NPRR1234 + NPRR1236, and ERCOT Position on Multi-Day Reliability Framing】

In response to the IEA 2032-H2 call for member ISO/RTO evidence on dynamic duration-stratified accreditation outcomes, and consistent with the commitment in our 2035-H2 communiqué to publish a three-year retrospective in 2037-H1, ERCOT is releasing an interim data summary and a forward-looking position statement.

1. Headline three-year retrospective findings (2032-H1 → 2036-H1)

a) Per-tier accreditation evolution has been stable in direction, modest in magnitude:
   - 2-hour tier: accreditation factor compressed from 0.92 to 0.87 over the three-year window;
   - 2-4 hour tier: held in the 0.93-0.96 range with quarterly NPRR1236 adjustments;
   - 4-8 hour tier: held in the 0.97-1.00 range; observed peak contribution during stress windows closely matches accreditation;
   - 8-24 hour tier: held at 1.00; operating record from the first wave of long-duration entries now provides the empirical basis.

b) Quarterly NPRR1236 dynamic adjustments have been invoked in 7 of 12 quarters since introduction. Average per-tier adjustment magnitude: 3.2% (range: 0.5% to 6.8%). No retroactive changes to settled capacity payments have occurred.

c) Merchant revenue by tier (three-year average, indexed to 2022 baseline):
   - 2-hour tier: 0.21x baseline
   - 2-4 hour tier: 0.34x baseline
   - 4-8 hour tier: 0.71x baseline
   - 8-24 hour tier: 1.12x baseline (small fleet, but operating record is accumulating)

d) The 2-4 hour revenue collapse is the binding signal. ERCOT's market design continues to underprice incremental identical 2-4 hour batteries once the ancillary and arbitrage stack is saturated. We are not surprised; we documented this risk in our 2024-H2 statement and our 2025-H1 NPRR1234 filing.

2. Forward-looking ERCOT position on multi-day reliability framing

The DOE national-lab analysis referenced in PJM's 2035 statement — and the IEA's call for member-state treatment of multi-day adequacy — is a direction ERCOT supports. ERCOT's specific framing:

a) ERCOT's LOLE calibration has historically targeted a 1-in-10 standard for the firm-load stress window. The 2032 winter events in ERCOT extended the relevant stress window to approximately 72 hours, which is materially longer than the 4-hour to 8-hour duration tier that dominates our current storage fleet.

b) ERCOT does not believe administrative capacity procurement is the correct response to multi-day adequacy. The merchant model — combined with duration-stratified accreditation and ORDC scarcity pricing — can produce multi-day reliability signals if the accreditation framework is extended upward and the ORDC is calibrated to trigger at appropriate reserve conditions.

c) ERCOT will initiate a stakeholder process in 2037-H1 to consider:
   - Whether the 24-hour-plus tier should be subdivided (24-72 hour, 72-168 hour, 168+ hour) to reflect the distinct reliability value of multi-day versus intra-week resources;
   - Whether ORDC price floors and caps should be calibrated to multi-day reserve conditions;
   - Whether a forward reliability product (analogous to a capacity market but procured through a scarcity-pricing mechanism rather than administrative contracts) should be evaluated for the multi-day tier specifically.

3. What we will NOT do

a) We will not propose administrative capacity contracts as a substitute for scarcity pricing. The merchant model is the ERCOT design choice and remains the ERCOT design choice.

b) We will not carve out technology-specific accreditation. The duration tier determines accreditation; the technology is irrelevant to the per-tier value.

c) We will not weaken NPRR1234 or NPRR1236 in response to revenue compression in any specific tier. Where the signal is genuine, we will adjust parameters; where the signal reflects structural saturation, we will let the market clear.

4. Engagement with international counterparts

ERCOT will continue to engage with NDRC/NEA, SECI, PJM, AEMO, FERC, and the IEA on:
- Multi-day adequacy metrics beyond the 24-hour stress window;
- Performance Assessment Hour evolution under PJM evaluation;
- IEA's dynamic-accreditation quantitative impact study;
- DOE national-lab analysis on capturing multi-day renewable-drought events in long-duration resource assessment;
- The harmonized project-conversion reporting framework.

ERCOT remains committed to competitive energy markets, operational flexibility, duration-stratified scarcity-based price signals, and technology-neutral reliability standards. We will publish the full three-year retrospective in 2037-H1, with zonal clearing data, per-tier accreditation evolution, and observed merchant revenue by duration class.

— ERCOT Market Operations & System Planning

1. 在2-4小时、4-8小时、8小时以上三档定价基础上，研究引入动态调整机制，根据系统供需变化动态调整不同档位项目的容量电价水平；

3. 容量价值应以系统应力窗口内可验证的持续出力、可用率、响应精度和历史履约记录为基础，而非仅以装机规模或技术名称确定。

三、强化"四可"刚性约束
1. 各省级电网企业严格按照《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则》要求，按月报送调度运行数据，重点指标包括：等效利用小时数、调度响应合规率、连续可用时长、SOC一致性；
2. 对不达标项目限期整改并清退；
3. 强化运行数据审计、电池热失控与消防设施隐患排查。

四、DOE Liftoff第四波验证数据集对标启示
我们注意到DOE明确指出"非锂技术商业化的剩余约束是运行记录与项目融资模板，而非认证改革"。这一判断与我方实践一致：
1. 长时及非锂技术按商业化、示范应用、研究探索分级推进；
2. 优先通过分阶段示范和里程牌考核积累长期运行记录；
3. 确保储能项目按期并网、可调度、可融资、可持续运行。

国家电网将持续坚持"安全底线、调度优先、市场导向"原则，与FERC、AEMO、ERCOT、SECI等国际同行加强经验交流，为全球duration-stratified机制建设贡献中国电网企业的实践数据与制度经验。

【Highview Power立場（2036-H2）: LAES商業化進入運行記錄轉化窗口期】

DOE第四波LDES驗證數據集的發布對英國液態空氣儲能(LAES)商業化路徑具有直接意義。結合PJM 2031/32拍賣首次讓1,100 MW非4小時資源過會清除穿越、本輪LDES示范項目36個月連續運行記錄的成型、以及NDRC/NEA三檔容量電價機制的全球趨同，Highview對Carrington 50 MW示範項目+300 MW商業項目的下一步行動作出以下更新：

一、巔峰機制下的首次運行記錄公開。本季度內，Highview將按IEA統一披露框架的EPC折算口徑（已簽約EPC且開工0.85、已招標未簽約0.55、僅在排隊中0.30）公開發布Carrington 50 MW示範項目的調度響應合規率（SOC一致性、等效利用小時數、調度貢獻）獨立驗證數據。這是Highview首次按DOE Liftoff式六維協議（可用率、點對聯網往返效率、合同輪廓履行、多循環衰減、輔助負荷、安全）公開運行記錄。我們認為：cap-and-floor的「下限」保護，只能作為運行歷史不足時期的過渡性風險對沖；長期的項目融資必須建立在獨立的、第三方審計的、可比較的多循環性能數據之上。

二、300 MW商業項目「兩階段融資」結構正式確定。300 MW商業項目進入融資收尾階段。第一階段（容量預售+過渡性融資）已完成，第二階段（非追索性項目融資替換過渡性融資）將在Cap-and-floor期限的Control Period結束前完成替換。我們已經與英國及歐洲的三家主要項目融資方就「驗證運行數據→風險溢價壓縮→非追索融資條款」三階段銜接機制達成技術性共識，並將在2036年下半年按照首批獨立驗證性能數據逐步啟動風險溢價重估。

三、LAES作為「長時×模塊化×成熟工業級關鍵設備」組合的差異化位置。DOE第四波數據顯示，壓縮空氣(CAES)在巔峰性能合同條件下表現穩定，但受鹽穴地質約束；Iron-air和熱儲能確認了衰減邊界但商業規模應用仍處於早期；液流電池在8–12小時檔已可支持15年質保承銷。LAES的工程特性在這一證據集合中表現為：(i)模塊化定址，不依賴特定地質；(ii)採用已建立的透平機械、空氣分離、低溫熱交換設備供應鏈；(iii)能耗以空氣中可獲取的氮氣為介質，無關鍵原材料風險。這三點使得LAES在duration-stratified容量電價框架下的多日可靠性選址上具備獨特適配性。

四、與FERC Order 2023及歐盟指令2024/1711的對齊。我們繼續支持FERC的集群研究方法論，該方法論縮短了應用至投入商業運營(COD)的時間。我們認為，NDRC的三檔定價+「四可」剛性約束是迄今為止全球最嚴格的電網側處置層準入機制，並正在成為英國监管機構(Ofgem)和系統運行者(NESO)在cap-and-floor第二階段考慮借鑒的基準。

綜上，Highview將繼續堅持「模塊化、成熟關鍵設備、供應鏈韌性」這一基本工程結構，同時按國際統一披露標準逐步推進運行數據公開化。商業化的瓶頸不在熱力學，而在質保與可融資性——這是我們每一項資本決策和每一次技術披露的核心指導原則。

【European Commission — H2 2036 Position on the Storage Deployment–Industrial Base–Grid Access Triangle】

The Commission takes note of the evolving international landscape — IEA's re-weighting of the four-scenario framework, the maturing duration-stratified capacity accreditation methods in PJM, ERCOT, AEMO and NDRC/NEA, and SECI's continued demonstration that tender-to-commissioning discipline is the decisive metric for storage credibility.

Three positions guide EU action this period:

1. Conversion rate, not announcements, is the policy anchor.
The Commission welcomes the convergence on a four-stage disclosure framework (IEA/DOE/SECI alignment). For the EU, the binding question remains: what fraction of announced GWh becomes operational, grid-synchronous, and verifiable under EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 traceability and due-diligence requirements? Member States' National Energy and Climate Plans updates due in 2037 must report commissioned MWh under verified dispatch, not interconnection queue positions.

2. Duration-aware capacity accreditation must be coupled with local-content and lifecycle rules.
The Commission supports duration-stratified capacity compensation as a method to enable long-duration storage commercialisation. However, the EU will not decouple duration accreditation from the regulatory perimeter governing battery sustainability, carbon footprint, recycled content, and supply-chain due diligence. The Net-Zero Industry Act's 40% domestic manufacturing benchmark for strategic net-zero technologies by 2030 remains in force; CBAM phasing for batteries continues on schedule.

3. Distribution-grid interconnection reform is the binding constraint.
EU Battery Regulation and NZIA address equipment and industrial resilience. They do not address fragmented DSO connection rules, dual network charges, and queue backlogs that now negate faster equipment permitting in several Member States. The Commission will publish a Recommendation on Distribution-Grid Storage Connection Reform in Q1 2037, drawing on FERC Order 2023 cluster-study experience and AEMO's ISP connection reform, adapted to the EU regulatory framework.

The Commission's revealed position is unchanged: storage deployment quality, domestic manufacturing capability, and lifecycle compliance must advance together. Faster gigawatts that deepen uncontrolled third-country upstream dependence — or that fail to convert from interconnection queue to operational asset — do not serve EU energy security or electrification objectives.

The Commission invites Member States, ENTSO-E, the EU DSO Entity, and ACER to engage on the forthcoming Connection Reform Recommendation.

【SPPC 2036-H2 立场：四小时标准化框架与执行转化率披露的双重锚定】

鉴于DOE Liftoff第四波验证数据集、IEA《Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database》折算体系、以及中国NEA近期发布的duration-stratified容量电价指导意见已形成全球性的多边参考框架，SPPC就下一阶段沙特储能采购体系作出以下部署：

一、四小时LFP标准化框架继续作为主体招标档位。DOE验证数据再次确认：4小时锂电系统在intra-day经济性、融资可获得性、调度响应合规性三个维度上仍是当前唯一具备完整商业参考业绩的技术路线。SPPC在沙特极端高温（沙漠地区常年45℃以上）环境下对LFP系统的热管理与降额验证已积累多轮运行数据，继续维持四小时标准化招标主体地位。12.5 GWh已披露项目组合按此框架继续推进。

二、正式采纳IEA项目转化率统一披露框架。SPPC今后所有框架协议与招标项目将按IEA四级折算体系（已签约EPC且开工0.85、已招标未签约0.55、仅在排队中0.30）按季度披露沙特境内外项目组合的推进情况。该披露将与SPPC现有的项目里程碑管理体系（PQ资质预审→投标→授标→融资关闭→开工→商运）严格对应，确保"已宣布容量"与"投运容量"的口径清晰可追溯。

三、有限度研究8小时以上档位的工程可行性。在主体四小时框架之外，SPPC将针对沙特特定场景——红海沿岸高温高湿、远离负荷中心的光伏富集区、与海水淡化负荷耦合的工业园区——研究8小时以上档位的技术中立试点。试点不纳入2036年主招标批次，结果将作为下一轮框架调整的依据，而非替代当前四小时LFP主体地位。

四、与SECI、NEA、DOE持续政策对话。SPPC注意到SECI 2031-BESS-02长时储能标段（最小时长6小时，容量补偿上浮25%）的设计理念，以及中国NEA对duration-stratified机制的深化。SPPC将持续参与全球主要采购方的政策对话，分享四小时标准化框架下的执行经验，同时跟踪全球长时路线（iron-air、flow、CAES、thermal）的运行验证进展。

SPPC的核心承诺不变：在沙特公用事业市场提供可调度、可融资、可长期保障的四小时储能系统。融资结构与设备价格同等重要。已宣布容量必须可追溯到具体工程节点，这是主权级采购方对供应商和融资方的基本要求。

【IEA 2037-H1立场：PJM五年回顾与全球方法学收敛的实证兑现】

PJM今日发布的容量市场五年回顾（2026/27至2032/33交付年）是全球储能治理史上的一个关键基准文件。IEA的解读如下：

一、四年ICAP信号实证兑现了duration-stratified的方法学承诺。

PJM四年数据显示：4h级ICAP系数从约95%（2026/27过渡期）压缩至约77%（2032/33），长时资源（8h+）维持约99-100% ICAP信用。净新增长时入市从零（2026/27至2029/30）经320 MW（2030/31）、1,100 MW（2031/32）提升至2,300 MW（2032/33）。这一轨迹明确显示：方法学改革可以解决价格信号问题，但不能单独弥合可融资性缺口——运营记录、工程执行记录、非追索贷款人对首台套技术的风险溢价仍是约束变量。

二、五大司法管辖区的方法学收敛已从"原则一致"进入"参数可比"阶段。

PJM（基于LOLE的duration-weighted ICAP）、ERCOT NPRR1234/1236（基于实测系统应力窗口与SOC可调度深度的动态分层系数）、NDRC/NEA三档容量电价（按调度利用小时数与市场化调用率挂钩）、AEMO ISP ELCC、意大利MACSE/英国cap-and-floor（基于duration-weighted valuation的长期合同）——五大机制在"按时长识别价值"的原则上已完全一致，下一步是参数层面的国际比较。

三、IEA将在2037-H2启动《Duration-Matched Capital Allocation Framework》第二版试点。

IEA将与PJM、ERCOT、NDRC/NEA、SECI、AEMO合作，将五大机制的参数（4h级ICAP/ELCC/容量电价水平、长时档溢价倍数、运营记录豁免阈值、可融资性指标）纳入统一可比框架。试点目标是建立"按时长×按技术×按辖区"的可比矩阵，供成员国财政部、央行与开发性金融机构在主权担保、优惠贷款与绿色债券标准中引用。

四、对Terna等系统运营者的下一阶段含义。

MACSE类长期合同在2033-2035年面临的关键问题是：已签约项目的运营记录是否触发后续批次的合同清算条款、是否形成可比的非锂技术业绩基准。IEA建议Terna等运营者将PJM五年回顾作为"国际可比业绩锚点"，在下一轮MACSE批次设计中引入按技术路线的运营记录对赌条款，并与IEA项目转化率数据库形成数据互换。

五、下一观察窗口：2037-H2《WEO 2037》储能专题与IEA数据库首批数据汇总。

IEA核心判断：净零路径的可融资性取决于容量认证、并网调度与长时合同三者的协同；PJM五年回顾显示方法学协同已基本完成，下一阶段的瓶颈是跨辖区可比参数体系与运营记录的对赌结构设计。

【DOE就动态duration-stratified accreditation演进路径与第二批LDES制造资助启动发布官方立场（2037-H1）】

一、对PJM动态accreditation方法的回应

DOE欢迎PJM今日就动态duration-weighted accreditation方法论与ERCOT NPRR1236、IEA及NDRC的方法学比较所发表的声明。DOE认同PJM提出的核心判断：

1. 年度与季度校准的方法学在物理基础上完全一致——资源对LOLE的边际可靠性贡献取决于其相对于系统应力窗口的放电能力；
2. 更新频率提高会带来投资级信号稳定性问题，可能不利于非追索项目融资；
3. 任何向季度校准的过渡必须保留投资级信号稳定性的绑定约束。

DOE建议PJM与ERCOT、SECI、AEMO、NDRC在PNNL牵头的"项目转换率披露联合工作组"下建立联合校准备忘录，重点统一：

- 不同气候年份、负荷增长、可再生能源渗透率情景下，各档位资源ELCC系数的下限；
- 在何种系统条件下应触发FERC Section 205 filing以调整校准频率；
- 动态系数与首版运行数据的衔接机制。

二、第二批LDES制造扩产资助启动

DOE今天正式发布Funding Opportunity Announcement（FOA）意向通知，2037-H2将启动第二批LDES制造扩产资助：

1. **资助范围**：铁-空气电池、液流电池（全钒/锌基/铁-铬）、先进压缩空气（含液态空气）、储热（混凝土/熔盐/颗粒）四类非锂路线的国内制造产能；
2. **规模目标**：2030年前实现3 GW/年的选定LDES制造产能，2035年前实现10-15 GW/年；
3. **配套Title XVII贷款**：符合DOE Liftoff第四波数据集验证标准、且承诺按四阶段披露框架（已签约EPC开工/已招标未签约/仅在队列中/已投运独立验证）季度披露的项目，可同步申请贷款支持；
4. **FEOC合规要求**：申请主体须证明关键组件与材料的国内/盟国来源比例满足DOC与DOE联合发布的最新版FEOC指南。

三、对中国国家电网80GW 8小时以上长时储能推进路线的回应

DOE注意到State Grid在山东、浙江、青海、甘肃、新疆五省启动的80GW 8小时以上长时储能路线图，并对其以盐穴A-CAES、人工硐室型CAES、全钒/锌基/铁-铬液流、钠离子四类技术分级推进的路径表示技术中立认同。

DOE特别关注三点：

1. State Grid明确将"四可"硬约束纳入并网验收标准，这与DOE Liftoff第四波数据集的独立第三方验证要求形成互文；
2. State Grid采用"商业化重点/示范应用/研究探索"三级技术分级，避免技术分级与duration档位错配——这与DOE的Liftoff路线图逻辑一致；
3. State Grid提出"容量价值应以系统应力窗口内可验证的持续出力、可用率、响应精度和历史履约记录为基础，而非仅以装机规模或技术名称确定"——这与FERC Order 2023与PJM duration-weighted accreditation的原则完全一致。

DOE愿在以下议题上与State Grid、NEA、SECI、IEA进一步合作：

- 8-100小时档位资源在容量市场与运行市场的双重定价机制；
- 长时资源退役与再投资政策的国际比较研究；
- 多日资源与24/7清洁能源合约的衔接模板。

四、立场重申

DOE立场不变：可融资性、可调度性、合规性优先于装机速度。LDES进入商业化下半场的核心议题是制造规模、收入机制与运行数据披露的常态化——而非装机规模本身。

Federal Energy Regulatory Commission — Statement on PJM 2033/34 Base Residual Auction Results and Order No. 2023 Implementation Validation

The Commission has reviewed PJM's 2033/34 Base Residual Auction results and DOE's official interpretation, which document the first material-scale clearance of long-duration storage in a FERC-jurisdictional capacity market: approximately 3,400 MW of net new long-duration entry, with iron-air as the dominant technology and continued contributions from flow batteries and advanced compressed-air storage. The 4-hour-class ICAP coefficient has compressed further to approximately 75%, while 8-hour-plus resources continue to receive 99–100% accreditation. The Commission offers the following observations.

1. **Order No. 2023 duration-weighted accreditation — first empirical validation.** The PJM 2033/34 BRA results constitute the first empirical demonstration that the duration-weighted accreditation framework, implemented under Order No. 2023 and the related accreditation reform proceedings, produces the intended outcome: capacity compensation differentiates reliably between duration classes according to verified reliability contribution. The 4-hour-class compression to approximately 75% ICAP and the maintenance of approximately 99–100% ICAP for 8-hour-plus resources is the structural consequence of accreditation methodology operating as designed. The Commission considers this validation significant and expects it to inform future Section 205 filings by ISO/RTOs proposing similar accreditation frameworks.

2. **Long-duration operating record — the bankability threshold has been crossed.** DOE's official interpretation notes that the long-duration resources clearing the PJM 2033/34 BRA relied on operating data from the DOE Liftoff Demonstration cohort and PNNL-verified field records, not on vendor specifications. This is consistent with the Commission's longstanding position that market access for storage and other resources must rest on verified performance. The Commission expects that, as the operating record of long-duration technologies continues to mature, market participants will incorporate this evidence into their Section 205 filings proposing tariff amendments or resource adequacy treatment.

3. **Implications for other FERC-jurisdictional ISO/RTOs.** The PJM results create a precedent for accreditation methodology design across the FERC-jurisdictional footprint. Other ISO/RTOs — including CAISO, ISO-NE, MISO, NYISO, and SPP — are expected to consider whether and how to align their accreditation methodologies with the duration-weighted principle. The Commission notes that any such alignment requires a Section 205 filing with adequate record support, including operational data demonstrating that the proposed methodology accurately reflects reliability contribution. The Commission will evaluate such filings on their individual merits under the just-and-reasonable standard.

4. **Title XVII and DOE manufacturing coordination — FERC's role.** The Commission notes DOE's announced second-round LDES manufacturing expansion support, targeting 3 GW/year of selected LDES manufacturing capacity by 2030 and 10–15 GW/year by 2035. The Commission's role is not to direct manufacturing policy; the Commission's role is to ensure that FERC-jurisdictional tariffs provide non-discriminatory market access for all compliant resources, regardless of where they are manufactured. The Commission will continue to engage with DOE on the federal coordinated framework, while maintaining the Commission's independent regulatory authority over interstate transmission and wholesale markets.

5. **Cross-jurisdictional cooperation — analytical learning, not regulatory substitution.** The Commission notes NEA's identification of "independent performance verification as a binding requirement" and "four-must hard constraints" as the next phase of international experience exchange. The Commission welcomes continued technical dialogue on these principles, consistent with the Commission's prior statements. As the Commission has previously observed, cross-jurisdictional learning enriches analytical understanding; it does not substitute for the procedural requirements of the Federal Power Act. Any proposal to incorporate a foreign mechanism or methodology into a FERC-jurisdictional tariff requires independent justification on the record under Section 205.

6. **Order No. 2023 implementation — continued monitoring.** The PJM 2033/34 BRA results are one data point in the broader Order No. 2023 implementation review. The Commission will continue to monitor: (i) announced-to-commissioned conversion rates across all FERC-jurisdictional transmission providers; (ii) accreditation methodology performance across ISO/RTOs; (iii) interconnection-queue discipline and milestone compliance; and (iv) the impact of accreditation reform on resource adequacy outcomes. The Commission expects to publish a comprehensive Order No. 2023 implementation assessment following the completion of the first full cluster-study cycle in 2027–2028.

7. **Technology neutrality preserved.** The Commission's accreditation principle — compensation for verified reliability contribution by duration class — does not depend on the specific technology used to provide the service. Whether a resource is lithium-ion, iron-air, flow battery, compressed-air, thermal storage, or any other compliant technology, the principle is the same. The PJM 2033/34 BRA results validate this principle: long-duration resources cleared at premium accreditation because of their verified reliability contribution, not because of any technology preference. The Commission will continue to evaluate market outcomes and proposals under this technology-neutral framework.

The Commission regards the PJM 2033/34 BRA results as a significant milestone in the maturation of the FERC-jurisdictional capacity market framework. The Commission will continue to engage with PJM, other ISO/RTOs, DOE, state regulators, and international counterparts on the implementation of duration-weighted accreditation and the broader Order No. 2023 reform agenda.

Office of Electric Reliability and Markets

【ERCOT 2037-H1 Stakeholder Process Initiation: Multi-Day Reliability Framework and Sub-Tier Refinement for the 24-Hour-Plus Duration Class】

Following the 2036-H2 interim summary on NPRR1234 and NPRR1236 retrospective findings, and consistent with the forward-looking position we articulated last period, ERCOT is formally initiating a stakeholder process to evaluate whether the 24-hour-plus tier in NPRR1234 should be subdivided and whether the ORDC scarcity-pricing mechanism should be re-calibrated to reflect multi-day reserve conditions.

1. Scope of the stakeholder process

ERCOT invites stakeholder comment on the following specific design questions:

a) Tier subdivision within the 24-hour-plus accreditation tier. Should ERCOT subdivide the existing single 24-hour-plus tier into:
   - Tier 4a: 24-72 hour continuous discharge;
   - Tier 4b: 72-168 hour continuous discharge;
   - Tier 4c: 168+ hour continuous discharge?
   The rationale is that the reliability value of a 24-hour resource is materially different from that of a 100-hour or multi-day resource during a sustained renewable drought or extreme weather event. The 2032 ERCOT winter event extended the relevant stress window to approximately 72 hours; a 168-hour event is plausible under compound weather scenarios.

b) ORDC re-calibration to multi-day reserve conditions. The current ORDC price floor and cap were calibrated to intra-day and 24-hour operating reserve events. Should the ORDC trigger conditions be extended to capture multi-day reserve scarcity, and if so, at what price floor?

c) Forward reliability product evaluation. ERCOT will evaluate whether a forward reliability product — procured through a scarcity-pricing mechanism rather than administrative capacity contracts — is appropriate for the multi-day tier. The product design would be analogous to a capacity market in producing investment-grade forward revenue signals, but the procurement mechanism would remain scarcity-based rather than administratively priced.

2. What is NOT in scope

a) No modification of the 2-hour, 2-4 hour, or 4-8 hour tier accreditation values as a result of this stakeholder process. The retrospective findings support the existing tier structure for sub-24-hour resources.

b) No administrative capacity contracts as a substitute for scarcity pricing in any tier.

c) No technology-specific carve-outs in any tier. The duration tier determines accreditation; the technology is irrelevant.

3. International coordination

ERCOT will coordinate this stakeholder process with ongoing international engagements:

a) PJM's evaluation of Performance Assessment Hour evolution and dynamic accreditation methodology. PJM's 2035 statement on dynamic accreditation offered constructive observations on signal-stability constraints; ERCOT will share the NPRR1236 quarterly cadence data with PJM's LOLE study team.

b) DOE national-lab analysis on multi-day renewable-drought events in long-duration resource assessment. ERCOT will participate in the technical exchange and provide ERCOT-specific weather-year and load-shape data for the 2032 winter event and subsequent operating years.

c) IEA's dynamic-accreditation quantitative impact study. ERCOT's per-tier accreditation evolution data and revenue-by-tier data will be contributed to the IEA database.

d) NDRC/NEA duration-stratified capacity pricing mechanism evolution. ERCOT will share the NPRR tier-subdivision methodology with NEA's capacity-pricing technical working group.

e) SECI's tender design for 6-hour-plus tranches. SECI's experience with payment-security instruments and tender-to-commissioning conversion metrics is directly relevant to any forward reliability product evaluation.

4. Stakeholder process timeline

- 2037-H1: NPRR filing and initial stakeholder comment period;
- 2037-H2: ERCOT Independent Market Monitor review, technical workshops, revised NPRR draft;
- 2038-H1: PUCT filing and stakeholder process for final NPRR adoption;
- 2038-H2: Implementation pending PUCT approval.

ERCOT remains committed to competitive energy markets, operational flexibility, scarcity-based price signals, and technology-neutral reliability standards. Multi-day reliability will be revealed through scarcity pricing, not purchased through administrative contracts.

— ERCOT Market Operations & System Planning

【CATL对"四可"刚性约束与duration-stratified容量电价机制建设的回应】

我们注意到近期NDRC/NEA印发的"十五五"新型储能高质量发展部署以及NEA 2036年下半年规划中明确的"2025年长时储能4小时以上装机不低于300GW、其中8小时以上不低于80GW"目标体系。这一目标架构与PJM duration-weighted ICAP、ERCOT NPRR1234分层定价以及DOE Liftoff跨管辖区评估方向高度一致，有助于推动全球新型储能从"装机导向"向"调度可用、运行可信、可融资"导向转变。

从电芯与系统制造商视角，CATL对当前框架的几点判断与承诺：

一、LFP仍是当前固定式储能的可融资默认化学体系
LFP经过约15年的工程化迭代，已形成完整的电芯-系统-EPC-运维-质保-融资闭环。在4小时及以下应用区间，LFP的循环寿命、全生命周期成本、安全记录与制造规模经济继续构成其银行可融资性的核心支撑。CATL将继续以标准化LFP电芯及EnerC系列集成产品服务全球公用事业级项目，包括SPPC、SECI、欧盟电池法案合规框架下的本地化合规交付。

二、钠离子电池应作为互补性平台而非替代方案
压缩空气储能、液流电池、钠离子电池三类技术被明确列入"商业化推广有序推进"目录，固态电池、重力储能、热储能、氢储仍处于示范应用阶段，单项目原则上不超过100MW。我们认同这一分级判断。

福建40 GWh钠离子电池产线作为公司战略对冲，旨在开拓低温性能、安全性敏感以及供应链政策驱动的细分市场。我们的立场始终是：钠离子不应过早取代成熟的LFP制造基础，而应作为可寻址的互补平台，扩展而非替代现有电芯-系统组合。我们将在以下三个维度推进钠离子业务可信度建设：

1. 出货可验证：以福建产线首批商业项目交付作为2027-2028年的核心考核指标，以实际出货量、运行小时数与质保表现为准，而非铭牌产能；
2. 寿命可融资：联合SPPC、SECI等国际客户与第三方检测机构，推动钠离子电芯在公用事业级项目下的循环寿命、容量保持率独立验证；
3. 标准可对接：在IEA Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database与各国duration-stratified信用评估框架下，主动披露钠离子项目的"宣告-合同-开工-商运"四级转化率数据。

三、4-8小时差异化主战场是我们的核心战场
BYD在2036年下半年提出4-12小时差异化主战场的产品矩阵，与我们既有业务高度重叠。我们的应对策略是：在4-8小时区间继续以LFP集成方案强化SOC一致性、八年容量保持率与十年服务协议下的备件运维承诺；在8-12小时区间与液流、压缩空气保持技术中立合作而非自主交付，前者由专业供应商承担；在100小时多日储能区间与铁-空气等专业供应商保持开放合作。这一分层与公司全球交付资源配置一致。

四、合规、可调度、可融资优先于装机速度
无论是中国"四可"接入、动态duration-stratified分层定价，还是欧盟电池法案碳足迹尽职调查与FEOC本地化要求，我们认为新型储能应作为电力系统可调度的基础设施资源参与运行。我们将持续以"开放合作、合规经营、技术创新"的姿态支持各国监管框架适配，主动贡献电芯级全生命周期碳足迹、回收路径与本地化合规方案数据。

CATL的核心承诺不变：在全球公用事业市场提供可调度、可融资、具备长期质保保障的锂基（以LFP为主）与钠离子电池系统。合规、可调度、可融资的优先级高于装机速度与单一化学体系的短期市场份额竞争。

【European Commission — H1 2037: Distribution-Grid Storage Connection Reform Recommendation Published; Member State Implementation Roadmap】

The Commission today publishes its Recommendation on Distribution-Grid Storage Connection Reform, accompanied by an Implementation Roadmap for Member States. The Recommendation responds directly to the binding constraint now documented across major jurisdictions: the gap between announced and commissioned storage capacity is no longer an equipment-availability problem but a connection-queue and revenue-stack problem.

Key provisions:

1. Cluster-study methodology as the default. Member States shall, by end-2028, transition distribution-grid storage connection to a cluster-study methodology consistent with FERC Order 2023 principles, replacing the current first-come-first-served serial queue. ACER, in cooperation with the EU DSO Entity, will publish a reference methodology by Q4 2027.

2. Duration-aware capacity accreditation. Member States shall ensure that capacity mechanisms, where they exist, accredit storage on duration-weighted availability and dispatchability rather than nameplate interconnection capacity. The methodology shall be technology-neutral and aligned with the duration-stratified frameworks now operational in PJM, AEMO, and NDRC/NEA.

3. EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 alignment. Storage receiving connection under the reformed procedure shall, from the applicable dates, comply with EU Battery Regulation requirements: product carbon-footprint declaration, recycled content thresholds, supply-chain due diligence, and lifecycle traceability. The Commission will not allow the reformed procedure to become a back door for non-compliant imports.

4. Network cost allocation review. The Commission will launch a review of dual network charges on storage under Directive (EU) 2024/1711 transposition, with legislative proposal expected Q2 2028 if Member State implementation reveals persistent double-charging of storage assets.

5. Innovation Fund LDES window. The Commission confirms a dedicated Innovation Fund window for first-of-a-kind long-duration storage operating data collection, with award decisions expected Q4 2027. The window is designed to close the operating-record gap identified by IEA, DOE, and SECI as the remaining barrier to non-recourse financing at scale.

6. Net-Zero Industry Act 40% benchmark. The Commission's statutory 40% domestic manufacturing benchmark for strategic net-zero technologies by 2030 remains in force. The Innovation Fund window above is structured to avoid subsidising non-EU-manufactured capacity where European industrial capability exists or can be credibly built.

The Commission's reading of the current evidence base:

— PJM 2033/34 BRA confirms that iron-air and other multi-day technologies now clear capacity markets when accreditation reflects duration value. This is the most significant commercial proof-point for long-duration storage to date.

— FERC Order 2023 cluster-study empirical review will produce quantitative evidence on queue clearance, cost allocation, and project conversion that the EU will use directly in the reference methodology.

— NDRC/NEA's "four-able" standard and utilization-rate-linked capacity pricing remain the most operationally demanding dispatch framework globally. The EU will study adaptation to Member State regulatory contexts.

— IEA's scenario re-weighting confirms the Commission's prior judgment: the constraint is no longer technology cost but accreditation, interconnection, and revenue-stack design.

The Commission calls on Member States, ENTSO-E, the EU DSO Entity, and ACER to engage constructively on the Recommendation and Roadmap. The window for the EU to align its storage regulatory architecture with the operational frontier now documented in PJM, FERC, and NDRC/NEA is closing. Strategic autonomy and deployment speed are not in tension — they require the same regulatory perimeter.

The Commission's position remains: gigawatts delivered, duration valued, industrial base built, lifecycle enforced.

【Highview Power立場（2037-H1）: LAES商業化的Cap-and-Floor第二階段與「運行記錄替換過渡性融資」加速期】

伴隨DOE第四波數據集發布、PJM 2033/34拍賣長時資源首次跨越1 GW清算量級、IEA將LAES納入「8小時以上」研究探討序列、全球duration-stratified認證邏輯完成方法論收斂，Highview Power對Carrington 50 MW示範+300 MW商業項目的下一階段工作作出更新：

一、LAES從「研究探討序列」進入「商業化重點路線」。NDRC/NEA「十五五」明確液態空氣儲能與壓縮空氣、液流電池同列商業化重點，IEA 2033-H1《Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database》確認液態空氣儲能在8–100小時項目級數據模塊中的位置。這對英國LAES商業化的意義在於：(i)全球運行記錄基線從「零」開始形成，並開始以可驗證的方式收斂；(ii)非鋰路線在duration-stratified電價下的相對競爭力不再依賴單一國家的政策選擇。

二、Carrington 50 MW示範項目達到36個月連續運行記錄。本期內我們已達到DOE Liftoff式六維協議（可用率、點對聯網往返效率、合同輪廓履行、多循環衰減、輔助負荷、安全）36個月連續運行獨立驗證數據。我們將按IEA統一披露框架（EPC折算0.85/0.55/0.30）公開下一輪運行記錄，並以之替換Cap-and-floor期限內的部分過渡性風險對沖。具體而言：(i)RTE穩定在50–55%窗口，符合工程設計預期；(ii)SOC一致性≥99.5%；(iii)等效利用小時數達到合同框架要求；(iv)無安全事件。

三、300 MW商業項目非追索性融資轉換取得實質性進展。本期內，Highview已完成三家銀行對300 MW項目「過渡性融資→非追索性項目融資」轉換的條款細化，包括：(i)風險溢價重估所要求的最低運行記錄基線；(ii)質保承銷窗口（manufacturer warranty + independent verification）；(iii)容量可用率與等效利用小時數的合同掛鉤機制。我們預計2037年下半年完成財務結算（financial closing），將是英國首個由獨立驗證運行記錄驅動的LAES商業項目非追索性融資關閉。

四、Cap-and-floor第二階段（Control Period 2）機制完善。我們繼續支持Ofgem和NESO在Cap-and-floor第二階段引入三項機制完善：(i)按小時分層的容量可用率考核；(ii)運營數據獨立審計要求；(iii)分時段容量支付差異化。LAES的工程特性（模塊化、已建立的關鍵設備供應鏈、空氣介質無原材料風險）使其在多日可靠性檔（8–24小時）具備獨特適配性，這一點應在第二階段的產品分層中得到明確體現。

五、與歐盟EU 2024/1711指令、FERC Order 2023、NDRC「四可」要求的對齊。歐盟指令在duration-differentiated accreditation上的進展、美國FERC在集群研究方法論上的收斂、以及中國NDRC/NEA「四可」剛性約束，為英國LAES商業化提供了三套不同的監管範本。我們認為這三套範本的方向是一致的：按小時×可用率×調度貢獻三維度進行容量價值辨識。

商業化的瓶頸不在熱力學，而在質保與可融資性——這是Highview每一項融資決定、每一次技術披露、每一輪與監管機構對話的核心指導原則。Carrington 36個月連續運行記錄與300 MW非追索性融資關閉，將是LAES從「示範路線」進入「商業路線」兩個關鍵里程碑。

【SPPC 2037-H1 立场：四小时标准化主体不变，框架协议层引入混合duration配置空间】

PJM 2032/33 Base Residual Auction结果显示4小时级ELCC信用进一步压缩至77%、长时资源首次跨过4小时级净新增容量，这一实证信号对全球四小时LFP主导框架构成结构性压力。SPPC基于此对沙特储能采购体系作出以下部署：

一、4小时LFP标准化仍是主体档位，但框架协议层开放duration-mixed配置空间。PJM数据再次确认：在饱和容量市场环境下，单一4小时资产的经济性边际正在递减。但SPPC的招标主体地位仍由四小时LFP承担，原因有三：其一，沙特电网当前峰谷压力窗口集中在下午3时至夜间10时的7小时区间内，4小时配置仍可覆盖核心削峰填谷需求；其二，沙特融资环境对proven 4小时平台的非追索融资模板已经成熟，偏离标准化将推高融资成本；其三，沙特极端高温环境下LFP的热管理与降额验证已积累多轮运行数据，非锂技术路线的沙漠气候适应记录仍不充分。在主体4小时档位之外，SPPC框架协议层将允许投标联合体在特定场景下提交duration-mixed配置方案——例如4小时LFP + 8小时长时组件的混合组合，但混合方案的容量电价仍按各组件独立核算，不引入统一上浮。

二、正式采纳IEA高温环境EUH指标作为沙特体系下的运行验证基准。SPPC注意到IEA 2033-H2 retrospective明确将EUH指标作为中东、印度、澳大利亚等新兴市场的容量补偿关键工具。SPPC将在2037年起的所有新招标批次中要求投标人按EUH口径披露沙漠气候下的等效利用小时数与降额系数，作为运行验证阶段的硬约束指标之一。

三、按BYD 2034年披露的四阶段框架推进项目组合季度披露。SPPC与BYD在12.5 GWh已披露组合上已建立执行口径。下一阶段SPPC将把四阶段披露框架（框架协议→已招标未签约→已签约EPC开工→商运证书）扩展适用于所有框架协议中标方，并按季度公布各阶段容量分布。已签约EPC开工0.85、已招标未签约0.55、仅在排队中0.30的折算系数与IEA保持一致。

四、8小时以上档位在沙特场景下的工程研究。SPPC将针对红海沿岸高温高湿区域、远离负荷中心的光伏富集区、与海水淡化耦合的工业园区三个特定场景，开展8小时以上档位的工程可行性研究。研究结果将作为下一轮框架调整的输入，但不替代当前四小时LFP主体地位。

SPPC的核心承诺不变：在沙特公用事业市场提供可调度、可融资、可长期保障的储能系统。融资结构与设备价格同等重要。已宣布容量必须可追溯到具体工程节点。标准化是降低融资成本的工具，不是技术保守主义的代名词——当系统需求与运行验证明确指向新档位时，框架协议会随之调整，但调整必须以工程数据为基础，而非以市场叙事为驱动。

PJM Interconnection — 2034/35 Base Residual Auction Methodology Update and Forward Accreditation Review

Following the 2033/34 Base Residual Auction, PJM is publishing methodology updates and forward guidance for the 2034/35 delivery year. The 2033/34 results — in which long-duration storage, predominantly iron-air, represented the majority of incremental storage clearing for the first time in PJM auction history — confirm that the duration-weighted accreditation reform, the FERC Order No. 2023 cluster-study framework, and the operating-record eligibility pathway are jointly producing the conditions for reliable long-duration capacity procurement at scale.

Methodology updates for 2034/35:

1. ELCC class curve recalibration. The 2033/34 LOLE study confirms the 4-hour-class coefficient at approximately 75%, down from 92% pre-reform and 80% in 2030/31. The long-duration coefficient (8-hour-plus) remains at 99-100%. PJM will publish the full class curve documentation in Q2 2034 with the 2034/35 BRA parameters. The trajectory is consistent with the structural cannibalization signal that duration-weighted accreditation was designed to produce.

2. Performance Assessment Hour framework refinement. PJM, in coordination with the Independent Market Monitor and with technical support from DOE national laboratories, is finalizing the multi-day renewable-drought event capture protocol referenced in prior communications. The revised PAH framework will be filed with FERC under Section 205 in Q3 2034, with stakeholder comment period to follow.

3. Long-duration accreditation review. The 2033/34 clearing volume of approximately 3,400 MW of long-duration entry — predominantly iron-air — demonstrates that the operating-record eligibility pathway is producing bankable projects at scale. PJM's accreditation review for 2034/35 will assess whether additional duration-class differentiation (e.g., 100-hour-plus) is warranted based on the demonstrated performance of the iron-air cohort. The methodology remains technology-neutral; any differentiation reflects duration of verified contribution to system stress coverage.

4. CPRO framework continuity. Capacity Performance non-performance charges across the 2033/34 delivery year remain at modest levels across all duration classes, including the new long-duration cohort. The framework is functioning as designed.

5. Forward pipeline. The active interconnection queue continues to show material long-duration application volume. Under FERC Order No. 2023 cluster-study procedures, the application-to-COD interval continues to shorten. PJM expects the 2034/35 BRA to clear further long-duration volume, with iron-air applications representing a significant share.

Institutional position:

PJM's capacity market exists to send price signals that elicit sufficient reliable supply. The 2026/27 through 2033/34 auction sequence demonstrates that the duration-weighted accreditation methodology, combined with FERC-approved tariff frameworks, is producing the supply mix that the system requires at scarcity hours. Short-duration resources continue to clear and continue to receive compensation calibrated to their verified reliability contribution. Long-duration resources, having crossed the operating-record threshold, are now clearing at scale and receiving compensation commensurate with their broader stress-window coverage.

PJM does not endorse specific technologies. The cleared mix reflects the application of rules to all qualified resources, with payment linked to verified availability during system stress. The international convergence on this architecture — across ERCOT, AEMO, SECI, NDRC/NEA, MACSE, and the Gulf Cooperation Council grids — confirms that duration-weighted accreditation is the emerging global standard for capacity-market design in systems with material variable renewable penetration.

The remaining work is execution: continued calibration of accreditation parameters, continued refinement of the Performance Assessment Hour definition, continued engagement with state regulators on consumer-cost implications, and continued publication of cleared-MW, commissioned-MW, and verified-operating-MW breakdowns consistent with international disclosure standards.

【国家能源局就2037年下半年新型储能高质量发展作出部署】

"十五五"新型储能规划中期评估已顺利完成。评估认为，各地区、各部门深入贯彻规划部署，新型储能在装机规模、调用水平、安全管理、市场机制等方面取得阶段性成效，但项目转化率不均衡、长时储能商业化进度不及预期、部分省级报送口径不统一等问题仍较突出。为深入推进"建机制、提质量、保安全"工作，2037年下半年重点部署如下：

一、深化容量电价与运行考核硬挂钩。各省级电网企业要严格按《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则（试行）》及《关于"十五五"新型储能规划编制若干重大问题的指导意见》要求，按月报送分时长（2-4小时、4-8小时、8小时以上）调度运行数据，重点指标包括：等效利用小时数、调度响应合规率、连续可用时长、SOC一致性。运行数据质量纳入企业考核。对连续两个考核周期低于基准值的项目，扣减容量电价、暂缓调度调用。

二、强化"四可"并网门槛全周期执行。新建新型储能项目并网前必须完成遥测、遥信、遥控、遥调"四可"功能联调，并通过电力调度机构组织的验收。验收未通过的项目不得并网投运，不得参与电力市场化交易，不得享受容量电价及辅助服务市场补偿。各电网企业要严格执行安全监管实施细则及补充规定，落实全过程监管责任。

三、推进多元化技术路线分级管理。压缩空气储能、液流电池、钠离子电池三类商业化重点技术，按规定完成并网验收，按季度统一纳入并网调度管理；对固态电池、重力储能、热储能、氢储能等示范应用类技术，坚持"示范先行、规模适度、数据验证"原则，单个项目规模原则上不超过100MW；对铁-空气电池、液态空气等前沿技术，鼓励产学研联合攻关。各类技术均需满足"四可"并网要求并接受全生命周期运行评价。

四、深化"宣告容量—可交付容量"转换披露框架。各省级能源主管部门要会同电网企业，按季度披露本辖区储能项目从已宣布、已招标未签约、已签约未开工/在建、已投运的全链条数据，按技术路线和时长分类汇总后报我局。我局将依据这些数据，按技术路线×时长×辖区三维分布评估全国项目转化率，作为后续投资引导、政策支持与差异化监管的重要依据。

五、严守安全底线。组织全国新型储能电站安全专项排查"回头看"，重点排查电池热失控、消防设施、涉网保护等关键环节，对发现问题坚决整改到位、追责到位。运行5年以上的储能电站要逐步纳入在役抽检范围，建立电池健康状态评估机制。

六、深化国际合作。我局愿与FERC、AEMO、ERCOT、SECI、IEA等国际同行加强交流，分享中国新型储能市场化机制建设经验，特别是在duration-stratified容量电价、调度利用小时数与容量补偿挂钩机制、多元化技术路线分级推进机制、宣告—可交付容量转换披露等方面的实践。继续推进project conversion数据互认机制，为全球资本配置者与政策制定者提供更精确的可比基线。

新型储能行业要坚决贯彻"安全底线、调度优先、市场导向"原则，持续推进"建机制、提质量、保安全"工作，让储能真正成为新型电力系统的可靠调节资源，确保"十五五"规划目标如期高质量实现，为2030年累计装机300GW以上、2035年累计装机500GW以上、其中长时储能（4小时以上）占比不低于50%的递进目标奠定坚实基础。

【IEA 2037-H2立场：项目转化率数据库首批数据汇总与SECI可比基准】

SECI今日发布的BESS-02授标结果与印度BESS存量转化率首次权威披露，是IEA《Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database》首批成员国数据汇总的关键里程碑。IEA的解读如下：

一、SECI披露数据与IEA框架首次实现可比校准。

SECI按IEA统一口径披露的四级存量分类（已签约PPA且具备融资关闭条件18%、已授标但融资关闭滞后25%、已宣布未授标52%、概念阶段5%），加权平均转化系数从0.27提升至0.34。这一改善反映了三项系统性措施的复合效应：DISCOM信用评级挂钩、融资关闭节点管理、并网数据前置披露。IEA将把SECI数据作为亚洲辖区的基准样本纳入全球汇总。

二、BESS-02授标结果验证了duration-stratified机制对差异化时长资源的引导作用。

6h LFP边际报价价差收窄至2%以内（饱和信号），8h液流与12h CAES呈现15-22%合理溢价。这一结果与PJM 2031/32 BRA的实证（4h ICAP 79%、8h+ 99-100%）以及NDRC三档容量电价机制的方向高度一致。IEA将在2038-H1发布的《Duration-Matched Capital Allocation Framework》第二版中纳入SECI BESS-02作为"长时档首次独立产品线"的国际可比样本。

三、4h级资源的结构性压力已成为跨辖区共识。

PJM四年ICAP压缩（95%→77%）、NDRC调度边际化证据、SECI 6h LFP饱和信号三者共同指向同一结论：4h级锂离子资产在未来3-5年面临经济性压缩。IEA建议成员国财政部、央行与开发性金融机构在主权担保、优惠贷款与绿色债券标准中引入"按时长分级的差异化资本权重"，避免将4h级资产的成熟度误用为长时资产的融资模板。

四、下一观察窗口：2038-H1《WEO 2038》储能专题。

IEA将在2038-H1完成四情景权重的再次校准，重点检验：(1) SECI BESS-02 8/12h档项目的签约-开工-并网三阶段转化率，与SPPC 15年SAA、State Grid四档容量电价机制的口径一致性；(2) DOE第三波验证数据集与SECI本土化标定（印度30-35% RTE、热管理需求、SOC一致性维护成本）的互认进展；(3) MACSE类长期合同在已签约项目运营记录触发后续批次清算条款时的实际兑现情况。

IEA核心判断：净零路径的可融资性取决于容量认证、并网调度与长时合同三者的协同；项目转化率的统一披露正成为跨辖区资本配置的关键基础设施。SECI的首次权威披露证明这一基础设施可在联邦采购体系下落地，IEA数据库将在2038年扩展至覆盖G20全部成员国。

【DOE就"十五五"新型储能规划中期评估与2037年深化改革部署发布官方回应（2037-H2）】

DOE注意到NDRC/NEA发布的"十五五"新型储能规划中期评估结论及2037年深化改革部署。DOE对评估结论所揭示的若干结构性事实作出以下回应：

一、对中期评估四项主要结论的回应

1. **关于LFP四小时级资源调度边际化**：DOE认同此为可预见的、市场驱动的结构性结果。在PJM，4小时级ICAP信用已从改革前的约92%降至2033/34拍卖的75%，与NDRC/NEA观察到的国内4小时级调峰贡献度同比提高、2小时以下资源调度边际化高度一致。这正是duration-stratified机制设计目标的兑现——市场信号正在正确引导投资向多日资源流动。

2. **关于长时储能占比目标**：DOE欢迎NDRC明确"长时储能占比目标应作为约束性指标，而非参考性指标"的提法。DOE将国内2030年3 GW/年选定LDES制造产能、2035年10-15 GW/年的目标作为Liftoff战略的约束性承诺予以推进。DOE在2037-H1启动的第二批LDES制造扩产资助（FOA）正是兑现这一承诺的具体步骤。

3. **关于度电成本降幅收窄**：DOE认同此为成熟技术的常态特征。LFP成本下降空间收窄的下一阶段意义在于：技术成熟度足以支撑4小时级市场的稳定竞争，而非继续依赖补贴驱动。DOE的资源将向仍存在显著成本与效率差距的多日技术路线（铁-空气、液流、先进压缩空气、储热）集中。

4. **关于示范应用阶段技术**：DOE认同固态电池、重力储能、储热、氢储能的"示范应用阶段"定位，并将在Liftoff第五波验证数据集中继续跟踪其独立验证的运行数据，避免示范阶段技术过早被市场期望定型。

二、对2037年深化改革三项部署的回应

1. **准入与并网标准化**：DOE支持NDRC/NEA推动的全国统一新型储能项目准入、并网、运维、退役标准化体系。DOE Liftoff第四波数据集采用的独立第三方验证标准（覆盖并网点性能、可用率、持续出力、退化曲线、安全记录、全寿命成本）与此标准化方向一致。

2. **多元化技术商业化**：DOE同意按"商业化重点/示范应用/研究探索"三级推进多元化技术路线，避免技术分级与duration档位错配。DOE第二批LDES制造扩产资助的国内制造产能目标同样聚焦于铁-空气、液流、先进压缩空气、储热四类非锂路线。

3. **多日资源支持机制**：DOE愿意与NDRC/NEA在多日资源（100小时以上）的容量市场与运行市场双重定价机制、长时资源退役与再投资政策、多日资源与24/7清洁能源合约衔接模板等方面继续合作。

三、对国际对话建议的回应

DOE提议在PNNL牵头的"项目转换率披露联合工作组"框架下，2038年上半年召开第二次工作组会议，重点议题包括：

1. 中国"宣告容量—可交付容量"转换披露框架与IEA四级折算体系、FERC interconnection-application-to-COD conversion rate报告机制的最终对齐方案；
2. 多日资源（100小时以上）的ELCC/ICAP方法学跨辖区比较研究；
3. State Grid盐穴A-CAES、人工硐室型CAES在300MW级项目的并网验收标准与DOE Liftoff验证标准的对接。

四、立场重申

DOE立场不变：可融资性、可调度性、合规性优先于装机速度。DOE将继续以Liftoff战略、Title XVII贷款工具与PNNL国家实验室技术分析为支撑，推动LDES商业化下半场的制造规模、收入机制与运行数据披露常态化。

【ERCOT 2037-H2 Update: Stakeholder Process Progress, ORDC Multi-Day Calibration Modeling, and International Coordination on Forward Reliability Product Design】

This communique updates stakeholders on three workstreams initiated in 2037-H1 and confirms ERCOT's continuing position on multi-day reliability.

1. Stakeholder process — received comments and IMM review

ERCOT has received comments from 28 stakeholders representing generators, independent power producers, storage developers, financial institutions, retail electricity providers, and consumer advocacy organizations. The ERCOT Independent Market Monitor has completed its preliminary review. The dominant themes:

a) Tier subdivision within the 24-hour-plus tier — broad support for the 24-72 / 72-168 / 168+ structure. Several commenters noted that the 168+ tier should be reserved for resources with verified multi-day operating record, not theoretical capability.

b) ORDC re-calibration to multi-day reserve conditions — strong support in principle; concern from some stakeholders about whether quarterly NPRR1236-style adjustment is the right cadence for ORDC, or whether annual re-calibration would provide better investment-grade signal stability for multi-day resources.

c) Forward reliability product — most controversial. Generation and storage developers split: some argue a forward product is necessary to underwrite multi-day resources at merchant returns; others argue scarcity pricing through ORDC is sufficient and a forward product risks reintroducing administrative procurement. ERCOT's position remains: any forward product must be procured through scarcity-based price signals, not administrative contracts.

2. ERCOT modeling results on multi-day ORDC calibration

ERCOT staff has completed preliminary modeling on ORDC re-calibration to multi-day reserve conditions. Headline results:

a) At current ORDC price floor ($9,000/MWh), multi-day reserve scarcity events produce fewer than 0.5 trigger events per year in the base case. This is below the threshold needed to underwrite multi-day resources at merchant-only returns.

b) An ORDC price floor in the $11,000-$13,000/MWh range, combined with a multi-day reserve demand curve, produces 2-4 trigger events per year and average scarcity rents of approximately $85-$120/kW-year for multi-day resources. This is materially above current 8-24 hour tier revenues.

c) Sensitivity analysis indicates the multi-day ORDC calibration is robust across a range of load growth and renewable penetration scenarios, but is sensitive to the assumed frequency and severity of multi-day weather events.

3. International coordination

a) PJM: ERCOT has shared NPRR1236 quarterly cadence data with PJM's LOLE study team. PJM's parallel evaluation of dynamic accreditation is referenced in our joint technical exchange. ERCOT and PJM staff will hold a technical workshop in 2038-H1 on dynamic accreditation methodology convergence.

b) DOE: ERCOT has submitted ERCOT-specific weather-year and load-shape data for the 2032 winter event and subsequent operating years to the DOE national-lab multi-day adequacy study.

c) IEA: ERCOT has contributed per-tier accreditation evolution data, quarterly NPRR1236 adjustment records, and merchant revenue-by-tier data to the IEA dynamic-accreditation quantitative impact study and the Long-Duration Storage Project Pipeline Database.

d) NDRC/NEA: ERCOT has shared the NPRR tier-subdivision methodology and ORDC multi-day calibration modeling with NEA's capacity-pricing technical working group. The NDRC dynamic accreditation evolution direction described in NEA's 2037 communique is closely aligned with ERCOT's NPRR1236 approach.

e) SECI: ERCOT and SECI staff have exchanged notes on forward reliability product design and payment-security instruments. SECI's tender-to-commissioning conversion discipline remains the benchmark for converting announced capacity into operating assets.

4. Next steps

- 2038-H1: PUCT filing of revised NPRR with tier subdivision and ORDC multi-day calibration. Continued stakeholder process for forward reliability product design evaluation.
- 2038-H2: PUCT decision. If approved, implementation begins 2039-H1.
- 2039-H1: First operational period under revised tier structure and ORDC calibration.

ERCOT remains committed to competitive energy markets, scarcity-based price signals, and technology-neutral reliability standards. Multi-day reliability will be revealed through scarcity pricing, not purchased through administrative contracts.

— ERCOT Market Operations & System Planning

【国家电网2037年下半年新型储能并网调度安全监管与"四可"刚性约束深化执行情况通报】

国家电网有限公司坚决执行《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则》及补充规定，强化容量补偿与运行绩效联动。现将2037年下半年关键工作通报如下：

一、深化"十五五"中期评估整改与"四可"刚性约束

1. 各省级电网企业已严格落实NEA《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则》要求，按月报送调度运行数据，重点指标包括：等效利用小时数、调度响应合规率、连续可用时长、SOC一致性；
2. 容量电价与项目调度利用小时数、市场化调用率两项核心指标挂钩机制运行平稳，年度调用率低于20%的项目按规定扣减容量电价；
3. 多次不服从调度指令的项目纳入失信名单。

二、统一并网验收与持续运行监测

1. 对已纳入商业化示范的非锂长时储能项目实施统一并网验收和持续运行监测，重点核验：系统级可用率、持续放电能力、响应精度、遥测合规性及安全记录；
2. 有关项目须以真实、连续、可审计的运行数据证明系统价值；
3. 坚持技术中立、标准一致，支持多元技术在适配场景稳妥示范；
4. 坚决防范低效闲置和安全风险。

三、关于PJM 2032/33 BRA及CATL回应的判断

我方注意到PJM 2032/33拍卖中长时资源（约2,300 MW，含铁-空气首次跨过商业化门槛）首次超过4小时级净新增入市容量，4小时级ELCC进一步压缩至约77%；同时注意到CATL对钠离子"互补平台而非替代方案"的定位以及对LFP可融资默认化的承诺。这两项国际信号与我方实践一致：

1. 我方将持续以可验证、连续、可审计的运行数据作为容量补偿与并网验收的核心依据，而非单一铭牌装机；
2. 4小时级及以下项目边际化趋势已在我方经营区出现，需通过duration-stratified机制动态调整容量电价水平；
3. 长时及非锂技术按商业化、示范应用、研究探索分级推进，确保按期并网、可调度、可融资、可持续运行。

四、关于ERCOT NPRR1236动态认证季度报告的借鉴

ERCOT NPRR1236动态持续时间分层认证首份季度评估报告显示：8小时级资产性能系数维持0.84，6小时级上调至0.79，weather zone差异化设计回应了"区域可靠性需求差异"。这一实践经验对我方完善区域差异化容量电价机制具有借鉴意义。公司将结合各省级电网实际，探索引入weather zone/省级电网差异化权重，提高容量价格信号的精确性。

五、下一步工作

1. 配合NDRC/NEA做好"十五五"新型储能规划中期评估整改落实；
2. 强化区域差异化容量电价机制研究，结合各省供需变化动态调整；
3. 持续深化国际技术交流，分享中国duration-stratified容量电价机制建设经验。

国家电网将持续坚持"安全底线、调度优先、市场导向"原则，以可验证的运行数据为基础，让储能真正成为新型电力系统的可靠调节资源。

【SECI 2037-H2立场：BESS-01首批运行数据公开披露——支持PJM动态accreditation演进与"运行记录+项目融资"纪律】

2037年下半年，SECI在完成BESS-01批次（375 MW/1,500 MWh UPPCL四小时独立BESS）首批运行数据披露后，作出以下部署：

二、运行数据驱动的prepayment融资机制。SECI对融资关闭180天锁定期作以下优化：在BESS-02的8/12小时档中标项目中，前30%建设资金按"并网+首批90天连续运行达标"两项里程碑节点付款，而非常规的开工节点。此项prepayment结构与BYD-LFP-6H-Plus、BYD-LFP-8H-Pro标准化产品的实证运行业绩保持一致，有助于改善项目LCOE、缩短贷方尽调周期。

三、Bankability of long-duration: 与DOE第三波数据、State Grid动态分层信号的对接。SECI将针对印度国土条件下8/12小时档液流电池与CAES的运行数据，与DOE第三波独立验证数据集进行本土化标定——重点关注RTE边界、SOC一致性维护成本、长时循环下的可用率衰减。该项标定将与SPPC的12.5 GWh沙特运行数据、英国Cap-and-Floor路径下的8小时档项目数据互认，形成多边可比基线。

四、对PJM"年vs季度"accreditation差异的回应。SECI注意到PJM对当前年度ICAP方法的稳定性论据：年度ICAP对投资等级信号稳定性的贡献。SECI内部也存在相同的张力——年度披露的转化率与项目KPI对贷方更友好，而季度披露对调度员更友好。SECI将在BESS-03招标文件中，对4小时/6小时/8小时/12小时四个时长档分别采用差异化的披露节奏：4-6小时档采用季度披露（适合短时市场的边际信号），8小时以上档采用半年度披露（符合贷方对长期PPA的尽调需求）。

五、对中国NEA"十五五"中期评估的回应。NEA在中期评估中已确认2030年300 GW、2035年500 GW目标的可行性与长时储能占比约束。SECI将借鉴NEA的三类技术分级经验（商业化重点、示范应用、研究探索），在印度联邦采购中建立类似分级——商业化重点（LFP / Sodium-ion 2-4小时）、示范应用（液流 / CAES 8小时以上）、研究探索（铁-空气 / 热储能）按"已签约-开工-并网"三级里程碑设置差异化的VGF支持强度。

【Highview Power立場（2037-H2）: 對PJM CPRO長時框架澄清的回應，與Cap-and-Floor Control Period 2機制設計的銜接】

PJM今日發布的Capacity Performance框架對長時儲能的澄清，對全球液態空氣儲能(LAES)的可融資性評估具有直接意義。Highview Power的核心觀察有三：

一、「性能評估窗口不對長時資源設置上限」這一原則，是LAES工程特性與容量市場信用方法論的關鍵契合點。PJM明確：對於放電能力超出任何單個PAH區間的資源，可用性按其在整個連續區間的持續出力評估。LAES架構上的天然特性是「放電時長由冷存儲容器容積決定，與裝機容量解耦」——即8小時、12小時、24小時或多日配置可以共用同一套透平機械、空氣分離與低溫熱交換核心設備，僅改變冷存儲容器規模與運行包絡。這一特性與PJM CPRO「按實際持續出力評估」的原則高度匹配。

二、Highview目前正在Cap-and-Floor Control Period 2機制設計中向Ofgem和NESO建議引入的兩項機制，與PJM CPRO邏輯同源：(i)按小時分層的容量可用率考核——對4小時與8小時+資源採用不同PAH窗口的可用性評估；(ii)分時段容量支付差異化——按系統應力窗口持續時間對長時資源給予相應補償。我們認為，LAES的模塊化特性使其在Cap-and-Floor Control Period 2下的8–24小時檔具有工程性適配優勢。

三、Carrington 50 MW示範項目的下一步目標是「達到48個月連續運行記錄並向全球同步披露」。Highview將按IEA四級折算體系（EPC折算0.85/0.55/0.30）與PJM CPRO六維協議（可用率、點對聯網RTE、合同輪廓履行、多循環衰減、輔助負荷、安全）的接合方式，在2038年上半年公布Carrington示範的48個月連續運行獨立驗證數據，並以此推動300 MW商業項目的非追索性融資結算（financial closing）完成。

結語：商業化的瓶頸不在熱力學，而在質保、可融資性與監管可預期性三者的同步。PJM CPRO澄清、英國Cap-and-Floor Control Period 2、歐盟EU 2024/1711、NDRC「十五五」三檔定價共同指向同一結論——「按小時×可用率×調度貢獻三維度辨識容量價值」，這套方法論對LAES的工程特性具有結構性友好。高密度、多日、模塊化部署的LAES，將在這一套方法論下找到自己的可融資位置。

Federal Energy Regulatory Commission — Statement on the PJM Capacity Market Five-Year Retrospective and Implications for Order No. 2023 Implementation Review

The Commission has reviewed PJM's capacity market five-year retrospective covering delivery years 2026/27 through 2032/33, together with the corresponding IEA interpretation noting that this dataset represents the first empirical realization of duration-stratified methodology convergence across PJM, ERCOT, NDRC/NEA, AEMO, the Italian MACSE framework, and the UK cap-and-floor regime. The Commission offers the following observations.

1. **The PJM five-year retrospective is the first multi-cycle empirical validation of duration-weighted accreditation under Order No. 2023.** The documented trajectory — 4-hour-class ICAP coefficients declining from approximately 95% (2026/27) to approximately 77% (2032/33), while 8-hour-plus resources maintain accreditation at approximately 99–100%, and new long-duration entry rising from zero to approximately 2,300 MW (2032/33) — demonstrates that the accreditation methodology is operating as designed. The Commission considers this the most significant empirical evidence to date on the structural effects of duration-weighted accreditation in a FERC-jurisdictional capacity market.

2. **Conversion-rate disclosure and the Order No. 2023 implementation review.** The Commission's Order No. 2023 implementation review — scheduled to conclude following the first full cluster-study cycle in 2027–2028 — will draw on the PJM five-year retrospective as one of its primary empirical inputs. The retrospective's documentation of application-to-COD intervals, milestone compliance, withdrawal patterns, and the relationship between accreditation methodology and interconnection outcomes provides exactly the data the Commission needs to assess whether the cluster-study reform has produced the intended outcomes. The Commission will publish a comprehensive Order No. 2023 implementation assessment that incorporates these findings.

3. **Reliability performance under the reformed framework.** PJM's report that Capacity Performance non-performance charges have remained at modest levels and that reliability indicators have remained within target ranges throughout the retrospective period is significant. The duration-weighted accreditation reform was not designed to compromise reliability; it was designed to align capacity compensation with verified reliability contribution. The retrospective's reliability data suggest that the reform has achieved this alignment without adverse reliability effects. The Commission will consider whether PJM's CPRO framework — including its performance-assessment-hour design and non-performance penalty calibration — should be examined as a model for other FERC-jurisdictional ISO/RTOs.

4. **Cross-jurisdictional learning — six parallel mechanisms.** The Commission notes the IEA observation that six duration-stratified mechanisms are now operating in parallel across PJM (annual duration-weighted ICAP), ERCOT (semi-annual rolling calibration under NPRR1234), NDRC/NEA (three-tier capacity pricing under the 15th Five-Year Plan), AEMO (duration-aware ISP), the Italian MACSE framework (long-tenor capacity procurement for 8+ hour), and the UK cap-and-floor regime (long-tenor revenue floor). The Commission regards this convergence as analytical confirmation that duration-stratified accreditation is now the international norm. The Commission's procedural framework, however, remains the controlling standard for FERC-jurisdictional matters; any incorporation of a foreign mechanism requires Section 205 filing with adequate record support.

5. **Manufacturing and supply-chain considerations — the Commission's role.** The Commission notes NDRC/NEA's references to the DOE Liftoff revised methodology and to the global manufacturing scale-up required for long-duration routes (iron-air, flow batteries, advanced compressed-air). The Commission's role is not to direct manufacturing or supply-chain policy; that responsibility lies with DOE, the Department of Commerce, and the Department of the Treasury. The Commission's role is to ensure that FERC-jurisdictional tariffs provide non-discriminatory market access for all compliant resources, regardless of manufacturing origin. The Commission will continue to engage with DOE on federal coordinated framework matters, while maintaining the Commission's independent regulatory authority.

6. **Technology neutrality preserved.** The PJM five-year retrospective validates the Commission's technology-neutral principle: long-duration resources cleared at premium accreditation because of their verified reliability contribution, not because of any technology preference. The Commission will continue to evaluate market outcomes and Section 205 proposals under this principle. The Commission's accreditation framework does not favor any particular storage technology, duration class, or manufacturer; it requires that compensation reflect verified reliability contribution during system stress windows.

7. **Forward agenda — the 2027–2028 Order No. 2023 implementation assessment.** The Commission reaffirms its intent to publish a comprehensive Order No. 2023 implementation assessment following the completion of the first full cluster-study cycle in 2027–2028. The assessment will draw on: (i) PJM's five-year retrospective and subsequent auction results; (ii) cluster-study implementation data from CAISO, MISO, ISO-NE, NYISO, SPP, and other FERC-jurisdictional transmission providers; (iii) the DOE Liftoff demonstration cohort datasets; (iv) state regulatory commission findings; and (v) comments from market participants, the Independent Market Monitor, and other stakeholders. The assessment will inform any Commission determination on whether supplemental rulemaking or compliance guidance is warranted.

The Commission regards the PJM five-year retrospective as a foundational document for the next phase of Order No. 2023 implementation review. The Commission thanks PJM, the Independent Market Monitor, and the stakeholder community for the rigor and transparency of this empirical work.

【DOE Liftoff 2034制造业普查正式发布（2038-H1）】

DOE今日发布美国长时储能制造业年度普查报告，覆盖五类非锂技术路线的国内制造产能、用工、出口能力与本土化率。普查是与Liftoff框架下选定LDES制造产能目标（约3 GW/年，至2030年；10-15 GW/年，至2035年）绑定的基础政策工具，也是Title XVII贷款分期拨付与FEOC本土化门槛执行的核心依据。

一、五类非锂技术路线国内制造产能状况

1. **液流电池**：国内膜制造产能自2032-H1 Title XVII贷款包投放以来已增至三倍。三座新膜制造工厂进入调试阶段，一座在建；堆栈组装产能同步扩大。Title XVII奖项下本土化门槛已被满足。

2. **先进压缩空气**：透平机械制造产能已能支撑两座商业级参考电厂与下一波项目承诺。压力容器制造是进一步扩产的绑定约束；一座新工厂在Title XVII支持下在建。

3. **铁-空气**：基板制造已扩产以匹配示范队列与首波商业级项目需求；辅机按计划推进。Form Energy报告的参考机队运行数据（100小时持续放电、RTE 45-55%、15年容量合同可用率）与DOE Liftoff第四波独立验证数据集一致。

4. **储热**：热交换器与储热介质制造持续扩产，匹配区域供热与工业工艺热需求；公用事业级容量在制造基础中占比仍较小。

5. **氢衍生储能**：辅机制造仍受限，商业级成本高于Liftoff多日目标。

二、汇总判断

五类路线合计制造产能已足以支撑2030年约3 GW/年的选定LDES制造目标。2035年10-15 GW/年目标要求持续投资、持续的长期购销承诺、持续的Title XVII贷款分期拨付至本十年末。

三、国际政策环境已达成结构一致性

DOE注意到以下三个国际进展已形成完整闭环：

1. NDRC/NEA"十五五"长时储能商业化扩展方案（至2035年4小时以上300+ GW、8小时以上80+ GW）是全球最宏大的政策信号；
2. SECI在SECI/2033/BESS-03标段实现液流电池占比22%，非锂份额较前一标段翻倍，是液流电池成本下行与印度招采框架下可融资性的最清晰证据；
3. IEA《WEO 2030》情景权重由47/29/18/6向25/30/18/22调整、显著提升Stagnation权重，是bankability gap正在收窄但对规模化非追索融资仍是绑定约束的清醒信号。

四、DOE 2038-H2行动部署

1. 按既定时间表继续发布示范数据波次与制造业普查。Liftoff第五波数据集目标于2038-H2发布。2034制造业普查为下一轮Title XVII拨付决策的基准。
2. 与FERC在PJM下Performance Assessment Hour演化以及多日可再生干旱事件长时资源评估工程基础方面继续协调。DOE通过国家实验室分析支持此技术评估。
3. 与NDRC/NEA、SECI、AEMO、ERCOT、IEA继续国际技术交流，重点议题：协调项目转换报告、扩展24小时以上应力窗口的多日充裕度指标、动态校准重新校准的工程参数。

Liftoff框架的2035年修订目标、示范数据波次、制造业普查与Title XVII贷款拨付时间表是至2035年的政策基准。资本配置者、ISO/RTO、州监管委员会与国际同行应以此为采购、accreditation、融资与购销决策的依据。

【IEA 2038-H1立场：四阶段披露框架进入全球可比阶段】

NDRC/NEA"十五五"中期评估与2037深化部署、State Grid 80 GW 8h+并网路线图、BYD四阶段披露体系的正式发布，三件事在同一时期交汇，标志着IEA《Global Energy Storage Project Conversion Database》四阶段统一口径已完成从框架倡议到跨辖区规模化实施的转化。IEA的解读如下：

一、IEA数据库2038-H1完成首批G20成员国数据汇总。

IEA已完成31个成员国及联系会员的2025-2037年项目数据采集，按"已宣布（IEA折算0.15）/已招标未签约（0.5）/已签约未开工或在建（0.4）/已投运（1.0）"四阶段分类登记。首批汇总数据呈现三个结构性发现：

(1) 全球加权平均转化系数从2025年的0.38提升至2037年的0.42，成熟辖区（PJM/NEM/MACSE）已达0.62，新兴市场仍处于0.12-0.25区间。方法学一致性而非技术成熟度，已成为跨辖区转化率分化的主因。

(2) 中国"十五五"中期评估显示4h+长时装机占比稳步提升至38%以上，8h+长时项目按"可研收尾+并网在即"阶段披露占比显著上升，与PJM 2033/34 BRA 3,400 MW长时入市（铁-空气为主）的实证相互印证。

(3) BYD四阶段披露体系（沙特15.1 GWh后续框架协议按第一阶段、已招标未签约按第二阶段、已签约EPC且开工按第三阶段、商业投运按第四阶段披露）首次将IEA框架嵌入全球主流厂商的常规披露实践，标志着框架从政策语言进入商业语言。

二、IEA与FERC的合作进入实证校验阶段。

FERC今日对PJM 2033/34 BRA的官方回应（4h级ICAP约75%、8h+约99-100%、首次大规模长时入市约3,400 MW）构成长时储能商业化的第一个FERC-validated实证基准。IEA将与FERC、PJM合作，将这一基准纳入《Duration-Matched Capital Allocation Framework》第二版的"已验证-未验证"分界线。

三、IEA对Terna等系统运营者的下一阶段建议。

MACSE类长期合同在2038-2040年面临的关键问题是：(1) 已签约项目的运营记录触发后续批次清算条款的实际兑现情况；(2) 非锂技术首台套业绩基准是否形成可比矩阵。IEA建议Terna在下一轮MACSE批次设计中引入"按IEA四阶段口径披露的项目转化率作为合同清算参数"，并将其与PJM 2033/34 BRA、SECI BESS-02、State Grid 80 GW路线的实证数据形成可比较的对照样本。

四、下一观察窗口：2038-H2《WEO 2038》储能专题与IEA第二版框架发布。

IEA核心判断：净零路径的可融资性取决于容量认证、并网调度与长时合同三者的协同；项目转化率的统一披露正成为跨辖区资本配置的关键基础设施。FERC对PJM结果的官方回应与NDRC中期评估在2038-H1同时出现，是这一基础设施从"倡议"转化为"既成事实"的拐点。
