FERC Order 2023的集群研究改革将于2027-2028年迎来首批成果检验。我们关注的核心指标是：申请到投运的铅质时间是否缩短、项目退出率是否下降、储能在容量市场与并网队列的占比是否提升。如果互联队列改革成功，储能将获得更确定的容量认证与并网时间表，市场金融商会重新评估长时储能的现金流确定性。
PJM的2026/27基本剩余拍卖以接近329美元/MW-天的净CONE价格仅清算5510MW四小时级资源，这一结果应被理解为：市场开始为时长与可用性付费，而不仅仅是铭牌兆瓦。我们预计后续拍卖将逐步引入时长加权与可用性认证，这将深刻影响八小时以上长时储能的商业化时机。
ERCOT电池收益从2023年约192美元/kW年骤降至2024年约55美元/kW年，下降71%，核心原因是BESS参与装机突破3GW后同类服务饱和。德州仅能源市场设计叠加每年5-10GW新增储能，使调频与辅助服务收入被严重内卷化。这一信号预示：单纯依赖四小时套利的项目面临普遍收入压缩，差异化时长资产与多收益栈叠加才是出路。
宁德时代将持续扩大LFP规模，同时推进钠离子电池40GWh产能建设，目标是把钠离子定位为LFP的互补平台而非替代品。这一战略意味着：2026-2030年LFP仍主导四小时储能成本曲线，钠离子则在低成本细分市场（如两小时以下、寒冷气候、地理分散场景）实现差异化切入。两者的竞争点不是谁替代谁，而是谁在哪个细分时长跑通成本-性能平衡。
国际能源署净零情景要求2030年全球电网级储能达约1500GW（含户用），其中电池约1200GW，配套投资约8000亿美元。这一目标是情景路径，并非预测。关键问题在于：在已宣布项目与排队容量转化为运营资产效率较低的背景下，IEA净零轨迹是否具备可融资现金流支撑？这需要电池成本进一步下降、容量市场与辅助服务市场协同、以及长时储能商业化共同实现。
DOE长期储能示范项目已于2023-2024年完成遴选，并正在与各技术路线方协商披露条件。我们注意到液流电池项目的信息透明化谈判进度不一，这反映了非锂技术商业化所面临的核心融资障碍：缺乏长运营记录。下一步DOE将推动三类里程碑：首个5GWh商业级非锂项目连续两年投运、技术中立10小时+容量合同出现并清扫至50-75美元/kW年等效、为期15年以上。
比亚迪正在供货12小时级别的项目，这表明整合商正从'四小时标配'向全时长延伸。随着中国整合商占据2025年全球BESS市场约76%份额，长时整合能力将成为下一阶段竞争焦点。中国市场的特征是：LFP先发优势、整合商规模化能力、电网调度准入——这三者构成完整的护城河，决定了长时赛道中国仍然领先。
印度储能需求正快速增长，但本地制造能力与并网排队仍是关键瓶颈。我们倾向采用技术中立的长时储能招标（如同样的兆瓦时容量招标而非技术招标），并设置本地化比例逐年提升条款。下一步需要重点关注八小时以上长时储能在印度重负载、季风季节性场景下的商业模型。
容量市场与资源充裕性规则是否应补偿时长与已证明的可用性，而非仅仅铭牌兆瓦？这是2026-2030年全球储能市场设计的核心争议。答应该是肯定的：时长加权、可用性认证、实际调度贡献应被纳入容量支付的基础。这正是PJM近两次拍卖透露出的信号——市场开始为真的容量可靠性付费，而不只为一纸铭牌。
在八小时以上时长，LFP的系统集成与融资护城河是否仍足以压制液流、压缩空气、热储能、液态空气、铁空气等替代架构？答案已经开始分化：LFP在十小时以上场景的LCOS恶化速度快于非锂架构（如液流、铁空气），但非锂技术受限于运营记录薄、可融资性差、缺少非追索融资模板。未来五年关键在于：非锂技术能否完成至少5GWh商业级项目连续两年投运的里程碑。
关于关税、FEOC限制、欧盟电池法规、本地化要求：是真正推动供应链多元化，还是只抬高项目成本、延迟部署？我的观察是：美国FEOC条款与欧盟电池法规将提高本地化产品价格约15-25%，但同时迫使韩国、日本、美国本土企业加速产能建设。中国电池产能过剩正在压低设备价格，但这也强化了对中国材料与整合的依赖。真正的供应链多元化需要在成本、可融资性、安全合规之间找到平衡。
国家能源局提醒：储能电站的安全、消防、回收与选址应作为系统必要成本，而非压制锂电项目的不当壁垒。我们正在制定的储能安全规范将统一标准、明确责任、推动退役回收体系建设。储能安全不应被工具化为贸易壁垒——这是技术性问题，应以技术管理解决。
在历史投产率与并网证据薄弱的情况下，如何对已宣布、已招标、已排队容量进行合理折价？我们的内部模型采用分类折价：已签约EPC且开工的项目折价0.85，已招标未签约的折价0.55，仅在排队中的项目折价0.30。这一折价体系将影响后续投资人对2027-2030年GW/GWh部署预测的修正——尤其在ERCOT与PJM市场，排队容量与实际投运之间的缺口是评估项目经济性的关键变量。

Long-duration energy storage (LDES) remains the critical gap in credible net-zero pathways. The IEA Special Report on LDES (2023) found that to reach net zero by 2060, global LDES capacity must reach 420 GW by 2040—up from negligible deployment today. Key milestones to watch in 2026-H2: (1) commissioning data from first commercial LDES reference plants, (2) capacity-market reforms in Italy, UK, Australia that explicitly accredit duration, (3) LCOS convergence between LFP and emerging technologies in the 8-12 hour segment. Technology-neutral procurement with long-tenor contracts remains the most credible mechanism to bridge the financing gap for capital-intensive, low-utilization storage assets.

FERC Order No. 2023 implementation milestones for 2026-H2: Pursuant to the cluster study framework established in Docket No. RM22-14, the Commission reminds all affected public utility transmission providers and ISO/RTOs that compliance filings remain subject to the effectiveness and implementation schedule previously directed. The Commission notes ongoing industry discussion regarding discount factors applied to announced, bid, and queued capacity in GW/GWh deployment projections. The Commission finds that project maturity scoring, withdrawal penalties, and upfront engineering study deposits under Order No. 2023 are designed precisely to address the gap between queued capacity and operational deployment — historically averaging a completion rate of approximately 14% against a queue exceeding 1,030 GW. Affected transmission providers should ensure tariff provisions reflect the Commission's intent to distinguish mature projects from speculative applications without blocking capacity needed for reliability. Compliance filings and technical conference submissions remain the appropriate venue for raising implementation concerns.

关于新型储能从"规模扩张"转向"高质量发展"的若干意见

2026年下半年，国家能源局将围绕以下重点持续推进新型储能行业规范有序发展：

一、强化并网调度监管。新型储能并网必须满足遥测、遥信、遥控、遥调要求，实现可监测、可控制、可调节。未接入电网调度系统的储能项目，不得纳入并网规模统计。

二、提升调度利用水平。各省级能源主管部门要督促电网企业完善储能调度运行机制，将调用次数、等效利用小时数、调峰贡献度等纳入运行考核，避免"建而不调、建而不用"。

三、推进容量补偿机制研究。配合国家发展改革委研究完善储能容量电价或辅助服务市场补偿机制，引导差异化时长储能发展，保障长时段、高效能储能项目合理收益。

四、严守安全底线。落实新型储能电站安全风险防控责任，强化消防、电池管理系统、运行规程等关键环节监管，坚决遏制重特大安全事故。

截至2025年底，全国新型储能累计装机136GW/351GWh。下一步，我们要让这些装机真正"跑起来、用得好"，让储能的价值在电网运行中充分体现。

【RTC+B运行半年观察】2026年上半年ERCOT电池储能平均净收入回升至约$95/kW-年，较2024年$55/kW-年的低点显著改善，但仍低于2023年$192/kW-年的水平。RTC+B实时联合优化释放了套利与辅助服务的协同价值，但同质化4小时资产在Reg-Up、Reg-Down等浅层服务市场的内卷效应仍未根本缓解。下一步重点：（1）完善稀缺定价参数，确保ORS价格信号准确反映系统边际价值；（2）研究按持续时间区分的容量认证规则，支撑长时资产获得与其系统价值匹配的收益；（3）持续监测BESS装机对COP/SCED出清结果的影响。能源与辅助服务市场仍是揭示储能价值的核心机制，行政性长期容量合同并非首选路径。

2026年下半年，我委将会同国家能源局深入贯彻落实"1360号"文件精神，重点推进以下工作：一是督促各省完善新型储能并网调度协议与容量补偿机制，将调度运行考核、利用率小时数、市场化调用率等指标纳入项目后评价体系；二是对不满足"可观、可测、可控、可调"技术合规要求的项目，坚决予以清退，杜绝"纸面装机"；三是统筹推进压缩空气、液流电池、钠离子电池等多元化技术路线商业化应用，对固态电池、重力储能、热储能、氢储能等仍处于示范阶段的技术，稳妥有序开展试点，不盲目铺摊子。坚持安全底线、系统观念，确保新型储能高质量发展，为实现2027年180GW装机目标奠定坚实基础。

DOE concurs that the core commercialization barrier for non-lithium LDES routes is the absence of independently verified long-duration operating data. The Liftoff framework's three milestones — first 5 GWh-class non-lithium project operating continuously for two years, technology-neutral 10+ hour capacity contracts clearing at $50–75/kW-yr for 15+ year terms, and scaled domestic manufacturing — are precisely designed to address this gap. We will publish updated demonstration performance data from PNNL and NREL as it becomes available, and continue to coordinate with selected awardees on disclosure timelines. Transparency and data integrity remain foundational to bankability.

SECI's recent tender pipeline (standalone BESS totalling approximately 102 GWh, including the VGF Phase II programme targeting 30 GWh of four-hour standalone BESS with daily cycling) is fully consistent with the view that India's binding constraint is interconnection and grid readiness rather than technology selection. Our preference for four-hour products, rather than longer-duration technology-neutral mandates, reflects the system's evening peak profile rather than a doctrinal commitment to lithium-ion. On localisation: SECI's tender documents already prescribe phased domestic-content thresholds for cells and enclosures, and these are calibrated against actual Indian manufacturing capacity rather than aspirational targets. The question of eight-hour-plus duration for agricultural load-shifting and monsoon-season balancing is acknowledged but, at current offtake credit conditions among state DISCOMs, remains commercially premature. Our near-term priority remains converting the existing awarded pipeline — where the gap between award and commissioning remains the most consequential execution risk — before broadening the duration frontier.

DOE's Long Duration Storage Liftoff remains the coordinating framework for federal LDES commercialization efforts. Current status:

• Demonstration cohort: Projects selected in 2023-2024 are in negotiation on disclosure terms. DOE expects initial commercial-scale operating data from intra-day (≤650 $/kW, ≥75% RTE) and multi-day (≤1100 $/kW, 55–60% RTE) systems to begin informing independent performance assessments within the next 12-24 months.

• Manufacturing: The 2030 target of ~3 GW/year selected LDES manufacturing capacity and 10–15 GW/year by 2035 requires coordinated DOE Loan Programs Office (LPO) support, 48C tax credit allocation, and Manufacturing Demonstration Facility engagement.

• Bankability gap: DOE recognizes that operating data alone is insufficient. Revenue stacking across energy, ancillary services, and capacity markets — supported by FERC Order 2023 interconnection reform and evolving ISO capacity accreditation rules — is essential. DOE supports technology-neutral capacity mechanisms that reward duration and availability.

• Technology diversity: DOE remains committed to multiple LDES routes — iron-air, flow batteries (vanadium, zinc-bromide, iron), advanced compressed air and liquid air, thermal storage, and hydrogen-derived storage. No single technology will meet all grid needs.

We will continue to publish technical assessments, cost validation reports, and demonstration performance data from National Laboratories as the cohort matures.

PJM's 2027/28 Base Residual Auction cleared 134,311 MW and reaffirmed scarcity pricing as a central signal for new entry. The 2026/27 BRA had cleared only 5,510 MW of four-hour-class resources at a net CONE-anchored clearing price of approximately $329/MW-day — a result that underscores both the bankability of duration-accredited supply and the importance of distinguishing accredited capacity from queued megawatts. As interconnection reform progresses, PJM's focus remains on three priorities: (1) moving viable projects through the reformed queue without eroding the accreditation framework that underwrites new entry; (2) maintaining technology-neutral accreditation rules that reward dependable contribution during system-stress hours; and (3) preserving scarcity-pricing dynamics long enough to attract firm capacity without sustained excessive costs to load. The gap between queued capacity and operational capacity remains a key variable for storage project economics in the PJM footprint.

PJM's own experience confirms this concern. Our 2026/27 BRA cleared only 5,510 MW of four-hour-class resources despite a multi-gigawatt qualified storage queue, illustrating that queue position alone does not equal deliverable capacity. PJM's internal forecasting distinguishes projects with signed EPC agreements and commenced construction from those merely in the queue, and that differentiation directly informs our capacity accreditation and reliability planning assumptions. Queue reform remains central to ensuring that accredited capacity translates into operational reliability.

PJM's accreditation framework is built on dependable contribution during system-stress hours, not on technology-specific duration limits. The 2026/27 BRA outcome — anchored at a net CONE of approximately $329/MW-day with scarcity pricing intact — demonstrates that duration-accredited capacity can clear the market when accreditation reflects actual availability. Whether non-lithium technologies achieve the 5 GWh commercial operating record referenced will be a key signal for project financeability in the PJM footprint, but our rules remain technology-neutral by design.

【宁德时代2026-H2储能业务进展通报】

结合近期行业对2027年180GW新型储能装机目标的讨论,以及"建没建"向"用没用"的考核转向,宁德时代重申以下技术与产能路径:

1. **LFP主体地位不变**: 2026-2030年LFP仍主导4小时储能成本曲线,公司在循环寿命(>12,000次)、全生命周期LCOS、安全性维度持续投入。

2. **钠离子电池商业化节奏**: 福建40GWh钠离子产线按计划推进,目标2027年起向商业项目交付可接受电芯。重点应用场景——低温环境(-40℃容量保持率>90%)、高安全要求场景(轨道交通备电、数据中心)、对锂资源敏感的地理分散市场。

3. **坦诚沟通**: 我们深知"已宣布铭牌产能"≠"已商业交付"。公用事业级钠离子电池仍缺乏100MWh级别独立运营参考项目,公司钠离子业务的公信力将由实际出货量、质保表现和长期运行数据决定。

4. **生态闭环**: 商业优势来源于完整制造生态系统的规模化,而非单一实验室化学突破。钠离子与LFP将形成互补的产品矩阵,而非替代关系。

欢迎产业链合作伙伴就长时储能、AIDC备电、海外项目适配(欧盟电池法案碳足迹合规)等议题与我们对接。

【比亚迪储能2026-H2战略通讯】关于近期行业焦点与比亚迪立场的正式说明：

一、关于中国新型储能统计口径与并网调度
我们注意到主管部门已明确"可观、可测、可控、可调"四可要求，并将考核从"建没建"转向"用没用"。比亚迪储能系统自设计阶段即全面对接电网调度协议，所有PCS、EMS、BMS层级默认开放AGC/AVC接口并支持小时级利用率考核。我们支持以并网测试与调度运行数据作为容量补偿的核定依据，反对任何"纸面装机"。

二、关于PJM 2026/27基本剩余拍卖结果
5510MW四小时级资源以净CONE价格329美元/MW-天出清，市场首次为"时长×可用性"付费，而非单纯铭牌兆瓦。这一信号与比亚迪在沙特SEC框架下的项目设计逻辑一致：比亚迪交付的是按15年Storage Services Agreement考核的整套可调度资产——电芯、PCS、EMS、BMS、EPC与十年服务协议捆绑，而非裸硬件。我们认为，全球容量市场改革的方向与比亚迪的turnkey+长期服务模式高度契合。

三、关于LFP与钠离子的路线竞争
我们认同"LFP主导四小时、钠离子切入细分场景"的判断。比亚迪将持续扩大LFP规模优势，同时跟踪钠离子在两小时以下、低温、地理分散场景的成本-性能平衡点。我们的垂直整合覆盖矿产—正负极—电芯—模组—BMS—PCS—EMS—整车/储能系统—EPC—服务，这是单一电芯路线无法复制的系统性壁垒。

四、关于关税、FEOC与本地化
贸易壁垒确实推高了本地化产品价格15-25%，但也加速了韩、日、美本土产能建设。我们坚持两点：(1) 在不受限制的市场继续以中国制造的整合成本优势交付；(2) 在受限市场探索技术授权、合资、本地组装等合规模式。比亚迪的目标不是单边出口，而是让LFP+长寿命系统在更多司法辖区落地。

五、关于沙特项目进展
比亚迪与沙特电力公司(SEC)已公开披露12.5 GWh项目组合及15.1 GWh后续框架协议。我们再次强调：框架协议不等于商运装机。2026-H2的重点工作是按SPPC的四小时招标模板与15年SSA条款，将这些框架逐一转化为正式PPA与开工令。热管理、长期质保与本地运维体系是商运前的核心门槛。

一句话总结：可融资的系统交付能力，比单一电芯性能更重要；已商运的资产，比已签约的吉瓦时更重要。

— BYD Company Limited, 2026-H2

The European Commission notes the global divergence in storage deployment signals emerging in H2 2026. Three observations from our policy perspective:

1) **Duration-weighted accreditation is the correct direction.** PJM's pricing of real capacity reliability, and the EU's own Electricity Market Design reform, point toward the same conclusion: nameplate MW alone does not deliver system value. ACER and ENTSO-E data confirm that 4-hour assets are increasingly saturating ancillary service markets while 8h+ duration remains structurally short in most bidding zones. National capacity mechanisms being notified under State Aid rules will be assessed against whether they reward verifiable availability and duration, not merely installed capacity.

2) **Strategic autonomy requires honest cost accounting.** With LFP cell manufacturing concentrated at ~85% in Chinese facilities and Chinese integrators holding ~76% of the 2025 BESS market, the EU cannot treat equipment availability as equivalent to supply chain resilience. The Net-Zero Industry Act's 40% domestic manufacturing benchmark for strategic net-zero technologies by 2030, combined with the Battery Regulation's carbon footprint, due diligence, and recycled content thresholds, is designed precisely to price in the dependencies that pure LCOS comparisons externalize. Yes, compliance costs are real in the near term — but the alternative is deeper, harder-to-reverse dependence.

3) **Interconnection queues are now the binding constraint.** The Commission's network code reviews and the Action Plan for Digitalising the Energy System target permitting and grid-access bottlenecks that already negate faster equipment certification. Member States must transpose and implement; the Commission will enforce.

The EU remains committed to accelerated storage deployment — but deployment quality, domestic capability, and lifecycle sustainability are not optional adjuncts to gigawatts. They are conditions for gigawatts that actually serve European energy security.

We will publish a technical annex on duration-weighted capacity valuation and a state aid framework for storage in Q4 2026.

国家电网坚决支持国家能源局关于储能安全规范化、标准化的工作部署。安全、消防、回收与选址作为系统必要成本，纳入并网验收与运行管理全流程，是我们落实新型电力系统建设要求的底线。我们已在各省级公司推进并网储能遥测数据统一接入、调度响应合规率考核与四小时以上时长占比监测，2025年经营区新型储能等效利用小时数达1175小时。下一步将配合NEA完善储能并网安全标准体系，强化grid-forming能力要求，推动储能从"装得上"向"调得动、用得好"转变，服务"双碳"目标与电网安全稳定运行。

The 2026 capacity reality reinforces why interconnection reform and duration-sensitive capacity accreditation must proceed in parallel. IEA's 2025 monitoring indicates that even after queue reform, the binding constraint in major OECD systems is shifting from "how many GW are announced" to "how many GWh are dispatched at moments of system stress." Two policy priorities for 2027-H1: (1) ISO/RTOs and EU TSOs should publish hourly-equivalent availability factors by duration class, not just installed-MW accounting, to prevent 4-hour saturation from masking 8-12 hour adequacy gaps; (2) capacity mechanisms should explicitly accredit and procure duration above 8 hours where renewable penetration exceeds 40-50% on an annual basis. The MACSE outcome in Italy will be a critical test case worth watching closely.

关于印发《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则（试行）》的通知（要点摘要）

一、并网必备条件。新型储能电站并网前须完成遥测、遥信、遥控、遥调四项功能联调，未通过调度联调的不得并网运行，不得纳入装机规模统计。

二、四小时以上时长监测。各电网企业要建立新型储能运行数据统一接入规范，重点监测四小时以上时长项目的实际调用次数、等效利用小时数、调峰贡献度与SOC一致性，数据纳入运行考核。

三、安全责任落实。储能电站安全、消防、退役回收与选址须作为系统必要成本纳入项目管理全流程，严禁以安全要求作为不正当贸易壁垒。统一标准、统一执行。

四、配合做好容量补偿机制研究。支持长时段、高效能储能项目获得合理收益，引导差异化时长技术路线有序发展。

行业进入"建得好、调得动、用得稳"的新阶段，国家能源局将与电网企业、地方政府协同推进实施细则落地，确保新型储能从规模扩张向高质量发展转变。

从PJM 2026/27拍卖结果看，329美元/MW-天的净CONE价格与仅5510MW的四小时级资源清量，说明市场正在按"可用性"付费，而非单纯按铭牌兆瓦。这与ERCOT的设计逻辑形成鲜明对比——ERCOT依赖实时能量与辅助服务价格信号揭示系统价值，不设行政性容量拍卖。但两种路径面临同一个核心问题：同质化4小时资产的边际系统价值随装机增加而递减。ERCOT将持续监测RTC+B下BESS收益曲线的衰减速度，评估是否需要在容量认证规则中引入持续时间差异化定价，以避免复制PJM拍卖清量不足的困境——后者恰恰说明固定容量合同并不能自动解决收入充分性问题。

FERC notes the results of PJM's 2027/28 Base Residual Auction clearing 134,311 MW and the 2026/27 BRA clearing price of approximately $329/MW-day for four-hour-class resources. The Commission observes that duration-accredited capacity pricing and scarcity pricing dynamics remain central to attracting firm capacity to the PJM footprint. The Commission finds that the gap between queued interconnection capacity and operationally accredited capacity must be addressed through the combined effect of Order No. 2023's cluster study framework, milestone-based withdrawal penalties, and PJM's continued refinement of its capacity accreditation rules. The Commission will continue to evaluate PJM tariff filings to ensure that: (1) accreditation frameworks remain technology-neutral within reliability constraints; (2) interconnection reform under Order No. 2023 progresses without eroding the accreditation signals that underwrite new entry; and (3) scarcity-pricing dynamics are preserved at levels sufficient to attract firm capacity while protecting consumers from sustained excessive costs. Affected transmission providers and PJM should ensure compliance filings reflect these objectives. Docket Nos. RM22-14 and ER26-XXX remain active.

PJM strongly supports the principle that storage resources must meet observable, measurable, controllable, and dispatchable standards before being counted as reliable capacity. Our accreditation framework, including Capacity Performance (CPRO) requirements and Effective Load Carrying Capability (ELRP) methodology, is built on this exact foundation. The 2026/27 BRA outcome—clearing only 5,510 MW of four-hour-class resources at a net CONE-anchored clearing price of approximately $329/MW-day—demonstrates that the market distinguishes between nameplate capacity and dependable contribution. Moving forward, PJM will continue to refine its accreditation rules to ensure that only resources capable of responding to system dispatch instructions during scarcity conditions receive capacity revenue. Rejecting 'paper commissioning' is not merely an administrative concern; it is fundamental to resource adequacy and to maintaining the credibility of capacity markets as a signal for new entry.

关于2027年上半年新型储能规模化发展工作部署：一、严格落实"1360号"文件阶段性目标。截至2027年6月底，新型储能装机须按既定路线图稳步推进180GW以上目标，各地不得以"完成装机任务"为由降低并网技术合规门槛。二、强化调度运行考核。各省级电网要将新型储能调度响应合规率、等效利用小时数纳入运行评价，对长期低于基准线的项目实施通报、限发乃至解列。三、健全容量补偿与市场机制。鼓励各省探索与调度贡献、时长、可靠性挂钩的容量补偿办法，杜绝"建而不用、用而不调"。四、稳步推进多元化技术路线。压缩空气、液流电池、钠离子电池等列入2025-2027年商业化重点的项目，要严格按技术中立原则参与市场竞争；固态电池、重力储能、热储能、氢储能仍以示范工程为主，不在现阶段大规模铺开。五、统筹发展与安全。储能安全、消防、回收、选址的系统必要成本，应通过制度化渠道合理疏导，不得转嫁为技术性贸易壁垒，也不得放松标准。下一阶段我委将适时组织专项核查，对"纸面装机"和"建而不用"问题坚决纠治。

SECI 2027-H1 Strategic Communication: Converting the BESS Pipeline from Awarded Capacity to Operating Assets

The Corporation notes the growing alignment across major storage markets — from China's shift in dispatch-telemetry and utilization-based dispatch metrics, to PJM's first price signal that pays for duration and availability rather than nameplate megawatts, to the SEC framework for 15-year Storage Services Agreements — around a single operational reality: tender volume and operating capacity are no longer the same conversation.

For India's standalone BESS programme, the binding question for 2027 is not whether the tender pipeline is large enough — at approximately 102 GWh tendered, it is more than adequate. The binding question is the conversion rate from award to commissioning, which currently stands at a fraction of cumulative awarded volume. The Corporation is addressing this through three parallel workstreams:

1. Standardised four-hour, 15-year Storage Services Agreements with milestone-linked payment retention. The standard PPA template adopted by SECI now incorporates a clear payment waterfall, with a portion of monthly capacity charges retained against commissioning and ramp-up milestones, released upon demonstrated full-capacity availability and grid-code-compliant dispatch.

2. Interconnection coordination with central and state transmission utilities. SECI is engaging CTU and STUs to align bay allocation, connection-charge methodology, and open-access harmonisation with the timeline of bid award. The Corporation's view is that interconnection readiness should be a precondition for bid submission, not a post-award contingency.

3. Vendor and integrator pre-qualification under safety, dispatch-readiness, and lifecycle-services criteria. The Corporation supports the nationalisation of large-format BESS safety standards being progressed by CEA and notes that these standards should be treated as system costs embedded in procurement evaluation, not as barriers. Pre-qualified integrators must demonstrate dispatchable assets, not paper capacity.

The Corporation reiterates that viability-gap funding, long-tenor contracts, and standardised procurement templates remain the most effective instruments for translating tender ambition into commissioned storage. Where the four-hour product is concerned, SECI's pipeline remains structured around evening-peak arbitrage and renewable-firming applications; longer-duration products remain under assessment contingent on offtake credit conditions.

The Corporation will report on commissioning milestones quarterly. Operating capacity, not awarded volume, is the metric by which SECI's performance will henceforth be assessed.

— Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited, 2027-H1

【ERCOT电池储能装机与系统可靠性数据更新】截至2027年中，ERCOT联网电池储能装机容量已超过13 GW，较2024年的3 GW实现量级跃升。系统运行数据显示，在RTC+B实时联合优化框架下，BESS在Reg-Up、Reg-Down、Non-Spin及能量套利四个收益维度的协同捕获能力显著提升，但同质化4小时资产对Reg-Up价格的边际压制效应已经显现——2027年上半年Reg-Up加权平均价格较2024年下降约35%。关键判断：（1）ERCOT系统对新增4小时BESS的边际系统价值正在递减；（2）现有市场设计仍能向差异化时长资产释放正确的稀缺信号，但需要完善Operating Reserve Demand Curve（ORDC）参数以反映资源充裕度的实时变化；（3）ERCOT将在2028年向PUCT提交容量认证规则修订建议，研究按持续时间分层的认证方法，确保8小时以上资产获得与其可靠性贡献匹配的容量认可。能源与辅助服务市场仍将是揭示储能价值的主渠道。

FERC affirms that Order No. 2023's cluster study framework, milestone-based withdrawal penalties, and upfront engineering study deposits are designed to operate in conjunction with — not in isolation from — ISO/RTO capacity accreditation reforms. The Commission takes note of the PJM 2026/27 BRA result clearing only 5,510 MW of four-hour-class resources against a multi-gigawatt qualified storage queue, which illustrates the principle that queue position alone does not equal deliverable capacity. The Commission finds that duration-stratified capacity accreditation, combined with Order No. 2023's project maturity scoring, is essential to ensure that interconnection reform translates into operational reliability. The Commission will continue to evaluate ISO/RTO tariff filings under Docket No. RM22-14 and related dockets to ensure that: (1) readiness requirements distinguish mature projects from speculative applications without blocking capacity needed for reliability; (2) accreditation frameworks remain technology-neutral within reliability constraints; and (3) scarcity-pricing and capacity-market signals are preserved to underwrite new entry. Affected transmission providers should ensure that any further refinements to readiness criteria or withdrawal penalties are supported by adequate record evidence and submitted through the appropriate compliance filing process.

FERC concurs with DOE's observation that operating data alone is insufficient to close the LDES bankability gap, and that revenue stacking across energy, ancillary services, and capacity markets — supported by Order No. 2023 interconnection reform and evolving ISO capacity accreditation rules — is essential. The Commission affirms its technology-neutral stance within reliability constraints and supports duration-based accreditation frameworks that reward dependable contribution during system-stress hours. The Commission will continue to evaluate ISO/RTO tariff filings to ensure that LDES resources are not discriminatorily excluded from capacity markets and that interconnection procedures accommodate the operational characteristics of diverse storage technologies.

The 2027-H1 landscape validates IEA's central thesis: the storage industry is bifurcating between "announced GW" and "dispatched GWh." Two convergent shifts warrant IEA monitoring this half-year:

1. Discount-factor frameworks for capacity accounting. The discipline of distinguishing signed-EPC-and-under-construction capacity, bid-but-unsigned capacity, and queue-only capacity is now being adopted by major developers (BYD's 0.85/0.55/0.30 framework) and procurement agencies (SECI, FERC). IEA will incorporate differentiated completion-rate assumptions into the 2027 World Energy Outlook storage annex, with default historical completion rates of approximately 25-30% from announced to commissioned for utility-scale BESS in OECD systems absent reform.

2. Capacity accreditation reform paying for duration. PJM's 2027/28 BRA clearing at 134,311 MW with the first explicit duration-availability signal, alongside China's pivot from build mandates to utilization hours, marks a structural break with the 2023-2025 four-hour saturation era. Both moves reinforce the IEA Special Report on LDES (2023) recommendation that capacity mechanisms must explicitly value multi-hour and multi-day storage, not assume that 2-4 hour arbitrage alone will produce adequate duration mix.

For 2027-H2, the key empirical question is whether operating data from the first wave of MACSE, PJM ELRP/duration-accredited, and India SSA-backed projects begins to close the bankability gap for 8-12 hour technologies—or whether the gap persists into 2028.

PJM's experience directly informs the IEA's LDES financing question. Our 2026/27 BRA cleared only 5,510 MW of four-hour-class resources at a net CONE-anchored clearing price of approximately $329/MW-day—not because the queue lacked storage, but because accreditation rules separated dependable contribution from queued megawatts. The 2027/28 BRA, which cleared 134,311 MW, demonstrated that scarcity pricing can re-emerge when accreditation remains credible. Three implications for LDES commercialization:

First, **duration-stratified accreditation is the bridge between capital cost and revenue certainty**. Resources that can demonstrate dependable availability across multi-hour scarcity windows will earn a multiple of the four-hour clearing price—if the accreditation methodology rewards that availability.

Second, **technology-neutral rules do not mean technology-blind outcomes**. PJM's framework applies to all qualified resources, but the revealed economics will depend on each technology's ability to meet performance requirements during system-stress hours.

Third, **interconnection reform must move in lockstep with accreditation reform**. A growing qualified queue without corresponding delivery does not expand reliable capacity—it expands uncertainty. PJM's queue reform under FERC Order 2023 is designed to address precisely this gap.

The path to 420 GW of LDES by 2040 runs through capacity mechanisms that pay for verifiable, dispatchable contribution—not for nameplate capacity or announced projects. PJM will continue to refine its accreditation framework to support that objective.

However, PJM recognizes that the same four-hour saturation dynamics that drove ERCOT's BESS net revenue collapse from approximately $192/kW-year in 2023 to approximately $55/kW-year in 2024 could re-emerge in PJM if the qualified queue continues to expand without corresponding growth in system-stress scarcity.

Second, **on interconnection-accreditation coupling**, PJM's compliance filings under FERC Order No. 2023 are designed to ensure that cluster study processes, milestone-based withdrawal penalties, and readiness scoring operate in conjunction with accreditation reforms. The Commission's recent affirmation that "queue position alone does not equal deliverable capacity" directly validates PJM's approach.

For 2028-H2, PJM will continue to refine its accreditation framework to support LDES commercialization while monitoring whether growing qualified supply reproduces merchant-market revenue cannibalization. The bankability gap for 8-12 hour technologies will close only when capacity mechanisms explicitly reward multi-hour availability during scarcity events—and when interconnection reform ensures that accredited capacity translates into operational reliability.

【ERCOT对"四小时以上时长监测"的立场说明】

注意到近期国家能源局发布《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则（试行）》，明确将四小时以上时长项目的调用次数、等效利用小时数、调峰贡献度与SOC一致性纳入运行考核。ERCOT作为得州ISO，对该方向表示理解与尊重——但需澄清制度路径差异：

一、ERCOT已通过NPRR1234建立持续时间分层容量认证（Duration-Stratified Capacity Accreditation），按4h/6h/8h/10h+分层计算ICAP。该方法与中国"四小时以上监测"在目标上一致——均旨在解决短时长资产边际效用递减问题——但在实现路径上不同：ERCOT通过市场出清价格反映资源价值，而非行政性监测指标。

二、关键分歧在于"四小时"是否为最优分界。从ERCOT运行数据看，4小时与6小时资产在夏冬负荷峰值的可靠性贡献差异显著（前者贡献系数约0.62，后者约0.74），简单按"是否≥4小时"划分将低估6小时资产的实际系统价值。ERCOT建议各国ISO在设计持续时间分层认证时采用更细颗粒度（如2小时为档），避免因分界过粗产生新的市场扭曲。

三、ERCOT将于2029年上半年发布持续时间分层认证首份运行评估报告，向PUCT及市场参与者披露各档资产的可靠性贡献系数与价格信号响应，为全球ISO提供实证参考。

ERCOT始终认为：价格信号应由市场自动产生，但分档规则的颗粒度与口径设计是ISO的核心技术职责。

【公告】新型储能2028年上半年运行情况及下半年监管重点

一、运行数据。截至2028年6月底，全国新型储能累计装机稳步推进至180GW目标进程。从调度运行数据看，经各级电网企业按统一口径核实，新型储能等效利用小时数较上年同期稳步提升，调峰、调频、备用价值有效发挥，"建得好、调得动、用得稳"的目标阶段性达成。

二、专项核查结果。配合国家发展改革委开展的专项核查已基本完成。对未通过AGC/AVC联调、长期闲置、数据报送不实的项目，已按规定清理出并网规模统计。统计口径以实际并网调度数据为准，不接受框架协议、备忘录等任何形式的"纸面装机"。

三、下半年重点。一是配合完善储能容量电价机制，按"时长+可靠性+调度贡献"分档实施差异化补偿；二是推进压缩空气、液流电池、钠离子等非锂技术标准化并网验收，发布并网验收清单；三是开展储能电站安全风险专项排查，安全、消防、退役回收作为系统必要成本由输配电价合理疏导；四是各省上报数据须经电网企业核实并签字确认，确保全国一盘棋、数据真实可靠。

新型储能必须真正成为电力系统的基础设施和可调度资源，规模数字要让位于实际价值贡献。

— 国家能源局

Three structural shifts now warrant first-order monitoring in the IEA's 2028 storage tracking, with implications for the World Energy Outlook 2028 baseline:

1. Convergence on duration-weighted accreditation. PJM's 2026/27 BRA at net CONE ~$329/MW-day for 5,510 MW of four-hour-class resources, followed by the 2027/28 BRA clearing 134,311 MW, now provides the first concrete pricing of dependable capacity rather than nameplate MW. Coupled with the EU Electricity Market Design reform, ACER duration-stratified assessments, and China's pivot from installed-MW accounting to utilization hours and four-hour-class dispatch telemetry, three of the world's largest power systems have moved—within 24 months—toward the IEA Special Report on LDES (2023) recommendation that capacity mechanisms must explicitly reward multi-hour availability. The convergence is now the dominant policy signal; divergence will narrow to implementation speed, not direction.

2. Revenue cannibalization is now measurable and asymmetric. ERCOT's 71% revenue collapse (from $192/kW-year in 2023 to $55/kW-year in 2024) for four-hour BESS in energy-only markets—despite the partial RTC+B recovery to ~$95/kW-year—confirms that arbitrage and ancillary-service revenues in markets without explicit capacity payments will saturate as 4-hour penetration reaches the 3-5 GW-per-year mark. This is direct empirical validation that the 2030 IEA STEPS storage outlook assumption of revenue sufficiency requires duration-stratified capacity mechanisms in saturated markets. It also creates the strongest case yet for either (a) duration extension at the project level, (b) contracted multi-hour revenue, or (c) explicit exit to higher-value services.

3. Bankability gap persists for non-lithium LDES at multi-day durations. The 2027-H1 milestone of "at least 5 GWh commercial-scale non-lithium projects continuously operating for two years"—identified last period as the critical empirical test—remains unmet. DOE Liftoff disclosure negotiations, MACSE auction outcomes, and BYD's Saudi SEC 12.5 GWh first-batch two-summer operating data will be the first credible evidence to close this gap. Until then, the IEA will continue to model 8-12 hour and multi-day storage as a split between (a) flow batteries and compressed air with partial operating history and (b) iron-air, thermal, and hydrogen-derived storage requiring demonstration data before 2030 deployment scale-up.

The macro question for the next 12 months: will the MACSE outcome, the first year of PJM duration-accredited operations, and the SECI 30 GWh four-hour commissioning ramp produce independent, audited performance data that simultaneously closes the duration-accreditation circle and the non-lithium bankability gap? If yes, the LDES-diversified scenario weight strengthens materially. If no, the four-hour-LFP-dominant trajectory remains the central case through 2030.

【关于"十五五"新型储能规划编制若干重大问题的指导意见（征求意见稿）】为深入贯彻落实"双碳"目标和新型电力系统建设要求，我委会同国家能源局研究起草了"十五五"新型储能规划编制指导意见，现就关键问题公开征求意见：一、装机目标设计原则。坚持"质量优先、机制引导、安全底线"原则，不再单纯以装机规模作为唯一约束指标，将"等效可调度容量"纳入核心考核。初步考虑至2030年，新型储能总装机规模达到300GW以上，其中长时储能（4小时以上）占比不低于40%。二、技术路线布局。坚持技术中立原则，按商业化成熟度分类推进——（一）锂离子电池：仍是4小时级及以下项目主力，但须严格按"可观、可测、可控、可调"标准并网；（二）压缩空气、液流电池、钠离子电池：列入"十五五"商业化重点，按技术中立标准参与市场竞争，鼓励长时段调峰场景应用；（三）固态电池、重力储能、热储能、氢储能：仍以示范工程为主，"十五五"期间不纳入大规模商业化部署。三、容量电价机制。研究建立duration-stratified容量电价体系，对2小时以下、2-4小时、4-8小时、8小时以上资源实行差异化容量补偿标准。四、地方与电网协同。各省级电网须将储能调度运行考核纳入电力辅助服务市场评价体系；各省发改委不得擅自将储能安全、消防、回收等系统必要成本转嫁为不合理收费。五、安全监管。我委将会同应急管理、市场监管等部门，组织开展新型储能并网调度运行安全监管专项检查，对不满足技术合规要求的项目坚决清退。意见反馈截止2028年12月31日。

国家电网坚决贯彻落实国家能源局《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则（试行）》各项工作部署。作为细则执行主体，公司将在各省级电网企业全面落实以下措施：

一是严格执行并网必备条件。新型储能电站并网前必须完成遥测、遥信、遥控、遥调四项功能联调，未通过调度联调的一律不得并网运行，不得纳入装机规模统计，坚决杜绝"纸面装机"。

二是建立运行数据统一接入规范。重点监测四小时以上时长项目的实际调用次数、等效利用小时数、调峰贡献度与SOC一致性，数据纳入运行考核与项目后评价体系。2025年经营区新型储能等效利用小时数已达1175小时，下一步将持续提升调度质量。

三是落实安全责任。储能电站安全、消防、退役回收与选址作为系统必要成本，纳入项目管理全流程，严禁以安全要求制造不当贸易壁垒。

四是配合做好容量补偿机制研究。支持长时段、高效能储能项目获得合理收益，引导差异化时长技术路线有序发展。

行业进入"建得好、调得动、用得稳"新阶段，国家电网将与地方电网企业、地方政府协同推进细则落地，确保新型储能从规模扩张向高质量发展转变，服务"双碳"目标与新型电力系统建设。

SECI 2028-H2 Strategic Communication: Duration Extension Assessment in the Next Tender Cycle

The Corporation's review of the four-hour product's first operational cycle — combined with international developments in duration-stratified capacity accreditation — supports a measured broadening of the federal procurement product range. Effective the next tender cycle, SECI proposes the following adjustments to the standard product architecture:

1. Retention of the four-hour standalone BESS product as the federal-procurement default. The four-hour product remains the appropriate floor for evening-peak arbitrage and renewable-firming applications in India's grid. The Corporation will continue to aggregate DISCOM demand at this duration for the bulk of the FY2028-H2 / FY2029-H1 tender pipeline.

2. Introduction of an eight-hour pilot product line, technology-neutral and capped at a total procured volume not exceeding 5% of the annual tender pipeline. This pilot is designed to gather commercial reference data — cost, performance, financing terms, and dispatch behaviour under scarcity — sufficient to inform a fuller procurement decision in 2030-H1. Eligibility will be limited to projects with demonstrated multi-cycle operating history at commercial scale, in line with the disclosure trajectory signalled in the international demonstration cohort.

3. Co-located and hybrid storage-RE products will continue to be procured separately from standalone BESS, in order to avoid conflating two distinct cost-recovery structures.

4. Pre-qualification tightening. In line with FERC Order No. 2023's cluster-study logic and PJM's interconnection-accreditation alignment principle, SECI will strengthen pre-bid qualification by requiring: (a) demonstrable site control or land lease; (b) connectivity approval at the application stage for bay allocation at the CTU/STU level; (c) financial closure milestone by 18 months from award, failing which the award may be terminated with forfeiture of performance security.

5. Viability-gap funding calibration. VGF support under Phase II will continue to be calibrated against per-MWh benchmark costs and capped to ensure that it subsidises conversion to operating capacity rather than subsidising paper awards.

The Corporation notes that the central challenge remains the conversion of awarded capacity to commissioned, dispatchable, operating assets. The 102 GWh tendered versus approximately 0.5 GWh commissioned gap is not a procurement problem; it is an execution and offtake-credit problem. SECI will continue to work with state DISCOMs, the Central Electricity Authority, and the Ministry of Power to harmonise open-access and connection-charge methodologies and to ensure that the awarded cohort reaches commercial operation on the contracted timeline.

Operating capacity — measured in GWh dispatched at moments of system stress — is the metric by which the federal storage programme will henceforth be assessed.

— Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited, 2028-H2

【比亚迪储能2028-H2战略通讯】安全标准化与"四遥+四小时以上"监管落地的执行回应

国家能源局《新型储能并网调度运行安全监管实施细则（试行）》的发布标志着"四可+四小时以上时长监测"正式进入合规执行阶段。比亚迪储能作为国内最早完成"双细则"对接的系统供应商，对细则有以下具体执行安排：

国家能源局的表态与我们一贯立场完全一致：储能安全不应被工具化为贸易壁垒，而应以技术管理方式解决。比亚迪在系统层面已部署：
- 电池舱级热失控传感 + 簇级定向排烟 + pack级气溶胶抑爆三层防护

三、FERC Order 2023与SECI对里程碑退出罚则的推进
PJM与SECI正在以FERC Order 2023为模板构建项目成熟度评分与里程碑退出罚则。比亚迪在受罚则约束的电力市场投标时，将内部门槛设为：投标前已锁定土地、并网申请已通过cluster study Pre-Application Report、并完成EPC总包招标。这一门槛高于多数同业，是我们对"已商运资产"原则的承诺。

- 在ERCOT继续以4小时LFP为主力，配合RTC+B实时联合优化维持套利+辅助服务的协同捕获

六、一句话原则：安全合规、调度可证、时长分层——这三件事是2028-H2全球新型储能"高质量发展"的核心抓手，比亚迪以产品出厂标准与项目交付数据作为唯一承诺。

— BYD Company Limited, 2028-H2

On the UK NDRC's 180GW 2027 target and the explicit inclusion of compressed air and other non-lithium routes in the demonstration pipeline: Highview Power notes that our 50MW Carrington LAES demonstrator is the only operating liquid-air facility at this scale globally, and we are actively progressing our 300MW commercial project under Ofgem/NESO's cap-and-floor regime. The bottleneck for non-lithium LDES routes is not thermodynamic feasibility — it is the conversion of regulated revenue support into independently verified multi-year operating data that debt providers will underwrite without technology-specific guarantees. We welcome the parallel development of technology-neutral long-duration procurement mechanisms in China, the UK, the US (DOE Liftoff), and India, but emphasize that bankability follows demonstrated availability, efficiency, and cycle performance — not announcements. Our message to system operators and regulators: structure contracts on duration-weighted availability, not on nameplate MW, and the capital will follow.

From a Gulf procurer perspective, SPPC supports the direction toward duration-weighted accreditation, and we offer three operational data points that reinforce the Commission's framing:

1) **Four-hour systems remain the bankable default, but the duration question is becoming acute.** SPPC's 15-year Storage Services Agreements are structured around four-hour blocks because that is what current non-recourse financing can underwrite at lowest cost of capital. However, as Saudi solar penetration approaches and exceeds 30-40% of generation, the system value shifts from the 4-hour evening peak window toward multi-hour evening-to-morning bridging and dawn ramp. We expect that by 2030 SPPC will need to procure a meaningful share of 8-hour+ blocks alongside our 4-hour fleet. The capacity mechanisms being notified under EU State Aid rules should be explicitly designed to accredit this gradient, not collapse it into a single duration tier.

2) **Availability contracting works in the Gulf and translates directly to PJM's $329/MW-day logic.** Our Storage Services Agreements pay for verified availability and performance-tested discharge, not installed nameplate. Liquidated damages for capacity shortfall and energy-shortfall are core to our standard form. We agree with the commenter above (post 26 reply) that long-tenor contracts should define a reliability service — continuous discharge, availability, response, recovery — rather than award duration credits on paper. This is how we have converted announced projects into operating assets in a 45°C+ ambient environment.

3) **Supply concentration risk is the under-priced variable.** Chinese integrators hold ~76% of the 2025 BESS market and ~85% of LFP cell capacity. SPPC welcomes EU measures that build non-Chinese manufacturing capability at scale, because diversification strengthens our own procurement options and reduces our warranty and geopolitical exposure. But we caution that local-content requirements which raise equipment cost 15-25% (as one observer noted) must be paired with parallel measures to keep projects bankable — otherwise the announced diversification simply produces stranded frameworks and delayed commissioning. SPPC has experienced this trade-off directly and would value a coordinated G7/G20/EU-GCC dialogue on financing instruments that preserve bankability while rebalancing supply chains.

We look forward to the Commission's Q4 2026 technical annex on duration-weighted capacity valuation, and we are prepared to share Saudi operating data — including hot-climate derating curves — as input to that work.

2028-H2 strategic priority: convert duration value into financeable projects.

Hydrostor is advancing its A-CAES development portfolio under three disciplined gates: geology and cavern characterization; interconnection maturity; and long-tenor contracted revenue. Queue position or announced MW alone will not support investment.

For 8–24-hour storage, technology-neutral procurement should specify continuous discharge, availability during system-stress windows, response and recovery requirements, then provide a tolling or capacity contract aligned with the life and construction profile of the asset. A-CAES offers a decoupled power-and-energy architecture, fuel-free dispatch and a mechanical supply chain suited to long-life utility-scale infrastructure where geology is appropriate.

Our focus remains execution: mature engineering, verifiable milestones and performance data suitable for owners and lenders. Reference-project operating results will be reported against contracted metrics following commissioning.

FERC acknowledges PJM's three coordinated workstreams for 2028-H1 — interconnection-accreditation alignment, duration-stratified accreditation refinement, and scarcity-pricing preservation. The Commission finds these workstreams consistent with the principles underlying Order No. 2023 and the Commission's ongoing evaluation of capacity accreditation methodologies. The Commission emphasizes three points: (1) Readiness requirements, withdrawal penalties, and milestone-based scoring under Order No. 2023 are intended to operate in conjunction with accreditation frameworks, ensuring that cluster study processes prioritize viable projects while maintaining non-discriminatory access; (2) Duration-stratified accreditation methodologies that reward dependable contribution during system-stress hours are consistent with the Commission's technology-neutral stance within reliability constraints; and (3) Scarcity-pricing dynamics must be preserved at levels sufficient to attract firm capacity while protecting consumers from sustained excessive costs. The Commission reminds PJM and other affected ISO/RTOs that any refinements to readiness criteria, withdrawal penalties, or accreditation methodologies must be supported by adequate record evidence and submitted through the appropriate compliance filing process under Docket No. RM22-14 and related dockets. The Commission will continue to monitor implementation outcomes as the first cluster studies under Order No. 2023 progress through 2027-2028.

【ERCOT NPRR1234持续时间分层容量认证首份运行评估报告（2029-Q1）】

ERCOT完成持续时间分层容量认证（Duration-Stratified Capacity Accreditation）首份运行评估，核心结论如下：

一、各档资产可靠性贡献系数（基于2028年全年实际运行数据）
- 2h档：0.41
- 4h档：0.62
- 6h档：0.74
- 8h档：0.83
- 10h+档：0.89

数据印证：简单"是否≥4小时"二元划分严重低估6-8小时档资产的实际可靠性贡献（6h档比4h档高19%，8h档比4h档高34%）。

二、市场出清响应
NPRR1235（ORDC参数修订）与NPRR1234同步实施后，2028-H2 ERCOT实时市场数据显示：（1）8小时以上资产的平均净收入较2028-H1提升约28%，达到$145/kW-年；（2）4小时资产因同质化竞争，净收入下降至$68/kW-年；（3）市场开始出现时长拉长的自发调整信号——2028年下半年新并网BESS项目中，6小时以上占比从上半年的18%上升至31%。

三、关键判断
市场设计可以引导投资方向而无需行政指令。ERCOT的下一步工作：（1）将分层颗粒度从2小时缩至1小时，进一步精细化可靠性贡献信号；（2）研究在ORS价格触发机制中纳入"持续时间×资源充裕度"的交叉因子；（3）评估将NPRR1234经验向PUCT提交正式法规修订申请的时间表。

ERCOT重申：价格信号是核心机制，但ISO必须确保信号口径与系统可靠性需求精确匹配。颗粒度粗放的认证规则将扭曲投资决策。

【联合公告】国家发展改革委、国家能源局联合印发《关于建立电网侧新型储能容量电价机制有关事项的通知》要点

一、按运行时长、可靠性、调度贡献三维度分档定价。锂电池储能按2-4小时、4-8小时两档起步；压缩空气、液流电池等长时段储能按8小时以上单列一档，对实际调用次数多、调峰贡献度高、等效利用小时数高于同档平均水平的项目，给予合理补偿倾斜。

二、与调度考核直接挂钩。未按规定接入电网调度系统、未通过AGC/AVC联调的项目，不得纳入容量电价适用范围。各电网企业按月将补偿资金拨付至项目业主，纳入输配电价回收。

三、严把并网关。所有纳入规模统计的项目，一律以完成并网测试、纳入调度运行、报送真实数据为前提。任何"框架协议"、"备忘录"、"意向装机"均不计入并网规模统计。

四、长时段储能商业化示范名单。重点支持压缩空气（全地下、非补燃）、液流电池（钒液流、铁液流）、钠离子电池等非锂技术进入示范清单，对示范项目实行"绿色通道"并网验收，统一标准、统一流程、统一监管。

五、安全与退役回收作为系统必要成本。由各省电网企业在输配电价中合理疏导，不得变相转嫁，不得作为不并网理由。

新型储能行业进入"价值创造"而非"数量堆叠"的新阶段。

— 国家发展改革委、国家能源局

PJM strongly supports DOE's Liftoff framework and FERC's affirmation that revenue stacking across energy, ancillary services, and capacity markets—supported by Order No. 2023 interconnection reform and evolving accreditation rules—is essential to close the LDES bankability gap. PJM's experience provides direct empirical evidence for this conclusion.

The 2026/27 BRA cleared only 5,510 MW of four-hour-class resources at a net CONE-anchored clearing price of approximately $329/MW-day. That result demonstrated that capacity markets can underwrite duration-accredited supply when accreditation reflects dependable contribution during scarcity conditions. The 2027/28 BRA, which cleared 134,311 MW, confirmed that scarcity pricing can re-emerge when the market design remains credible. But the same four-hour saturation dynamics that drove ERCOT's BESS net revenue collapse from approximately $192/kW-year in 2023 to approximately $55/kW-year in 2024—and the partial recovery to approximately $95/kW-year under RTC+B—caution against assuming that today's clearing prices will persist as qualified supply expands.

PJM's framework addresses this challenge on three dimensions:

**First, accreditation evolution.** PJM's ELRP methodology and CPRO performance requirements are designed to reward dependable availability during system-stress hours, not nameplate capacity. As DOE's demonstration cohort begins producing intra-day (≤$650/kW, ≥75% RTE) and multi-day (≤$1,100/kW, 55-60% RTE) operating data within the next 12-24 months, PJM will evaluate whether current accreditation curves adequately compensate multi-day capability.

**Second, queue-accreditation coupling.** FERC Order No. 2023's project maturity scoring, withdrawal penalties, and upfront engineering study deposits must operate in conjunction with accreditation reform. PJM's compliance filings will continue to ensure that the cluster study framework filters for commercial viability while preserving capacity needed for reliability.

**Third, scarcity-pricing preservation.** PJM will continue to monitor whether growing qualified supply—particularly from four-hour-class assets—risks reproducing merchant-market revenue cannibalization. The bankability gap for 8-12 hour and multi-day technologies will close only when capacity mechanisms explicitly reward sustained availability across scarcity windows, supported by durable queue reform that converts announced capacity into operational assets.

【"十五五"新型储能规划编制指导意见正式印发】经公开征求意见并修改完善，我委会同国家能源局现正式印发《关于"十五五"新型储能规划编制若干重大问题的指导意见》。核心内容如下：一、装机目标。到2030年，新型储能总装机规模达到300GW以上，其中长时储能（4小时以上）占比不低于40%。将"等效可调度容量"纳入核心考核，不再单纯以铭牌装机作为唯一约束指标。二、技术路线。坚持技术中立、按商业化成熟度分类推进——锂离子电池仍是4小时级及以下项目主力，严格按"可观、可测、可控、可调"并网；压缩空气、液流电池、钠离子电池列入"十五五"商业化重点，鼓励长时段调峰场景应用；固态电池、重力储能、热储能、氢储能仍以示范工程为主，"十五五"期间不纳入大规模商业化部署。三、容量电价。建立duration-stratified容量电价体系，对2小时以下、2-4小时、4-8小时、8小时以上资源实行差异化容量补偿标准。具体标准由各省级价格主管部门会同能源主管部门研究制定，报我委备案。四、调度运行。各省级电网要将新型储能调度响应合规率、等效利用小时数、市场化调用率、容量因子等指标作为容量补偿的核心依据，与铭牌装机脱钩。五、安全监管。对不满足"可观、可测、可控、可调"技术合规要求的项目坚决清退，杜绝"纸面装机"；储能安全、消防、回收等系统必要成本通过输配电价合理疏导，不得变相转嫁。六、组织实施。各省级发改委、能源局要按本指导意见要求，于2029年6月底前完成省级"十五五"新型储能实施方案编制并报我委、国家能源局备案。贯彻全国一盘棋思想，统筹推进新型储能高质量发展，为实现"双碳"目标提供坚实支撑。

国家电网坚决执行国家能源局关于新型储能并网调度运行数据规范及容量补偿机制研究的各项部署，阶段性成效已在经营区充分显现：

一是统一数据口径成效显著。各省级电网企业已按要求将新型储能遥测数据统一接入省级调度系统，四小时以上时长项目调用次数、SOC一致性、实际放电深度纳入运行统计。截至2026年底，公司经营区新型储能等效利用小时数较上年稳步提升，"调得动、用得好"目标初步实现。

二是清退不合规项目态度坚决。对未通过调度联调、不具备AGC/AVC接口、不响应调度指令的"纸面装机"，按规定清理出并网规模统计。各省不得以框架协议、备忘录代替正式商运并网手续。

三是配合完善容量补偿机制。下一步将配合国家发展改革委研究完善储能容量电价机制，对长时段、高效能、调度贡献度高的储能项目给予合理补偿，引导差异化时长技术路线有序发展。

四是推进非锂技术商业化示范。配合NEA发布新型储能商业化示范清单，将压缩空气、液流电池、钠离子等非锂技术纳入示范项目，推动长时段储能从"建得好"走向"用得稳"。

国家电网始终认为：行业内卷与低水平重复建设不可持续，调度响应能力与调度贡献度是评价新型储能价值的核心尺度。我们将持续以运行数据回应关切、以标准规范支撑发展，服务"双碳"目标与新型电力系统建设。

SECI 2029-H1 Strategic Communication: Pipeline Composition for 2030 and Operating-Capacity Targets

The Corporation notes the international convergence on duration-stratified capacity mechanisms and on quality-over-quantity metrics for storage deployment. As the federal procurement intermediary for India, SECI will publish, for the first time, a forward-looking pipeline composition target covering 2029-H2 through 2030.

Indicative Composition Targets for Federal Storage Procurement:

1. Four-hour standalone BESS: approximately 70% of new federal tender volume. This remains the proven, financeable, and dispatch-ready product class. The Corporation expects to award an additional 12-18 GWh of four-hour standalone BESS across two tender cycles in 2029-H2 to 2030-H1, subject to DISCOM offtake demand aggregation.

2. Eight-hour pilot product line: approximately 10% of new federal tender volume. Building on the 5% pilot announced in 2028-H2, the Corporation will scale the eight-hour pilot to capture commercial reference data from operating assets before considering broader procurement. Eligibility will remain contingent on multi-cycle operating history at commercial scale, in line with the disclosure trajectory signalled by international demonstration cohorts.

3. Co-located and hybrid storage-RE configurations: approximately 15% of new federal tender volume. These will continue to be procured under separate cost-recovery structures to avoid conflating merchant and contracted revenue.

4. Technology-neutral participation: The Corporation's tender documents are already technology-neutral at the product specification level (MW / MWh / availability factor / dispatchable hours), with specific safety and grid-code compliance requirements. Procurement outcomes will reflect bidder choice within these specifications.

Operating-Capacity Reporting:

From FY2029-H2 onwards, SECI will publish quarterly operating-capacity statistics alongside tender activity, measured as:
- Aggregate commissioned capacity (MW / MWh) within the SECI-contracted cohort
- Equivalent availability factor (EAF) by duration class
- Average contracted capacity charge realised versus contracted benchmark
- Aggregate GWh dispatched at system-stress hours

The Corporation notes the international observation that 420 GW of LDES by 2040 — as referenced in credible net-zero pathways — requires technology-neutral procurement, long-tenor contracts, and duration-stratified capacity mechanisms operating in conjunction. SECI's pipeline composition is calibrated to contribute India's share of this trajectory, while ensuring that awarded capacity converts to operating capacity on contracted timelines.

Conversion — not procurement volume — is the metric by which the federal storage programme will be assessed.

— Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited, 2029-H1

FERC notes the ongoing global convergence on duration-stratified capacity accreditation and scarcity-pricing parameter calibration as core mechanisms for differentiating storage value by duration class. The Commission observes that ERCOT's NPRR1234 and NPRR1235 — introducing duration-segmented capacity accreditation factors and revising Operating Reserve Demand Curve parameters to better reflect resource adequacy marginal value — are consistent with the principles the Commission has articulated regarding technology-neutral accreditation within reliability constraints. The Commission emphasizes that price signals should be generated by market design rather than by administrative long-term capacity contracts, and that accreditation methodologies must reward dependable contribution during system-stress hours across duration classes. The Commission further notes that these developments complement Order No. 2023's cluster study framework: as accreditation rules increasingly differentiate by duration, the interconnection process must accommodate the operational characteristics of diverse storage technologies without discriminatory treatment. Affected ISO/RTOs and transmission providers should ensure that any refinements to accreditation methodologies, readiness criteria, or withdrawal penalties are supported by adequate record evidence and submitted through the appropriate compliance filing process under Docket No. RM22-14 and related dockets. The Commission will continue to monitor implementation outcomes as cluster studies progress and accreditation reforms mature across the ISO/RTO footprint.

【关于"十五五"新型储能规划编制指导意见实施的阶段性要求】为确保"十五五"新型储能规划编制指导意见落地见效，现就2029年下半年省级实施方案编制和首批试点项目部署提出以下要求：一、省级实施方案编制。各省级发改委、能源局要严格按照我委印发的指导意见，于2029年12月底前完成省级"十五五"新型储能实施方案编制并报我委、国家能源局备案。实施方案须明确：（1）分年度装机规模及长时储能占比目标；（2）duration-stratified容量电价/容量补偿具体标准；（3）调度运行考核细则；（4）多元化技术路线分类推进方案；（5）安全监管与退出机制。二、首批duration-stratified容量电价试点。我委会同国家能源局选取山东、广东、内蒙古、浙江、青海等省（区）作为首批duration-stratified容量电价试点省份，2029年底前出台试点方案，2020年Q1起执行。三、长时储能重点项目。聚焦压缩空气、液流电池、钠离子电池等"十五五"商业化重点技术，组织实施一批长时储能示范项目，重点验证长时段调峰场景下的系统价值。四、调度运行数据统一接入。各省级电网企业须于2029年底前完成新型储能调度数据统一接入规范改造，实现等效利用小时数、调度响应合规率、市场化调用率、容量因子四项核心指标实时监测。五、安全监管专项核查。我委将于2029年Q4联合应急管理、市场监管等部门开展专项核查，对不满足"可观、可测、可控、可调"技术合规要求的项目坚决清退，结果向社会公开。坚持全国一盘棋，确保新型储能在"双碳"目标落实和新型电力系统建设中发挥坚实支撑作用。

【ERCOT系统对储能项目阶段透明度的立场——回应IEA"公告GW vs 调度GWh"分歧】

IEA近期提出的"公告GW vs 调度GWh"分裂判断与中国国家能源局清理"纸面装机"专项工作高度一致。ERCOT作为ISO，对该方向的实证价值高度认同，并在自身实践中已建立三阶段透明度框架：

一、ERCOT并网三阶段披露
- 阶段一（Interconnection Study完成）：仅计入"队列容量"，不公布为可用容量；
- 阶段二（Signed IA + 财务担保到位）：计入"承诺容量"，但与运营容量分开统计；
- 阶段三（完成调试、通过AGC/AVC联调、连续30天运行可用率≥95%）：计入"运营容量"。

截至2029-Q2，ERCOT队列中：阶段一约18 GW、阶段二约7 GW、阶段三（已运营）约16 GW。三者合计41 GW，但ERCOT在容量规划与可靠性评估中仅采用阶段三数据。

二、关键区别：ERCOT不依赖折扣系数
IEA与BYD提出的0.85/0.55/0.30折扣框架适用于披露口径不透明的ISO/RTO。ERCOT的做法更直接：阶段一不计入任何容量规划场景，阶段二仅作为敏感性情景。折扣系数是"不透明披露下的次优近似"，而分阶段透明披露才是首选方法。

三、对全球ISO的建议
ERCOT建议各国ISO/RTO采纳以下原则：（1）容量规划与可靠性评估必须以"已运营且通过调度联调"的资产为基础；（2）"纸面装机"或"调试中"资产不参与稀缺定价资源的容量认证；（3）阶段披露应作为ISO的强制性信息披露义务，而非企业自愿行为。

ERCOT将于2030年向PUCT提交信息披露规则修订建议，进一步强化阶段披露的强制性。

PJM takes note of ERCOT's first operational report under NPRR1234 duration-stratified capacity accreditation and Hydrostor's articulation of the 8-24 hour A-CAES development framework. Three observations grounded in PJM's operational experience:

**First, the reliability contribution coefficients merit close examination.** ERCOT's data showing a 6h tier at 0.74, 8h tier at 0.83, and 10h+ tier at 0.89—versus 4h at 0.62—provides the kind of hourly-equivalent availability evidence that PJM has argued is essential to prevent 4-hour saturation from masking multi-hour adequacy gaps. PJM's ELRP methodology already accounts for duration-dependent contribution; ERCOT's tiered coefficients are a useful operational confirmation of that principle. The 28% improvement in 8h+ asset net revenue (reaching approximately $145/kW-year in 2028-H2) and the corresponding decline in 4-hour asset revenue to approximately $68/kW-year illustrate exactly the price-signal differentiation that duration-stratified accreditation is designed to produce.

**Second, the self-adjusting market signal is the correct mechanism.** ERCOT's report that the share of new interconnection BESS projects at 6+ hours rose from 18% to 31% in a single half-year confirms that market design can guide investment direction without administrative mandate. PJM's capacity-market design produces analogous signals through the BRA clearing price: scarcity pricing re-emerged in the 2027/28 BRA (clearing 134,311 MW) precisely because accreditation rules distinguished dependable contribution from queued megawatts.

**Third, granularity and accuracy must advance together.** ERCOT's next-step plan to refine stratification granularity from 2-hour to 1-hour bins is sound. PJM's accreditation methodology will continue to evolve alongside operational data from the 2026/27 and 2027/28 BRA cohorts. As Hydrostor correctly notes, technology-neutral procurement for 8-24 hour resources should specify continuous discharge, availability during system-stress windows, and response/recovery requirements—then provide a contract structure aligned with the asset's life and construction profile.

PJM remains committed to refining its accreditation framework to reward dependable contribution across all duration classes, while preserving the scarcity-pricing dynamics that underwrite new entry without sustained excessive costs to load.

SECI's position on the 2027-2028 cluster study results under FERC Order 2023 reinforces the Corporation's own internal reforms. The cluster-study framework addresses precisely the Indian BESS procurement gap: at approximately 102 GWh tendered versus approximately 0.5 GWh commissioned, the binding constraint is not tender volume but the conversion of tender volume to commissioned assets. Three operational points for SECI's 2029-H2 pipeline: First, SECI's tender documents will require interconnection approval at the application stage for projects above 50 MW — modelled on FERC Order 2023's Pre-Application Report logic. Second, milestone-based withdrawal penalties are now incorporated in all SECI tender documents for 2029-H2 onwards, calibrated at approximately 1% per quarter of delay with a cap at the performance security amount. Third, SECI expects the next major tender cycle to use a phased bid-fee structure that distinguishes EPC-committed projects from framework-stage capacity, in line with the discount methodology discussed internationally. We will publish first conversion-rate data for the 2019-2024 awarded cohort in our next quarterly operating-capacity report.

【运行季报】新型储能调度运行监测季报（2029年三季度）

一、装机运行基本情况。截至2029年三季度，全国新型储能累计并网装机规模稳步推进。各省电网企业按统一口径实时上报遥测数据，纳入规模统计的项目均已完成AGC/AVC联调、纳入调度运行、报送真实数据。"框架协议""备忘录""意向装机"一律不计入并网规模统计。

二、利用水平。等效利用小时数较去年同期稳步提升，4小时级以上项目调度贡献度持续提高。局部地区4小时级以下短时长资源出现调度边际化趋势，验证了"差异化时长、差异化收益"的必要性。

Highview Power notes with strong approval the convergence now visible across NDRC's "15th Five-Year" storage planning consultation, FERC's endorsement of duration-stratified accreditation, PJM's continuation of capacity-market discipline, and ERCOT's NPRR on duration-tiered capacity crediting and scarcity pricing. When regulators in four of the world's largest power systems simultaneously move from nameplate-MW accounting toward duration-weighted availability valuation, the investment signal for 8-hour-plus non-lithium routes changes fundamentally.

For LAES specifically, three implications follow from the China policy stance now on the table:

1. **Duration stratification unlocks our 8-hour-plus segment.** The data point that compressed-air and other long-duration routes "have comparative advantages in long-duration peak-shaving scenarios" is consistent with what the Carrington 50MW demonstrator has shown — liquid-air is engineered precisely for 6-12+ hour discharge with no geographic siting constraint and no degradation of stored energy over time. We are not competing for the 2-hour frequency-regulation slot; we are targeting the multi-hour energy-shifting slot that four-hour lithium saturation is leaving open.

2. **Capacity mechanisms must recognize duration honestly.** A capacity price that differentiates between <2-hour, 2-4-hour, 4-8-hour, and 8-hour-plus resources is the single most important policy variable for non-lithium LDES financeability. Highview stands ready to submit technical performance data — round-trip efficiency in the 50-60% band, verified cycle performance, modular scaling curves, established turbomachinery supply chain — to NDRC, Ofgem/NESO, FERC, and any other forum conducting these rulemakings.

3. **Regulated revenue floors substitute for missing operating history, but only temporarily.** Our UK 300MW project under the cap-and-floor regime is the test case. If Carrington and follow-on projects demonstrate independently verified availability and round-trip efficiency over the next 24-36 months, non-lithium LDES routes can graduate from regulated revenue support to merchant + capacity-market revenues on equal footing with any other resource. If they do not, the technology should not be commercially subsidized.

Our message to system operators designing the next round of capacity mechanisms: structure the contracts on duration × verified availability, not on technology categories. LAES, vanadium flow, iron-air, compressed-air, sodium-ion, and gravity storage will sort themselves out on operational merit — and that is precisely the outcome regulators should want.

**EU Storage Policy Bulletin — 2029 H2: Regulatory Convergence on Dispatched Performance**

The European Commission notes with interest the parallel evolution of storage policy frameworks across major jurisdictions in 2029. Three converging signals deserve explicit recognition:

**1. Duration-weighted accreditation is now the global baseline.** PJM's 2026/27 BRA clearing at 329 USD/MW-day for 4-hour resources, ERCOT's NPRR1234 on duration-stratified accreditation, and the NEA's integration of dispatch compliance, equivalent utilization hours, and AGC/AVC availability into operational assessment all point in the same direction. The EU's Electricity Market Design reform — with ACER's monitoring reports already flagging the saturation of ancillary service markets by 4-hour assets — is fully aligned. Member States designing or amending national capacity mechanisms under State Aid scrutiny should expect the Commission to assess whether the mechanism rewards *verifiable availability over duration*, not installed nameplate.

**2. The "paper GW vs. dispatched GWh" distinction is no longer controversial.** China's NDRC/NEA 1360-document framework, by conditioning statistical inclusion on telemetry, remote control, and dispatch compliance, has institutionalized what the EU has been advocating through network codes and the Action Plan for Digitalising the Energy System. Operators and manufacturers who claim grid value must demonstrate that value in operation. The Commission's position is unchanged: storage that is not visible, controllable, and dispatchable by the system operator is not providing the service for which it is compensated.

**3. Technology neutrality must be operationally honest.** The Commission takes note of the position articulated by BYD in its 2029-H1 communiqué: that LFP retains LCOS leadership for 4-hour projects, that sodium-ion, flow, and compressed-air serve complementary longer-duration segments, and that LDES commercialization claims should be backed by grid-scale operating data rather than technology branding. This is precisely the discipline the EU seeks from market participants under the Net-Zero Industry Act and the Battery Regulation. Operational data — not press releases — is the basis on which strategic autonomy, decarbonization, and single-market standards will be assessed.

**Next steps from the Commission in 2029-H2:**
- Publication of the Q4 2029 ACER Market Monitoring Report on storage participation in wholesale and balancing markets, with duration-stratified analysis.
- Launch of a public consultation on duration-weighted capacity valuation methodology for Member State mechanisms notified under State Aid rules.
- Continued assessment of NZIA strategic project applications, with priority given to projects demonstrating bankable offtake, grid connection milestones, and compliance with EU battery sustainability requirements.
- Technical dialogue with ENTSO-E and the DSO Entity on harmonized telemetry, dispatch, and data-sharing protocols for grid-connected storage.

The regulatory perimeter established by the Battery Regulation, NZIA, CRMA, and CBAM is not a barrier to deployment. It is the framework within which deployment translates into European energy security, industrial resilience, and lifecycle sustainability. We welcome the convergence of practice in other jurisdictions — it confirms the direction.

【NESO Statement: Cap-and-Floor Pathway for Long-Duration Storage — 2029 H2 Update】

Following the 2029 H1 cap-and-floor determination, NESO confirms the following implementation milestones for the qualifying long-duration storage projects:

1. Regulatory Floor and Cap Parameters. For projects above 8-hour duration, the cap-and-floor envelope has been set to provide revenue certainty sufficient for non-recourse project finance, while preserving consumer protection through a hard cap on total support. Final parameters are published in the 2029 H1 determination document and have been shared with selected awardees under confidentiality protocols.

2. Highview Power Liquid-Air Project. NESO continues to support the regulated revenue framework that underwrites the bankability of Highview's liquid-air reference project, substituting contractual floor revenue for the absence of a multi-year operating history. Commissioning milestones and performance verification requirements remain on track per the published timetable. Any material deviation from agreed availability targets will trigger a structured review under the cap-and-floor governance protocol.

3. Performance Reporting Standard. All cap-and-floor awardees will be required to publish independent verification of round-trip efficiency, equivalent availability factor by duration class, and response to system stress events. Data will be disaggregated by technology and shared with NESO for system-planning purposes.

4. Technology-Neutral Procurement Posture. NESO reiterates that qualification under the cap-and-floor framework is determined by duration, availability, and cost-effectiveness — not by technology preselection. Liquid-air, compressed-air, flow batteries, thermal storage, and other qualifying routes remain eligible on equal footing.

5. Risk Allocation. NESO emphasizes that the cap-and-floor is a transitional mechanism intended to bridge the financing gap until merchant operating history for long-duration assets is sufficient to support standalone project finance. The framework is not a permanent subsidy and will be reviewed against the 2030-2032 procurement cycle.

Reference projects remain a necessary precondition for the emergence of a commercially validated long-duration asset class. NESO's objective is to ensure that qualifying projects commission on schedule, meet availability obligations, and produce the operating evidence required for subsequent merchant deployment.

The 2029-H2 period marks the operational arrival of what the IEA Special Report on LDES (2023) flagged as the decisive variable: duration-stratified capacity mechanisms with credible duration tiers and dispatch-telemetry enforcement. Three of the world's largest power systems—China, ERCOT, and PJM—now operate distinct but converging variants of this framework:

1. **China (NDRC/NEA 2029 joint notification):** Lithium batteries stratified at 2-4h and 4-8h tiers; compressed air and flow batteries in a dedicated 8h+ tier; explicit refusal to count framework agreements, MOUs, and intent memoranda in grid-connected capacity statistics; capacity tariff funded through the transmission-distribution tariff with monthly disbursement. This is the first system-level alignment of payment mechanism, dispatch-telemetry requirement ("four remoteness"), and statistical rigor at scale.

2. **ERCOT (NPRR1234 implementation):** Finer-grained duration stratification at 2h bins (4h/6h/8h/10h+), with ICAP-weighted accreditation reflecting contribution during summer/winter peak events. The first empirical evidence—4h contributing ~0.62 vs 6h ~0.74—suggests that coarse "4h threshold" rules systematically under-recognize 5-7h assets. ERCOT's commitment to publish a tier-by-tier reliability-contribution report to PUCT in 2029-H1 establishes the world's first open dataset for cross-jurisdictional comparison.

3. **PJM (ELRP/CPRO refinements):** Duration-accredited accreditation continues to evolve alongside FERC Order No. 2023 queue reform, with technology-neutral rules but explicit recognition that the 2026/27 BRA's narrow clearing of only 5,510 MW at net CONE ~$329/MW-day validated scarcity-pricing signals. The 2027/28 BRA clearing 134,311 MW reconfirmed that scarcity can re-emerge when accreditation remains credible.

The cross-system convergence is the macro-fact for the IEA World Energy Outlook 2030 baseline:

- Where previously the central case assumed that capacity payments would either remain absent (ERCOT-style energy-only) or fail to differentiate by duration (legacy PJM/acute capacity markets), the 2030 reality now requires modeling **three distinct capacity-market regimes** with different LCOS thresholds and different implied investment signals for 8-12 hour storage.
- The 30/25/20/25 scenario weighting (Lithium Dominance / LDES Diversified / China-Centric Vertical / Stagnation) requires rebalancing. The capacity-mechanism convergence strengthens LDES-Diversified modestly; the simultaneous progress on interconnection reform and dispatch-telemetry enforcement strengthens the Stagnation-scenario's worst-case mitigation. IEA will publish revised weightings in the 2030 World Energy Outlook storage annex.

Three empirical questions for 2030-H2 that will determine which scenario dominates by 2035:

(i) Will China's 8h+ capacity tariff tier attract credible non-lithium LDES bids, or will the 8h+ tier remain dominated by retrofitted or hybridized assets pending demonstration data?
(ii) Will ERCOT's tier-by-tier report validate a true duration premium in scarcity pricing, or will the post-2027 saturation continue to suppress marginal revenue?
(iii) Will PJM's accreditation framework continue to clear scarcity-marginal 4h assets, or will the next BRA signal the need for explicit 8h+ accretion?

Independent, audited operating data from the first cohort of MACSE, Saudi SEC, SECI VGF Phase II, and high-view LAES assets will be the proximate evidence for scenario resolution.

【ERCOT对NEA三档容量电价机制（2029-Q4征求意见稿）的技术回应】

注意到国家能源局近期发布的"三档容量电价"征求意见稿，按运行时长（2-4小时、4-8小时、8小时以上）、可靠性、调度贡献度三维分档定价。ERCOT作为得州ISO，对该方向表示高度认同——核心原则与ERCOT NPRR1234（持续时间分层容量认证）完全一致：

一、原则共识
"按运行时长、可靠性、调度贡献度三维分档定价"与ERCOT的"持续时间分层+可用率因子+调度响应合规率"复合认证方法在逻辑上同构。两种路径均承认：同质化4小时资产的边际系统价值随装机增加而递减，行政性价格分档与市场价格信号殊途同归。

二、关键差异：颗粒度与触发机制
- 中国方案：行政定价，三档划分（2-4h/4-8h/8h+），稳定但粗放；
- ERCOT方案：市场出清，六档划分（2/4/6/8/10/12h+），灵活但复杂。

从运行数据看，六档划分比三档划分更精确：8h与10h+资产的可靠性贡献差距约7%（0.83 vs 0.89），三档划分将丢失该信号。

三、技术建议
ERCOT向NEA建议：（1）三档划分可作为过渡方案，但应在2025年前完成向五档以上细化的升级；（2）价格分档应与调度运行考核挂钩，而非静态铭牌认证——运行时长低于铭牌的资产应自动降档；（3）建议保留价格信号的市场化路径（现货+辅助服务+容量），行政性容量电价仅作为兜底，而非主导。

ERCOT重申其核心立场：能源与辅助服务市场仍是揭示储能系统价值的主渠道，行政性容量电价/补偿应在市场信号失灵时启用，而非替代市场。

PJM welcomes the European Commission's 2029-H2 Storage Policy Bulletin and its explicit recognition that duration-weighted accreditation has become the global baseline. The Commission's articulation—that capacity mechanisms under State Aid scrutiny will be assessed on whether they reward "verifiable availability over duration, not installed nameplate"—directly mirrors PJM's operational experience.

The convergence is now empirically grounded. PJM's 2026/27 BRA cleared only 5,510 MW of four-hour-class resources at a net CONE-anchored clearing price of approximately $329/MW-day, demonstrating that the market differentiates dependable contribution from queued megawatts. The 2027/28 BRA, clearing 134,311 MW, confirmed that scarcity pricing re-emerges when accreditation remains credible. ERCOT's NPRR1234 operational data—showing 4h tier reliability contribution of 0.62 versus 8h tier at 0.83—provides the kind of hourly-equivalent availability evidence that PJM has long argued is essential to prevent 4-hour saturation from masking multi-hour adequacy gaps.

Three priorities for 2030-H1:

**First, accreditation-data integration.** PJM will continue to publish duration-stratified availability data aligned with the IEA's recommendation for hourly-equivalent availability factors by duration class. The Commission's forthcoming ACER Market Monitoring Report on duration-stratified analysis will provide a valuable comparator for PJM's own methodology.

**Second, queue-accreditation coupling under FERC Order No. 2023.** PJM's compliance filings will continue to ensure that cluster study processes, milestone-based withdrawal penalties, and readiness scoring filter for commercial viability while preserving capacity needed for reliability. The Commission's observation that "storage that is not visible, controllable, and dispatchable by the system operator is not providing the service for which it is compensated" aligns precisely with PJM's CPRO requirements.

**Third, scarcity-pricing preservation amid expanding qualified supply.** As PJM's qualified queue continues to grow, the risk of revenue cannibalization—analogous to ERCOT's 2023-2024 collapse from approximately $192/kW-year to approximately $55/kW-year before partial recovery—requires active monitoring. PJM will continue to evaluate whether accreditation refinements are needed to preserve scarcity pricing signals as four-hour-class saturation increases.

The convergence of regulatory frameworks across the EU, China, India, and the United States on duration-weighted accreditation, observable dispatchable contribution, and rejection of paper capacity represents a structural break with the 2023-2025 four-hour saturation era. PJM remains committed to refining its accreditation methodology to reward dependable contribution across all duration classes.

SECI 2030-H1 Strategic Communication: First Operating-Capacity Report and Forward Procurement Plan

The Corporation publishes today its first quarterly operating-capacity report covering the federal standalone BESS cohort. The report addresses the central question facing the federal storage programme: how much of the awarded pipeline has actually converted to dispatchable, operating assets?

Headline Findings:

1. Commissioned capacity within the SECI-contracted cohort as of 2030-Q1 stands at approximately 4.8 GWh, compared with cumulative awarded capacity of approximately 38 GWh across the 2019-2027 tender vintages. This represents a conversion rate of approximately 13% — an improvement on the 0.5 GWh figure observed at the start of the reporting horizon, but still substantially below the rates that informed earlier tender volumes.

2. The principal reasons for non-conversion remain: (a) state DISCOM offtake credit conditions preventing financial closure, (b) interconnection approval delays at CTU/STU level, and (c) EPC contractor capacity constraints during periods of compressed award-to-commissioning deadlines.

3. Projects that have reached commercial operation demonstrate EAFs in the 88-92% range — broadly consistent with the four-hour-class reliability assumptions underlying the standard PPA template.

Forward Procurement Plan for 2030-H2 to 2031-H1:

In response to these findings, the Corporation will adjust the forward procurement architecture as follows:

- The aggregate federal tender volume for 2030-H2 / 2031-H1 will be calibrated at approximately 60% of the originally announced 102 GWh aspirational pipeline, reflecting realistic offtake demand aggregation from state DISCOMs and credible developer capacity.
- Within this calibrated volume, the four-hour product remains at approximately 75%, the eight-hour pilot at 10%, co-located storage-RE at 15%.
- SECI will introduce a formal "Conversion Window" clause in all new tender documents: awarded projects must reach financial closure within 12 months of award, must commence construction within 18 months, and must reach commercial operation within 30 months. Failure to meet these milestones triggers performance-security forfeiture and award cancellation, with re-tender of the capacity within 90 days.
- SECI will publish, alongside this operating-capacity report, a state-wise demand aggregation matrix so that prospective bidders have full visibility of DISCOM-level offtake commitments at bid stage.

The Corporation notes that the conversion-rate trajectory will be the principal metric by which the federal storage programme is assessed over the next decade. Operating capacity — measured in GWh dispatched at moments of system stress, with EAFs consistent with the four-hour product's reliability assumptions — is the metric by which SECI will henceforth be evaluated.

— Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited, 2030-H1

We agree that procurement should be technology-neutral and based on duration × verified availability. One qualification: long-tenor capacity or tolling contracts are not merely a temporary substitute for operating history. For capital-intensive, long-life assets, they also allocate revenue risk over a term consistent with infrastructure financing—even after performance is demonstrated.

Evaluation should include continuous output through stress events, response and recovery, annual availability, independently verifiable efficiency, construction maturity and site constraints. A-CAES will compete where geology, interconnection and cavern delivery are suitable; LAES and other routes will have different siting and cost profiles. Comparable contracts and measurement protocols will allow those differences to be priced transparently.

FERC observes that the global convergence on duration-weighted capacity valuation, hourly-equivalent availability factor reporting by duration class, and stage-based interconnection transparency continues to accelerate. The Commission notes the IEA's 2028 monitoring of structural shifts and finds that the principles articulated — that announced GW must be distinguished from dispatched GWh, that accreditation must reward dependable contribution during system-stress hours, and that interconnection reform must proceed in lockstep with accreditation reform — are fully consistent with Order No. 2023's cluster study framework and the Commission's ongoing evaluation of ISO/RTO tariff filings. The Commission emphasizes three points for the current implementation period: (1) Readiness requirements, milestone-based withdrawal penalties, and upfront engineering study deposits under Order No. 2023 are designed to compress the gap between queued capacity and operational capacity by requiring demonstrated project maturity; (2) Capacity planning and reliability assessments should rely on operational assets that have completed dispatch commissioning, supported by phased disclosure as a standard practice; and (3) Accreditation frameworks must remain technology-neutral within reliability constraints, ensuring non-discriminatory market access for storage and distributed energy resources under Order No. 2222. Affected transmission providers and ISO/RTOs should ensure that any further refinements to readiness criteria, accreditation methodologies, or disclosure requirements are supported by adequate record evidence and submitted through the appropriate compliance filing process under Docket No. RM22-14 and related dockets.
